paragraphs.zh: Bench-MFG 提供离散时间、离散状态的平稳平均场博弈，涵盖不同交互性质的问题类别及随机 MF-Garnet 实例。求解目标是个体策略与群体分布相容的均衡。
paragraphs.en: Bench-MFG provides discrete-time, discrete-state stationary mean-field games, including contrasting interaction classes and random MF-Garnet instances. Solvers seek equilibria with compatible individual policies and population distributions.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究均衡求解、算法收敛及对问题结构变化的鲁棒性，可在具有不同交互性质的实例间比较学习算法与数值求解器。
paragraphs.en: It supports equilibrium computation, convergence analysis and robustness studies, comparing learning algorithms and numerical solvers across interaction structures.

paragraphs.zh: 主要指标为可利用度，即固定群体分布下个体转向最佳回应所获得的收益增量。收敛曲线与多实例统计刻画求解效率、稳定性和失效模式。
paragraphs.en: Exploitability measures the gain from switching to a best response against a fixed population distribution. Convergence curves and instance-wise statistics characterize efficiency, stability and failure modes.

paragraphs.zh: 评测对象为数学博弈中的策略与分布求解，实验条件包括博弈类别、随机实例、算法配置及求解预算。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation concerns policy and distribution solvers for mathematical games, parameterized by game class, random instances, algorithm configuration and solver budget.

paragraphs.zh: BALROG 将 BabyAI、Crafter、TextWorld、Baba Is AI、MiniHack 和 NetHack 纳入统一的观测—动作评测框架，任务涵盖指令执行、规则解谜、资源获取和地牢探索。
paragraphs.en: BALROG unifies observation–action evaluation across BabyAI, Crafter, TextWorld, Baba Is AI, MiniHack and NetHack, spanning instructions, rule puzzles, resource acquisition and dungeon exploration.

paragraphs.zh: 用于比较 LLM 与 VLM 的持续决策表现，并研究提示策略、历史窗口和观测模态对多阶段任务进展的影响。
paragraphs.en: It compares sustained decision making in LLMs and VLMs and supports studies of prompting, history windows and observation modality in multistage tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 分别记录指令或解谜任务的完成情况，以及 Crafter 成就、NetHack 得分等环境进展，再按套件的归一化规则汇总。分环境成绩用于辨别模型在不同目标和动作机制下的差异。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation records instruction or puzzle completion and environment progress such as Crafter achievements and NetHack score, then aggregates using the suite’s normalization rules. Per-environment results expose differences across objectives and action mechanisms.

paragraphs.zh: 六个环境共享智能体调用流程，各自保留任务目标、终止条件与动作集合。文本和图像输入、历史窗口及单局交互预算是套件对比中的主要实验变量。
paragraphs.en: The six environments share an agent-invocation workflow while retaining their own objectives, termination rules and action sets. Text versus image input, history windows and episode interaction budgets are principal experimental variables.

paragraphs.zh: TeamCraft 在 Minecraft 中设置蓝图建造、方块清除、耕作和冶炼任务。多个智能体结合语言与蓝图提示、各自视觉观测及物品信息，协同完成共同目标；项目提供程序生成的专家示范。
paragraphs.en: TeamCraft provides Minecraft tasks for blueprint building, clearing, farming and smelting. Agents combine language and blueprint prompts, individual visual observations and inventories to pursue shared goals, with procedural expert demonstrations.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究多模态动作策略、模仿学习与任务分工，以及协作策略对新目标、新场景和智能体数量变化的泛化。
paragraphs.en: It supports multimodal policies, imitation learning, task allocation and generalization to new goals, scenes and agent counts.

paragraphs.zh: 采用子目标成功率与完整任务成功率，分别刻画局部操作完成情况及团队目标达成情况。集中式与分布式模型提供不同信息组织方式下的比较。
paragraphs.en: Subgoal and full-task success rates characterize local execution and shared-objective completion. Centralized and decentralized models provide comparisons across information structures.

paragraphs.zh: 评测单元为指定任务、队伍规模与控制方式下的团队表现。视觉任务与文本简化设置对应不同观测条件。
paragraphs.en: The evaluation unit is team performance for a specified task, team size and control scheme. Visual tasks and simplified text settings use different observation conditions.

paragraphs.zh: Crafter 采用像素视觉和离散动作。智能体在随机世界中寻找食物和材料、制作工具并维持健康、饥饿和口渴等状态，通过资源依赖链解锁22项成就。
paragraphs.en: Crafter uses pixel observations and discrete actions. Agents gather food and materials, craft tools and maintain health, hunger and thirst, unlocking 22 achievements through resource dependencies.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究深度探索、技能组合和长期目标推进，并比较奖励驱动与内在目标驱动的学习方法。
paragraphs.en: It supports deep exploration, skill composition and sustained goal pursuit, including comparisons of reward-driven and intrinsically motivated learning.

paragraphs.zh: 先计算22项成就各自在评测回合中的达成率，再以带偏移的几何平均汇总为 Crafter 分数。分成就达成率显示技能覆盖，回合回报则描述奖励设置下的执行表现。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation first computes each of the 22 achievements’ attainment rates across episodes, then combines them using a shifted geometric mean into the Crafter score. Per-achievement rates show skill coverage; episode return describes performance under the chosen reward setting.

paragraphs.zh: 评测围绕单一生存世界中的多项成就展开，环境版本、随机种子、奖励设置与交互预算构成实验条件。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation spans multiple achievements within one survival world. Environment version, seeds, reward settings and interaction budget define the experimental conditions.

paragraphs.zh: SMAC 基于《星际争霸 II》的小规模战斗，每个智能体控制一个单位，依据局部观测选择移动或攻击等动作，协同击败内置敌军。场景在兵种组合、数量和难度上有所变化。
paragraphs.en: SMAC consists of small StarCraft II battles. Each agent controls one unit from local observations, coordinating movement and attacks to defeat built-in enemies across varied unit compositions and difficulty levels.

paragraphs.zh: 用于比较去中心化多智能体强化学习、信用分配和协作控制方法。局部观测与异质兵种为团队决策提供不同协作条件。
paragraphs.en: It supports decentralized MARL, credit assignment and cooperative control, with local observations and heterogeneous units providing varied coordination settings.

paragraphs.zh: 核心指标为场景时限内的测试胜率；随训练步数变化的胜率曲线刻画学习效率。训练过程同时提供密集奖励信号。
paragraphs.en: The primary metric is test win rate within the scenario limit. Win-rate curves over training steps characterize learning efficiency, alongside shaped rewards used during training.

paragraphs.zh: 评测聚焦战斗微操。原版 SMAC 与 SMACv2 采用不同场景分布，结果对应具体 StarCraft II 版本、地图与评估配置。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation targets combat micromanagement. Original SMAC and SMACv2 use different scenario distributions, with outcomes tied to the StarCraft II version, maps and evaluation configuration.

paragraphs.zh: Katakomba 为 NetHack 提供分角色配置的离线数据、加载工具与学习基线。策略从 AutoAscend 轨迹学习后，在 NetHack 环境中执行并接受评测。
paragraphs.en: Katakomba supplies character-specific NetHack datasets, loaders and offline-learning baselines. Policies learn from AutoAscend trajectories and are evaluated through subsequent NetHack interaction.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究离线强化学习、序列策略和数据利用，考察已有行为轨迹如何支持长序列决策与实际游戏表现。
paragraphs.en: It supports offline RL, sequential policies and data-use studies, examining how logged behavior supports long-sequence decisions and gameplay performance.

paragraphs.zh: 各角色分数按对应 AutoAscend 平均分归一化，并报告中位数、四分位均值及性能分布，以描述高变异回报下的总体表现。
paragraphs.en: Character scores are normalized to their corresponding AutoAscend mean, with medians, interquartile means and performance distributions summarizing highly variable returns.

paragraphs.zh: 训练采用固定离线轨迹，评测采用在线游戏得分。数据分布偏向早期游戏，角色配置、数据规模与运行预算决定具体实验范围。
paragraphs.en: Training uses fixed offline trajectories and evaluation measures online game scores. The data emphasize early gameplay; character configurations, dataset size and evaluation budgets define the experimental scope.

paragraphs.zh: CivRealm 基于 Freeciv-web 提供文明经营与竞争环境，支持张量 RL 和语言智能体接口。完整对局涉及探索、城市与单位发展、科技和外交，专项小游戏在相同规则下聚焦局部决策。
paragraphs.en: CivRealm provides civilization management and competition in Freeciv-web, supporting tensor-RL and language-agent interfaces. Full games involve exploration, cities, units, technology and diplomacy; minigames target particular decisions under the same rules.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究长期战略、资源取舍与层次化决策。完整对局考察多目标协调，建城选址等小游戏则支持对特定决策环节的分析。
paragraphs.en: It supports long-term strategy, resource trade-offs and hierarchical decisions. Full games examine coordination across objectives, while minigames such as city-site selection support analysis of specific decision components.

paragraphs.zh: 完整游戏统计人口、城市、科技、单位、探索范围与综合得分；专项小游戏采用各自的目标和指标，例如建城任务中的资源得分。
paragraphs.en: Full-game measures include population, cities, technologies, units, exploration and aggregate score. Minigames use task-specific objectives and metrics, such as resource scores for city placement.

paragraphs.zh: 完整对局与专项小游戏构成两个评测层级。地图、对手、初始局面、回合预算，以及语言或张量观测接口定义各层级的实验设置。
paragraphs.en: Full games and minigames form two evaluation levels. Maps, opponents, initial states, turn budgets and language or tensor observation interfaces define their experimental settings.

paragraphs.zh: Collab-Overcooked 在 Overcooked-AI 上扩展菜谱、食材和任务。两个智能体通过行动与自然语言交流完成订单，协调取料、加工和交付之间的先后依赖。
paragraphs.en: Collab-Overcooked extends Overcooked-AI with recipes, ingredients and tasks. Two agents act and communicate in natural language to coordinate dependencies between gathering, processing and delivery.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究 LLM 协作、任务分解和交流机制对执行效率的影响，分析智能体如何分工、发起协作并响应伙伴。
paragraphs.en: It supports LLM cooperation, task decomposition and communication studies, examining allocation of work and the initiation of and response to collaboration.

paragraphs.zh: 任务结果采用成功率与成功轨迹的完成时间步；协作过程采用参考动作序列相似度或冗余，以及协作发起与响应统计。
paragraphs.en: Outcomes are measured by success rate and completion timesteps on successful trajectories. Process metrics include reference-action similarity or redundancy and collaboration initiation and response statistics.

paragraphs.zh: 评测基于扩展版研究环境中的双智能体订单任务。任务、布局、伙伴与预算确定实验条件，完成时间以环境步数计量。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation covers two-agent order tasks in the extended research environment. Tasks, layouts, partners and budgets define experimental conditions, with completion time measured in environment steps.

body.en: Evaluation covers two-agent order tasks in the extended research environment. Tasks, layouts, partners and budgets define experimental conditions, with completion time measured in environment steps.

paragraphs.zh: MiniGrid 提供导航、取物、开门和记忆等网格世界任务，智能体依据任务提示与局部观测操作物体。例如 Memory 任务要求记住起点物体，再穿过走廊选择匹配目标。
paragraphs.en: MiniGrid provides grid-world tasks for navigation, retrieval, doors and memory, using mission text and local observations. Memory requires retaining an initial object cue and later selecting a matching destination.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究部分可观测决策、记忆和目标执行。地图结构、可见范围与任务难度可配置，便于构造受控实验与算法消融。
paragraphs.en: It supports partial observability, memory and goal execution through configurable map structures, visibility and difficulty, enabling controlled experiments and ablations.

paragraphs.zh: 以 MiniGrid Memory 为例，智能体记住起点物体并在走廊末端选择匹配目标；选对时获得随耗用步数折减的奖励，选错时为零。成功率衡量记忆后的选择，平均回报同时反映行动效率。
paragraphs.en: In MiniGrid Memory, the agent remembers the initial object and selects its match at the corridor end. Correct choices receive a step-discounted reward and incorrect choices receive zero. Success rate measures the final choice; average return also reflects action efficiency.

paragraphs.zh: MiniGrid 采用网格编码，RGB 与全可观测包装器提供其他输入设置；Memory 是其中的记忆任务。MiniWorld 在三维场景中提供导航与对象交互任务，两个环境分别按环境 ID、观测包装器和步数上限组织实验。
paragraphs.en: MiniGrid uses grid encodings, with RGB and fully observable wrappers offering other inputs; Memory is one of its memory tasks. MiniWorld provides navigation and object interaction in 3D scenes. Each environment is evaluated under its own IDs, observation wrappers and step limits.

paragraphs.zh: Procgen 包含16个程序生成的视觉游戏，采用共同的像素观测与离散动作接口。CoinRun 要求越障取币，Heist 要求找钥匙开锁；各游戏内部的地图与物体配置也持续变化。
paragraphs.en: Procgen contains sixteen procedurally generated visual games with shared pixel observations and discrete actions. CoinRun involves reaching a coin past obstacles and Heist uses keys and locks; layouts and objects vary within games.

paragraphs.zh: 用于比较强化学习的样本效率与未见关卡泛化。限制训练关卡集合并设置独立测试关卡，可以研究表征学习、过拟合和训练分布多样性的作用。
paragraphs.en: It supports sample-efficiency and held-out-level generalization studies. Restricted training levels and independent test levels enable analysis of representations, overfitting and training-distribution diversity.

paragraphs.zh: 逐游戏统计训练关卡与未见测试关卡上的平均回报，再按所用协议的参考分数归一化和汇总。测试回报评价未见关卡表现，训练—测试回报差揭示对训练关卡的过拟合。
paragraphs.en: Mean return is reported separately on training and unseen test levels for each game, then normalized and aggregated using the selected protocol’s reference scores. Test return measures unseen-level performance, while the train–test gap reveals overfitting to training levels.

paragraphs.zh: 原始评测套件覆盖16个环境，后续竞赛采用独立协议。关卡划分、难度、环境版本与交互预算确定相应的实验范围。
paragraphs.en: The original suite covers sixteen environments; subsequent competitions use separate protocols. Level splits, difficulty, versions and interaction budgets define each experimental scope.

body.zh: MineDojo 在 Minecraft 中提供 Programmatic、Creative 与 Playthrough 三类任务，配套可配置的传感器、移动与制作动作，以及互联网视频、百科和社区知识资源。
body.en: MineDojo provides programmatic, creative and playthrough Minecraft tasks, configurable sensors and movement/crafting actions, alongside internet video, wiki and community knowledge resources.

body.zh: 用于研究开放式具身学习、知识迁移与技能组合。任务可以连接资源获取、工具制作和环境探索，支持分析语言知识如何转化为连续行动。
body.en: It supports open-ended embodied learning, knowledge transfer and skill composition, linking resource collection, tool crafting and exploration to study how language knowledge informs sequential action.

body.zh: Programmatic 任务依据模拟器中的资源、状态或事件计算目标完成情况。论文对所选四项 Creative 任务采用 MineCLIP 轨迹分数判定成功，并以人工成功／失败标签上的 F1 检验该自动判据；Playthrough 以击败末影龙为整局目标。
body.en: Programmatic tasks evaluate objectives from simulator resources, states or events. For four selected Creative tasks, the paper uses MineCLIP trajectory scores to classify success and checks this criterion against human success/failure labels using F1. Playthrough uses defeating the Ender Dragon as its full-game objective.

body.zh: 评测单位为所选任务及其初始世界、传感器和动作配置。任务库与知识库分别提供交互目标和外部学习材料。
body.en: Evaluation units are selected tasks with specified initial worlds, sensors and actions. The task suite and knowledge collection provide interaction objectives and external learning material, respectively.

body.zh: MineRL 数据集记录人类在 Minecraft 中完成资源采集、导航和制作任务的轨迹，包含与环境接口对齐的观测与动作。数据与配套环境支持从示范学习游戏策略。
body.en: The MineRL dataset records human Minecraft trajectories for resource gathering, navigation and crafting, with observations and actions aligned to its environment interface.

body.zh: 用于研究模仿学习、离线数据利用与样本高效强化学习。分阶段制作和稀疏目标为示范预训练、探索与策略改进提供任务背景。
body.en: It supports imitation learning, offline data use and sample-efficient RL. Crafting dependencies and sparse objectives provide settings for demonstration pretraining, exploration and policy improvement.

body.zh: 数据驱动方法通过相应环境的任务回报和目标达成情况评价；例如 Treechop 以木材采集进度计分。论文中的在线基线与示范数据统计分别报告。
body.en: Learned policies are evaluated using task returns and goal completion; Treechop, for example, measures wood collection. Online baseline results and demonstration statistics are reported separately.

body.zh: 数据集、任务环境与竞赛规则构成不同资源层级。实验范围由数据版本、训练数据量、环境任务及交互预算确定。
body.en: Dataset, task environments and competition rules are distinct resource layers. Data version, training-data volume, task selection and interaction budget define the experiment.

body.zh: BASALT 在 Minecraft 中设置寻找洞穴、建造瀑布、动物围栏和村庄房屋等开放式目标，提供自然语言任务说明和示范，任务质量由人类判断。
body.en: BASALT specifies open-ended Minecraft goals such as finding caves and constructing waterfalls, animal pens and village houses, using language descriptions, demonstrations and human assessment.

body.zh: 用于研究从人类反馈学习、偏好建模与开放式任务执行，考察智能体如何把定性目标转化为环境中的行为与作品。
body.en: It supports learning from human feedback, preference modeling and open-ended execution, examining how agents translate qualitative objectives into behavior and constructions.

body.zh: 2021 竞赛通过匹配任务与种子的成对人工偏好估计各任务 TrueSkill，再对标准化任务得分进行汇总，评价人类对完成质量的相对判断。
body.en: The 2021 competition derives task-wise TrueSkill from pairwise human preferences at matched tasks and seeds, then aggregates normalized task scores to characterize relative perceived quality.

body.zh: 2021竞赛评测开放式任务的完成质量，任务说明、示范使用方式、测试种子与人工成对比较共同构成协议。人工偏好体现任务产物和过程的相对质量。
body.en: The 2021 competition evaluates open-ended task quality under specified task descriptions, demonstration use, test seeds and paired human comparisons. Human preferences reflect the relative quality of task artifacts and behavior.

body.zh: Craftax 是基于 JAX 的程序生成生存与地下城环境。智能体采集资源、制作装备、战斗并推进楼层，任务同时涉及生存约束与多阶段成长。
body.en: Craftax is a JAX-based procedurally generated survival and dungeon environment. Agents gather resources, craft equipment, fight and traverse floors under survival and progression constraints.

body.zh: 用于研究高吞吐强化学习、探索与长期技能组合。并行环境支持在不同训练规模下比较学习效率，复杂制作链提供多阶段决策任务。
body.en: It supports high-throughput RL, exploration and long-horizon skill composition. Parallel simulation enables learning-efficiency comparisons across training scales and multistage crafting decisions.

body.zh: 扩展 Craftax 的官方成绩表将回合累计奖励除以最大值226，以百分比报告。成就达成和楼层推进用于解释奖励来自哪些制作、战斗或进展环节；Craftax-Classic 保留自己的计分版本。
body.en: The expanded Craftax leaderboard reports episode reward as a percentage of the maximum value, 226. Achievement attainment and floor progression explain which crafting, combat or progression events produced the reward; Craftax-Classic retains its own scoring version.

body.zh: Craftax 与 Craftax-Classic 是不同版本。评测配置包括任务版本、观测表示、训练步数和环境并行规模。
body.en: Craftax and Craftax-Classic are distinct variants. Evaluation configurations specify the variant, observation representation, training steps and simulation parallelism.

body.zh: NetHack Learning Environment（NLE）将 NetHack 接入标准强化学习接口，提供地图符号、角色状态、消息与物品栏等观测，并支持移动、搜索和物品操作。
body.en: The NetHack Learning Environment exposes NetHack through an RL interface with glyph maps, character statistics, messages and inventory, supporting movement, search and item interaction.

body.zh: 用于研究部分可观测决策、探索和长期策略。程序生成地牢、复杂物品机制与角色成长形成持续变化的决策过程。
body.en: It supports partial observability, exploration and long-term policies through procedural dungeons, rich item mechanics and character progression.

body.zh: Score 任务以局内游戏分数的增量形成回报，探索任务则按新发现区域给奖。逐任务汇总回合累计回报，评价策略在得分或探索目标上的表现。
body.en: The Score task rewards increments in in-game score, whereas exploration tasks reward newly discovered areas. Episodic returns are aggregated per task to evaluate performance on the respective score or exploration objective.

body.zh: NLE 是环境接口，具体协议由任务类、角色配置、观测字段、动作集与终止条件确定。完整游戏目标与专项奖励任务具有不同评价层级。
body.en: NLE is an environment interface. Task class, character configuration, observation fields, action set and termination define the protocol, with full-game objectives and targeted reward tasks forming distinct levels.

body.zh: MiniHack 利用 NetHack 引擎构造可配置的小型任务，涵盖导航、物体操作和技能组合。例如 River 任务要求推动巨石跨越河流并到达终点。
body.en: MiniHack builds configurable small tasks on the NetHack engine, spanning navigation, manipulation and skill composition. River tasks, for example, require pushing boulders to cross a river and reach a goal.

body.zh: 用于受控研究探索、空间推理与组合泛化。关卡描述和奖励接口支持调整地图、对象和行为依赖，形成不同复杂度的任务族。
body.en: It supports controlled exploration, spatial reasoning and compositional generalization through level descriptions and rewards that vary layouts, objects and action dependencies.

body.zh: 以 River 为例，成功事件是推动巨石形成过河通路并到达终点，评测据此统计成功率和终点奖励。其他关卡通过奖励管理器定义各自的事件组合，按关卡分别汇总回报。
body.en: In River, success means pushing boulders to create a crossing and reaching the goal; evaluation records success rate and terminal reward. Other levels define their event combinations through the reward manager and aggregate returns separately by level.

body.zh: 评测围绕指定关卡族、观测模式、动作空间和地图分布展开。单关卡、程序生成任务与跨任务迁移对应不同实验设置。
body.en: Evaluation specifies level families, observation modes, actions and map distributions. Fixed levels, procedural tasks and cross-task transfer define different experimental settings.

paragraphs.zh: MiniHack 利用 NetHack 引擎构造可配置的小型任务，涵盖导航、物体操作和技能组合。例如 River 任务要求推动巨石跨越河流并到达终点。
paragraphs.en: MiniHack builds configurable small tasks on the NetHack engine, spanning navigation, manipulation and skill composition. River tasks, for example, require pushing boulders to cross a river and reach a goal.

body.zh: TextWorld 是文字游戏生成与交互平台，可构造房间、物品和任务目标。智能体阅读文字反馈并提交命令，通过导航、取物和对象操作完成目标。
body.en: TextWorld generates and runs text games with rooms, objects and goals. Agents read textual feedback and submit navigation, retrieval and interaction commands.

body.zh: 用于研究语言理解、任务规划与跨游戏泛化。游戏生成参数支持控制地图规模、任务长度和对象组合，从而分析策略对环境复杂度的响应。
body.en: It supports language understanding, planning and cross-game generalization, with generation parameters controlling map size, quest length and object combinations.

body.zh: 任务成功率衡量是否达到目标，任务进度以所得分数相对于最高可达分数表示，动作次数衡量完成效率。环境分别提供分数、最高分、胜负标记与动作计数供实验汇总。
body.en: Task success measures reaching the objective; progress compares attained score with the maximum available score; move count measures completion efficiency. The environment exposes scores, maximum scores, outcome flags and move counts for aggregation.

body.zh: TextWorld 提供平台能力，任务集合、生成种子、命令接口和可用辅助信息共同构成评测协议。不同任务族采用各自的得分定义。
body.en: TextWorld supplies platform functionality; task collections, generation seeds, command interfaces and auxiliary information define evaluation protocols, with task-specific scoring.

body.zh: Jericho 为人工编写的交互小说提供统一接口。智能体从叙事文本、场景描述和物品信息中推断状态，并通过文字命令探索世界、使用物品和解决谜题。
body.en: Jericho interfaces with human-authored interactive fiction. Agents infer state from narrative, locations and inventory, then issue text commands to explore, use objects and solve puzzles.

body.zh: 用于研究自然语言动作选择、探索与知识状态维护。环境支持动作模板、状态保存和有效动作分析，便于比较不同的搜索与策略方法。
body.en: It supports language-based action selection, exploration and knowledge-state tracking, with action templates, state saving and valid-action analysis for policy and search comparisons.

body.zh: 常用评价为逐游戏得分及相对于最高分的归一化成绩，并按交互预算记录进展。游戏间差异通过分游戏结果呈现。
body.en: Common measures are per-game score and score normalized by the game maximum, with progress tracked under interaction budgets and results reported by game.

body.zh: 协议包含游戏版本、训练方式、命令候选生成和状态辅助接口。自由生成命令与环境辅助动作选择属于不同动作条件。
body.en: Protocols specify game versions, training regimes, command-candidate generation and state-access tools. Free-form commands and environment-assisted action selection use different action conditions.

body.zh: ALFWorld 将家庭操作任务的文字抽象与 ALFRED 具身环境对齐。智能体依据目标执行取放、清洁、加热、冷却和检查物体等多步操作。
body.en: ALFWorld aligns textual household-task abstractions with ALFRED embodied environments. Agents follow goals through multistep placement, cleaning, heating, cooling and examination tasks.

body.zh: 用于研究高层规划、对象状态推理和文本到具身任务的迁移。对齐的任务结构支持在抽象空间学习策略，再研究其在具身执行中的应用。
body.en: It supports high-level planning, object-state reasoning and text-to-embodied transfer. Aligned task structures enable abstract policy learning and investigation of embodied execution.

body.zh: 以任务成功率评价目标状态完成情况，并按已见与未见测试划分报告。文字轨道和具身轨道分别对应各自的输入与执行过程。
body.en: Task success measures goal-state completion on seen and unseen splits. Textual and embodied tracks use their respective observation and execution processes.

body.zh: 评测设置包括任务类型、场景划分、观测模态、动作接口和交互上限。文本命令执行与视觉低层控制构成不同实验层级。
body.en: Task types, scene splits, observation modality, action interfaces and interaction limits define evaluation, with textual commands and visual low-level control forming distinct experimental levels.

body.zh: ScienceWorld 是以基础科学实验为主题的文字交互环境。智能体在房间间寻找器材与材料，操作物体并观察变化，完成测量、分类和状态变换等任务。
body.en: ScienceWorld is a text-interaction environment for elementary science experiments. Agents locate equipment and materials, manipulate objects and observe changes to perform measurements, classifications and state transformations.

body.zh: 用于研究科学知识应用、实验规划与反馈驱动推理。任务将知识应用与一系列可执行操作联系起来，支持分析中间步骤的完成情况。
body.en: It studies scientific knowledge in action, experimental planning and feedback-driven reasoning by connecting knowledge application with executable operation sequences and intermediate goals.

body.zh: 每项科学任务把实验目标分解为可检测的对象状态和子目标，系统依据已完成步骤给出进度分数。按任务类型与变体汇总完成率或归一化进度，可区分最终目标达成和部分实验步骤完成。
body.en: Each scientific task decomposes its objective into detectable object states and subgoals, assigning progress scores to completed steps. Completion rates or normalized progress are aggregated by task type and variation, separating final success from partially completed experimental procedures.

body.zh: 评测对应具体任务变体、可用动作辅助、环境简化选项和步数预算。环境采用文字模拟的科学过程与对象状态。
body.en: Evaluation specifies task variations, action aids, simplification options and step budgets. The environment simulates scientific processes and object states textually.

body.zh: BabyAI 在网格世界中生成语言指令任务，包括到达物体、开门、拾取和按关系放置。智能体结合指令与局部符号观测执行动作，复杂关卡组合多个指令步骤。
body.en: BabyAI generates grid-world language instructions for reaching objects, opening doors, pickup and relational placement. Agents combine instructions with local symbolic observations, with complex levels composing multiple steps.

body.zh: 用于研究语言落地、组合指令学习与样本效率。平台提供任务验证器和专家策略，支持比较模仿学习与强化学习在不同指令难度上的表现。
body.en: It supports language grounding, compositional instruction learning and sample efficiency through task verifiers and expert policies for imitation-learning and RL comparisons.

body.zh: 主要指标为指令完成成功率，以及达到目标成功水平所需的示范数或训练回合数。分任务族结果体现不同语法和行为组合的学习难度。
body.en: Measures include instruction success and demonstrations or episodes needed to reach a target success level. Task-family results characterize the difficulty of language and behavioral compositions.

body.zh: 任务采用程序生成的语言与网格环境。关卡族、语言组合、观测包装器及训练测试划分定义实验条件。
body.en: Tasks use procedurally generated language and grid environments. Level families, language compositions, observation wrappers and train/test splits define the experimental conditions.

body.zh: Hanabi Challenge 采用合作式不完全信息纸牌游戏。玩家可看到伙伴手牌，却看不到自己的手牌，需要通过有限提示以及出牌、弃牌共同完成按颜色和数字递增的烟花序列。
body.en: The Hanabi Challenge uses a cooperative imperfect-information card game. Players see teammates’ cards rather than their own and use limited hints, plays and discards to build increasing colored sequences.

body.zh: 用于研究隐含信息推理、沟通约定和伙伴适应。有限提示资源与共同回报使行为选择同时承担行动和传递信息的作用。
body.en: It supports hidden-information reasoning, communication conventions and partner adaptation, as limited hints and shared rewards give actions both instrumental and informational roles.

body.zh: 以团队终局烟花得分评价共同目标，标准五色规则的最高分为25。自博弈使用共同训练的伙伴；交叉对战把独立训练策略配成队伍，以得分衡量约定能否互相兼容。
body.en: The team’s final firework score measures its shared objective, with a maximum of 25 under standard five-color rules. Self-play uses jointly trained partners; cross-play teams independently trained policies and uses score to measure convention compatibility.

body.zh: 协议由玩家数量、牌组配置、观测编码、提示规则和伙伴分布确定，训练伙伴与评测伙伴的关系构成重要的实验维度。
body.en: Protocols specify player count, decks, observation encoding, hint rules and partner populations. The relationship between training and evaluation partners is a central experimental dimension.

body.zh: Google Research Football 提供完整足球比赛与 Football Academy 局部场景。智能体控制球员移动、传球和射门，可采用像素、特征平面或结构化状态等观测。
body.en: Google Research Football provides full matches and Football Academy scenarios. Agents move players, pass and shoot using pixel, feature-plane or structured observations.

body.zh: 用于研究视觉控制、稀疏奖励学习和多智能体团队配合。局部场景聚焦进攻或控球技能，完整比赛考察更长时间尺度的策略组合。
body.en: It supports visual control, sparse-reward learning and team coordination. Academy scenarios target local attacking or possession skills, while matches combine strategies over longer horizons.

body.zh: 完整比赛按比分差和胜负评价；Academy 场景按进球等场景目标统计回报或成功。scoring 奖励对应比分变化，checkpoint 奖励另为推进球的位置提供训练信号，两种奖励配置分别报告。
body.en: Full matches use score difference and match outcomes, while Academy scenarios report return or success on objectives such as scoring a goal. Scoring rewards follow score changes; checkpoint rewards additionally shape ball advancement, and results retain the reward configuration.

body.zh: 实验配置包含场景、对手难度、受控球员数量、观测表示和奖励模式。完整比赛与 Academy 场景分别形成评测单元。
body.en: Configurations specify scenarios, opponent difficulty, controlled-player counts, observations and rewards. Full matches and Academy scenarios form separate evaluation units.

paragraphs.en: Configurations specify scenarios, opponent difficulty, controlled-player counts, observations and rewards. Full matches and Academy scenarios form separate evaluation units.

body.zh: OpenSpiel 汇集不同玩家数量、信息结构和交互形式的游戏，提供状态、信息状态、合法动作及回报接口，并配套搜索与学习算法。
body.en: OpenSpiel collects games with varied player counts, information structures and interaction forms, exposing states, information states, legal actions and returns alongside search and learning algorithms.

body.zh: 用于研究博弈求解、强化学习、搜索规划及不完全信息决策。统一接口便于在不同规则下比较算法与分析学习动态。
body.en: It supports game solving, RL, search, planning and imperfect-information decisions. Shared interfaces enable algorithm comparisons and analysis of learning dynamics across rules.

body.zh: 指标随游戏与问题定义变化，包括对局回报、胜率及适用设置下的 exploitability 或 NashConv；后两者衡量策略与均衡的偏离。
body.en: Metrics are game- and problem-dependent, including returns, win rates and, where applicable, exploitability or NashConv to characterize deviation from equilibrium.

body.zh: OpenSpiel 是研究平台，具体评测由游戏、规则参数、玩家信息、对手和算法预算定义。平台同时覆盖合作、竞争及混合收益设置。
body.en: OpenSpiel is a research platform. Games, rule parameters, player information, opponents and algorithm budgets define each evaluation across cooperative, competitive and mixed-payoff settings.

body.zh: RLCard 为 Blackjack、Leduc Hold’em、斗地主等牌类游戏提供强化学习接口，包含状态编码、合法动作、回报及示例策略。智能体从可观察牌局信息中选择行动。
body.en: RLCard provides RL interfaces for games such as Blackjack, Leduc Hold’em and Dou Dizhu, with state encodings, legal actions, payoffs and example policies for acting on observable card-game information.

body.zh: 用于研究不完全信息决策、自博弈与牌类策略学习。不同游戏的牌组规模、动作数量和玩家结构提供可控的复杂度差异。
body.en: It supports imperfect-information decisions, self-play and card-game policies, varying deck size, action spaces and player structure to provide different complexity levels.

body.zh: 按具体游戏报告回报、胜率或对固定基线的平均收益；例如 Leduc 的净收益采用对应下注单位计算。重复对局统计策略表现。
body.en: Evaluation uses game-specific returns, win rates or average payoffs against fixed baselines; Leduc payoffs follow its betting units. Repeated games characterize policy performance.

body.zh: 协议包含游戏 ID、状态表示、合法动作处理、对手策略和评估局数。各游戏采用独立的规则与收益定义。
body.en: Protocols specify game IDs, state representations, legal-action handling, opponents and evaluation episodes. Each game retains its own rules and payoff definitions.

body.zh: Melting Pot 在一组多智能体游戏中构造合作、竞争和混合动机的社会互动。智能体依据局部视觉行动，例如在 Clean Up 中分配资源采集与河流清理行为。
body.en: Melting Pot constructs cooperative, competitive and mixed-motive interactions across multi-agent games. Agents act from local vision, for example allocating harvesting and river-cleaning behavior in Clean Up.

body.zh: 用于研究社会互动泛化与陌生群体适应。训练和测试伙伴群体的变化支持分析策略对不同约定、合作方式和竞争行为的响应。
body.en: It supports social generalization and adaptation to unfamiliar populations. Changes in training and test partners expose responses to varied conventions, cooperation and competition.

body.zh: 测试场景通过焦点群体的人均累计回报评价表现，背景智能体用于构造互动条件。分场景结果呈现策略在不同群体中的收益。
body.en: Scenarios evaluate focal per-capita return, with background agents constructing the interaction setting. Scenario-wise results characterize returns across partner populations.

body.zh: 每个 substrate 定义地图、物体和收益规则，scenario 再指定焦点玩家与背景策略的组合。测试群体的构成及其与训练群体的关系，决定社会泛化实验的评价范围。
body.en: A substrate defines maps, objects and payoff rules; a scenario specifies focal-player and background-policy combinations. Test-population composition and its relationship to training populations determine the scope of social-generalization evaluation.

body.zh: Memory Gym 提供 Mortar Mayhem、Mystery Path 和 Searing Spotlights 等二维视觉任务。智能体记住短暂指令、路径或危险区域，并在后续步骤据此控制移动。
body.en: Memory Gym provides 2D visual tasks including Mortar Mayhem, Mystery Path and Searing Spotlights. Agents retain transient instructions, paths or hazards to guide subsequent movement.

body.zh: 用于研究记忆保持、序列执行与历史信息利用。任务参数控制指令长度、可见性和运动条件，支持比较循环网络与其他记忆策略。
body.en: It supports retention, sequence execution and history use through configurable instruction length, visibility and movement, enabling recurrent and other memory-policy comparisons.

body.zh: Mortar Mayhem 统计指令执行比例和整段序列完成情况；Mystery Path 统计能否沿记忆路径到达目标；Searing Spotlights 记录硬币回报、逃脱和存活表现。三项任务分别随记忆负荷配置汇总。
body.en: Mortar Mayhem measures command accuracy and complete-sequence success; Mystery Path measures reaching the goal along a remembered path; Searing Spotlights records coin return, escape and survival. Results are aggregated separately for each task and memory-load setting.

body.zh: 原始评测采用有限任务，Endless 是后续的无限序列变体。环境 ID、可见性、控制方式与序列长度分别定义记忆保持和执行条件。
body.en: The original evaluation uses finite tasks; Endless is a later unbounded-sequence variant. Environment IDs, visibility, controls and sequence lengths define retention and execution conditions.

body.zh: POPGym 汇集部分可观测的牌类、迷宫、控制与诊断任务，提供统一的 Gymnasium 接口。例如 Concentration 要求利用先前翻开的牌位寻找配对。
body.en: POPGym collects partially observable card, maze, control and diagnostic tasks under Gymnasium interfaces. Concentration, for example, requires remembering previously revealed card positions to find matches.

body.zh: 用于比较深度强化学习中的记忆模型。任务对时间顺序、噪声和历史长度的不同需求，支持分析模型保存与更新信息的方式。
body.en: It compares memory models in deep RL. Tasks vary temporal-ordering demands, noise and history length to study information retention and updating.

body.zh: Concentration 的每回合累计回报综合配对收益与无效尝试：匹配获得归一化正奖励，失败或重复翻开已揭示牌受到惩罚。套件按环境和难度分别汇总回报，比较不同记忆模型的表现。
body.en: Concentration’s episode return combines matching gains and ineffective attempts: matches receive normalized rewards, while failures or choosing already-revealed cards incur penalties. Suite returns are aggregated by environment and difficulty to compare memory models.

body.zh: 评测对象是原始 POPGym 任务集合；POPGym Arcade 是另一个扩展项目。环境、难度、包装器与训练预算定义具体配置。
body.en: Evaluation concerns the original POPGym collection; POPGym Arcade is a separate extension. Environment, difficulty, wrappers and training budget define each configuration.

body.zh: bsuite 通过一组小型受控实验诊断强化学习智能体。任务覆盖延迟信息回忆、奖励噪声与尺度变化，以及 Deep Sea 等需要连续探索选择的环境。
body.en: bsuite diagnoses RL agents through small controlled experiments, including delayed recall, reward noise and scale changes, and environments such as Deep Sea requiring coordinated exploratory choices.

body.zh: 用于分析算法的探索、记忆、学习效率和对实验条件的敏感性。每组实验改变特定因素，便于将总体表现分解为可解释的行为特征。
body.en: It analyzes exploration, memory, learning efficiency and sensitivity to experimental conditions. Controlled factors expose interpretable behavioral characteristics of algorithms.

body.zh: 各实验保留自己的诊断量：Memory Length 在10,000回合后记录平均 regret，Deep Sea 记录探索中的 regret 并与随机探索时间参照比较。套件将这些量转换为分析分数，按实验族呈现行为画像。
body.en: Experiments retain distinct diagnostics: Memory Length records average regret after 10,000 episodes, while Deep Sea records exploration regret and compares against a random-exploration-time reference. These quantities are converted to analysis scores and shown by experiment family.

body.zh: 评测由实验族、具体配置和运行预算定义，重点是算法在受控任务中的行为诊断。单比特记忆与多步探索分别对应独立实验。
body.en: Experiment families, configurations and budgets define evaluation. The focus is behavioral diagnosis in controlled tasks, with single-bit memory and multistep exploration assessed separately.

body.zh: Alchemy 是具有隐含结构的元强化学习环境。智能体操作石块与药水，通过尝试变换推断当前规则，并将石块转化为更有价值的状态。
body.en: Alchemy is a structured meta-RL environment. Agents manipulate stones and potions, experiment with transformations to infer current rules and produce more valuable stone states.

body.zh: 用于研究潜在状态推断、主动实验与快速适应。一个 episode 内多个 trial 共享规则，使早期探索获得的信息能够影响后续决策。
body.en: It supports latent-state inference, active experimentation and rapid adaptation. Trials within an episode share rules, allowing information gathered early to guide later decisions.

body.zh: 智能体把石块投入坩埚获得与石块状态对应的奖励，按 trial 和完整 episode 累计回报。共享规则下后续 trial 的收益变化反映此前实验信息如何被用于选药水和转化石块。
body.en: Depositing stones in the cauldron yields rewards determined by stone state, accumulated per trial and episode. Return changes in later trials under shared rules show how earlier experiments inform potion choice and stone transformation.

body.zh: 任务分布定义规则、感知映射与结构变化，实验可采用视觉环境或符号接口。观测形式、规则分布与 trial 预算构成评测条件。
body.en: Task distributions specify rules, perceptual mappings and structural variation. Visual and symbolic interfaces, rule distributions and trial budgets define evaluation conditions.

body.zh: 474个可执行推理游戏要求模型只凭规则，向隐藏配置发起结构化查询，再依据反馈提交答案；五档难度形成2370个配置实例。
body.en: Across 474 executable reasoning games, models receive rules, query hidden configurations and submit answers; five difficulty levels yield 2,370 configurations.

body.zh: 研究将推理拆成主动取证、信念更新与停止决策，并以集合、序列、树和图结构组织任务，另设上下文扰动及反事实修订。
body.en: The framework studies evidence acquisition, belief updates and stopping decisions across set, sequence, tree and graph structures, with contextual perturbations and counterfactual revision.

body.zh: 成功率衡量最终答案正确性，成功回合平均轮数衡量达成答案所需的交互成本，格式错误与超时另行统计。模型比较采用匹配的搜索空间和查询预算。
body.en: Success rate measures final-answer correctness, while mean turns on successful episodes measure the interaction cost of reaching an answer; formatting errors and timeouts are counted separately. Model comparisons match search spaces and query budgets.

body.zh: 同一规则游戏通过五档搜索空间生成不同难度实例。上下文扰动与反事实修订形成额外测试条件，结果按规则结构、难度及交互预算组织比较。

body.zh: AI GameStore以应用商店与Steam游戏为灵感，通过模型编写和人工参与修订，生成100款可容器化小游戏，玩家读取画面并输出键盘操作。
body.en: AI GameStore synthesizes 100 containerized games inspired by App Store and Steam titles, using model-generated code and human refinement; players act through visual keyboard interaction.

body.zh: 平台研究如何持续扩展贴近人类游戏的评测空间，以统一短时交互比较七种视觉语言模型，并提供人类游玩分数作为参照。
body.en: The platform explores scalable evaluation through human-oriented games, comparing seven VLMs under short-play interaction with human performance references.

body.zh: 以人类归一化游戏分数评价表现，跨游戏报告中位数和几何均值。每游戏运行三次，最多120次调用或120秒游戏时间；每秒暂停后，模型给出五段各0.2秒的键盘动作。
body.en: Human-normalized game scores measure performance, aggregated across games by median and geometric mean. Three runs per game allow at most 120 calls or game seconds; after each second, play pauses for five 0.2-second keyboard-action segments.

body.zh: 评测使用100个生成改编实现及其人类参照分数，商业游戏提供设计灵感；认知需求标注用于描述各小游戏的综合任务要求。

body.zh: GameWorld提供34款浏览器游戏和170项任务，模型从画面与近期动作记录选择操作，系统以游戏内部状态验证目标是否达成。
body.en: GameWorld contains 34 browser games and 170 tasks, connecting visual observations and recent action history to objectives verified from internal game state.

body.zh: 研究统一两类接口：直接键鼠控制，以及由确定性解析器执行的语义动作；借此比较不同模型接口组合并分析延迟、记忆与动作有效性。
body.en: The benchmark standardizes direct keyboard/mouse control and semantic actions executed by a deterministic parser, enabling interface comparisons and studies of latency, memory and validity.

body.zh: 状态验证成功率衡量目标达成比例，最大归一化进度衡量单局最远进展。资源采集克隆和 Flappy Bird 协议均采用100动作预算，并分别比较直接键鼠与语义动作接口。
body.en: State-verified success rate measures objective completion, while maximum normalized progress measures the furthest progress in an episode. The resource-collection clone and Flappy Bird protocols use 100-action budgets and compare direct keyboard/mouse with semantic-action interfaces separately.

body.zh: 套件涵盖34款浏览器游戏和170项任务，资源采集克隆与 Flappy Bird 分别提供资源目标和得分目标实例。推理暂停与实时条件采用不同环境计时方式，各接口和时长条件对应各自结果。
body.en: The suite contains 34 browser games and 170 tasks; the resource-collection clone and Flappy Bird provide resource-objective and score-objective examples. Paused-inference and real-time conditions use different environment timing, with results tied to their interface and duration settings.

body.zh: OmniGameArena以Unreal Engine 5新建12款游戏，覆盖七个单人、三个对抗和两个合作环境，统一画面、时间戳、历史与分段键鼠动作接口。
body.en: OmniGameArena builds 12 UE5 games: seven solo, three competitive and two cooperative, sharing visual, timestamp, history and chunked keyboard/mouse interfaces.

body.zh: 除首次尝试表现外，研究引入改进动态曲线，由反思模型在多轮中修改有界技能提示，并考察技能在留出任务变体上的效果。
body.en: Beyond cold-start performance, Improvement Dynamics Curves track reflection-driven revisions to bounded skill prompts and their behavior on held-out task variants.

body.zh: 各任务把路线进度、生存时长、有效伤害、触发器完成或交付价值按目标量归一化；对抗场景还采用己方或核心剩余生命。首次尝试分数与逐轮反思后的分数分开报告，改进动态曲线刻画随反思轮次的变化。
body.en: Tasks normalize route progress, survival duration, effective damage, activated triggers or delivered value by their target quantities; competitive settings also use own or core remaining health. Cold-start and post-reflection scores are separate, with Improvement Dynamics Curves tracing changes across reflection rounds.

body.zh: 七个单人、三个对抗和两个合作场景共享观测与动作框架，保留各自目标函数。留出任务变体用于检验技能提示修订的迁移，反思产生的提示文本构成每轮可转移的经验产物。
body.en: Seven solo, three competitive and two cooperative settings share observation/action infrastructure while retaining task-specific objectives. Held-out variants test transfer of revised skill prompts, whose text constitutes the experience artifact passed between reflection rounds.

body.zh: Game-RL通过Code2Logic改写游戏代码，生成具有可验证答案与可控难度的多模态推理题；GameQA覆盖30款来源游戏和158类任务。
body.en: Game-RL uses Code2Logic to transform game code into multimodal reasoning questions with verifiable answers and controlled difficulty; GameQA spans 30 source games and 158 tasks.

body.zh: 研究把丰富的游戏视觉元素与规则作为强化学习训练资源，训练视觉语言模型，并观察游戏推理数据对通用视觉语言推理的迁移价值。
body.en: The work uses game visuals and mechanics as reinforcement-learning data for VLMs and investigates transfer from game-derived reasoning to general multimodal reasoning.

body.zh: 首先用游戏代码产生的可验证答案检查 GameQA 问答，再比较使用这些数据训练的模型在七个域外视觉语言基准上的表现。游戏种类与数据规模消融用于分析迁移效果随训练数据构成的变化。
body.en: Game-code-derived verifiable answers check GameQA responses, while seven out-of-domain vision-language benchmarks evaluate models trained on the data. Ablations vary game diversity and data volume to analyze how training-data composition affects transfer.

body.zh: GameQA 的30款来源游戏被转换为158类视觉推理任务，模型产出是题目答案。论文研究的是游戏衍生数据训练与域外迁移，训练游戏、数据规模和外部测试集分别构成实验维度。
body.en: GameQA converts 30 source games into 158 visual-reasoning task types, with answers as model outputs. The work studies game-derived training data and out-of-domain transfer, varying source games, data volume and external test sets.

body.zh: GameBoyWorlds研究智能体能否从自身游玩中学习，包含Execution局部执行和Playthrough整局探索；Execution跨五个系列设置500项测试任务。
body.en: GameBoyWorlds studies learning from self-directed play through Execution and Playthrough tracks; Execution includes 500 localized tasks across five game series.

body.zh: 智能体先在专用训练游戏探索，无示范、文档或奖励，再把获得的操作知识用于未见游戏；研究比较世界建模、技能发现和探索写作指南等方法。
body.en: Agents explore dedicated training games without demonstrations, documentation or rewards, then transfer knowledge to unseen games; approaches include world models, skill discovery and written guides.

body.zh: Execution 以任务完成率计分，由指定画面区域与参考成功画面的匹配判定完成，并在500项任务上汇总。从固定存档开始的局部执行最多允许75次执行器响应；Playthrough 另评价整局探索推进。
body.en: Execution scores task completion using designated screen-region matches against reference success screens and aggregates over 500 tasks. Local execution starts from fixed saves with at most 75 executor responses; Playthrough separately evaluates full-game exploration progress.

body.zh: Execution的500任务衡量局部导航和机制操作；Playthrough另以两款同人宝可梦研究整局推进，两条轨道具有各自的初始状态与目标。
body.en: Execution measures 500 local navigation/mechanics tasks; Playthrough separately studies full progression in two fan-made Pokémon games.

body.zh: lmgame-Bench 将平台跳跃、解谜和叙事游戏接入统一接口。模型读取图像或感知模块生成的符号状态，输出游戏操作；轻量感知与记忆模块为长序列决策提供辅助。
body.en: lmgame-Bench connects platforming, puzzle and narrative games through a common interface. Models read images or symbolic states produced by a perception module and output game actions, with lightweight perception and memory modules supporting sequential decisions.

body.zh: 用于比较游戏表现与语言、数学、编码、物理和视觉基准之间的关联，并分析感知、记忆模块的影响。训练实验进一步研究在简化 Sokoban 或 Tetris 上强化学习后的跨游戏与规划迁移。
body.en: It studies associations between game performance and language, math, coding, physics and vision benchmarks, alongside perception/memory-module effects. Training experiments investigate cross-game and planning transfer after RL on simplified Sokoban or Tetris.

body.zh: 游戏分别采用目标完成或游戏分数，并按重复运行汇总。Sokoban 实例比较推箱目标的完成分数，在图像或符号感知、有无辅助模块等条件下报告三次运行均值；训练迁移实验另用其目标基准成绩评价。
body.en: Games use objective completion or game score, aggregated over repeated runs. Sokoban reports mean completion-based scores over three runs under image/symbolic perception and module conditions; training-transfer experiments use scores on their destination benchmarks.

body.zh: 主评测的 Sokoban 比较图像输入与符号感知辅助下的推箱表现；强化学习迁移实验使用简化 Sokoban 和 Tetris，并测试更大棋盘、其他游戏与外部规划任务。两类实验分别采用自己的关卡、提示和动作预算。
body.en: Main-evaluation Sokoban compares image input with symbolic-perception support. RL-transfer experiments train on simplified Sokoban and Tetris and test larger boards, other games and external planning tasks. Each study retains its own levels, prompts and action budgets.

body.zh: Orak为12款主流电子游戏提供训练与评测框架，通过可插拔接口连接游戏状态、动作工具和模型，并发布专家模型游玩轨迹用于微调。
body.en: Orak provides training and evaluation across 12 popular videogames through pluggable state/action interfaces and releases expert LLM trajectories for fine-tuning.

body.zh: 用于研究感知模态、记忆、规划和反思模块如何影响同一游戏任务，以及专家轨迹微调能否改善执行。跨游戏比较保留各游戏的动作抽象，StarCraft II 等完整对局还支持策略模块分析。
body.en: It studies how perception modality, memory, planning and reflection affect a fixed game task, and whether expert-trajectory fine-tuning improves execution. Cross-game comparisons retain game-specific action abstractions; full matches such as StarCraft II also support strategic-module studies.

body.zh: Minecraft 制作任务以八项目标的完成比例计分，StarCraft II 整局任务以对内置 AI 的胜率计分。前者通过 JavaScript 技能执行制作，后者通过高层动作字典执行运营与战斗；结果逐游戏汇总。
body.en: Minecraft crafting is scored by completion across eight targets, while full-game StarCraft II uses win rate against built-in AI. The former executes JavaScript skills and the latter uses a high-level action dictionary for economy and combat; results are aggregated per game.

body.zh: 十二游戏共享工具调用框架，逐游戏定义状态工具、控制接口和评分。Minecraft 制作链体现工具化资源操作，StarCraft II 整局运营体现高层策略，其他游戏按各自目标和控制粒度组织实验。
body.en: The twelve games share a tool-calling framework but define game-specific state tools, controls and scores. Minecraft crafting illustrates tool-mediated resource operations, StarCraft II illustrates high-level strategy, and other games retain their own objectives and action granularity.

body.zh: GAMEBoT让语言模型在八种规则游戏中对战，读取游戏状态、规则和预设策略问题，先回答中间子问题，再生成可以执行的落子或动作。
body.en: GAMEBoT evaluates model-versus-model play across eight rule-based games, supplying state, rules and strategy subquestions before executable moves.

body.zh: 研究以可检查的中间步骤增强推理评测透明度，将最终博弈表现与过程问题表现并列分析，观察模型能否把推导转化为有效行动。
body.en: The benchmark makes intermediate reasoning assessable and compares these diagnostics with final game outcomes, testing the connection between subproblem answers and actions.

body.zh: 终局奖励归一化后汇总对战表现，并另报胜平负与中间策略问题的准确率或 F1。每模型对进行20局、双方各先手十局；4096词元输出上限定义中间推理与行动回答预算。
body.en: Normalized terminal rewards summarize match performance, alongside win/draw/loss and accuracy or F1 on intermediate strategy questions. Each model pair plays 20 games with ten starts per side; a 4,096-token limit bounds reasoning and action responses.

body.zh: 八游戏共同比赛协议与中间问题诊断并列呈现；策略提示、先手平衡及自定义游戏实现界定结果的语境。
body.en: The eight-game competition protocol accompanies intermediate-question diagnostics, under specified strategy prompts, seat balance and custom game implementations.

body.zh: AgentBench在八类交互环境中评估模型作为智能体的决策，其中Aquawar数字卡牌要求四鱼队伍选择攻击与技能，第二阶段还需猜测隐藏身份。
body.en: AgentBench evaluates agents across eight interactive environments; its Aquawar card-game component uses four-fish teams, attacks and skills, with hidden-identity guesses in stage two.

body.zh: 整体研究分析多轮推理、决策和指令遵循；卡牌子任务把文本规则、当前存活状态、已揭示身份和敌方反馈接入闭环对战。
body.en: The broader study examines multi-turn reasoning, decisions and instruction following. Aquawar combines textual rules, live-team state, revealed identities and enemy feedback in closed-loop battles.

body.zh: Aquawar 以胜率衡量取胜、以伤害率记录战斗进展，阶段得分为0.7×胜率＋0.3×伤害率，再汇总两个阶段。实验对照随机与贪心策略；格式重试耗尽后计负。
body.en: Aquawar measures victory through win rate and combat progress through damage rate. Stage score is 0.7 × win rate + 0.3 × damage rate, aggregated across two stages. Random and greedy policies serve as baselines; exhausted format retries count as losses.

body.zh: Aquawar是八环境AgentBench中的数字卡牌子任务，包含公开战斗与隐藏身份阶段，综合胜率和伤害率评价队伍决策。
body.en: Aquawar is the digital-card component of eight-environment AgentBench, combining open combat and hidden-identity stages with win/damage scoring.

body.zh: LMAct把专家交互轨迹作为长上下文示范，覆盖井字棋、象棋、Atari、网格导航、填字与模拟猎豹控制，比较模型能否在上下文中模仿决策。
body.en: LMAct supplies expert trajectories as long-context demonstrations across tic-tac-toe, chess, Atari, grid navigation, crosswords and simulated cheetah control.

body.zh: 研究逐步增加示范数量至512个完整回合，并比较文字或图像编码与思维链提示，检验长上下文容量是否真正带来更好的交互策略。
body.en: The work increases demonstrations up to 512 episodes and varies textual/image encodings and chain-of-thought prompting to examine whether context capacity improves policies.

body.zh: 各环境按自身回报或成功标准比较示范数量和输入表示。象棋实例对弱化 Stockfish 16 运行100局、每局最多100步，以胜／和／负的1／0／−1奖励汇总，并单独统计被随机替代的非法着法。
body.en: Each environment uses its own return or success measure to compare demonstration counts and input representations. The chess example plays 100 games against weakened Stockfish 16 with at most 100 moves, aggregates rewards of 1/0/−1 for win/draw/loss, and separately counts illegal moves replaced at random.

body.zh: 象棋只是六类环境中的一个子协议，采用不同示范与测试初局，并分别考察ASCII、FEN、PGN和RGB表示及上下文容量。
body.en: Chess is one of six environment families, separating demonstration/test starts and comparing ASCII, FEN, PGN, RGB and context capacity.

body.zh: SmartPlay由六种游戏构成，包括石头剪刀布、汉诺塔与Minecraft，以多种设置和环境变化组织语言智能体的交互评测。
body.en: SmartPlay comprises six games, including rock-paper-scissors, Tower of Hanoi and Minecraft, with multiple settings and environment variations for language agents.

body.zh: 研究通过游戏之间不同的任务需求分析规划、空间关系、历史学习和随机性处理；共同方法是把规则、文字状态与行动反馈连接起来。
body.en: Its methodology compares differing game demands involving planning, spatial relations, learning from history and randomness through textual rules, state and feedback.

body.zh: 按游戏目标分别计分：汉诺塔记录是否完成盘子转移，双臂老虎机记录累计奖励，Minecraft 记录到达指定生物群系的成功率。Minecraft 论文实验采用200步预算和20次试验，目标由手写控制器执行导航。
body.en: Scores follow each objective: completing disk transfers in Tower of Hanoi, cumulative reward in the two-armed bandit and success in reaching a specified Minecraft biome. The paper’s Minecraft setup uses 200 steps and 20 trials, with a hand-written controller executing navigation.

body.zh: 六游戏共同构成SmartPlay的方法框架；Minecraft例子聚焦由手写控制器执行的目标生物群系导航，老虎机与汉诺塔则有不同目标。
body.en: SmartPlay's six games define its methodology; the Minecraft example targets biome navigation through a hand-coded controller, alongside distinct bandit and Hanoi goals.

body.zh: Alem在Craftax式生存世界中程序化生成协调任务，包含同步采矿、限时交接、合作建造与战斗，队伍还需探索、制作和交换资源。
body.en: Alem procedurally generates coordination tasks in a Craftax-like survival world, including synchronized mining, timed handovers, cooperative construction and combat.

body.zh: 研究通过软角色分工、通信与可控协调难度，区分个体完成基础任务和团队执行共同计划；零样本文字模型与训练过的多智能体强化学习作参照。
body.en: Soft specialization, communication and controlled coordination difficulty separate base competence from shared-plan execution, comparing zero-shot language teams with trained MARL references.

body.zh: Base% 汇总基础任务表现，Coord.% 汇总专门的协调收益，Total% 给出整体归一化成绩，并报告置信区间。三项结果把个人生存制作和团队同步、交接等额外协调需求分开呈现。
body.en: Base% aggregates base-task performance, Coord.% aggregates coordination-specific gains, and Total% reports overall normalized performance, with confidence intervals. These results distinguish individual survival/crafting from additional synchronization and hand-off demands.

body.zh: 局部地图、物品和队友消息构成观测，含通信的60种离散动作构成控制接口。固定种子、任务难度和八步历史条件下，对比零样本文字模型与训练后的多智能体强化学习策略。
body.en: Observations combine local maps, inventories and teammate messages; 60 discrete actions include communication. Fixed seeds, task difficulty and eight-step history define comparisons between zero-shot language models and trained multi-agent RL policies.

body.zh: EMemBench从智能体实际交互生成个体化轨迹，再由程序化模板提出可核验的情景记忆问题，覆盖文字游戏和视觉游戏。
body.en: EMemBench generates personalized trajectories through interaction and derives verifiable episodic-memory questions using programmatic templates in text and visual games.

body.zh: 研究包含单跳与多跳回忆、归纳、时间、空间、逻辑和对抗问题，以环境底层信号计算答案并控制可回答性，减少固定题库的局限。
body.en: Templates cover single/multi-hop recall, induction, temporal, spatial, logical and adversarial questions, deriving ground truth and answerability from environment signals.

body.zh: 准确率评价经历相关问题的答案正确性，F1 衡量模型对“可回答／不可回答”的校准，分别汇总七类问题。自体验测试使用各方法自己的轨迹，受控暴露测试使用共同日志，从而比较记忆机制和证据读取条件。
body.en: Accuracy measures correctness on experience-grounded questions; F1 measures calibration of answerable versus unanswerable questions, aggregated across seven categories. Self-experience evaluation uses each method’s own trajectory, whereas controlled exposure uses a common log to compare memory mechanisms and evidence access.

body.zh: 评测以15种文字游戏和视觉游戏中的轨迹作为记忆材料，最终输出为记忆问答。持久记忆智能体、长上下文基线以及人类开卷／闭卷研究分别提供存储检索和证据可用性的比较。
body.en: Trajectories from 15 text games and visual games provide memory evidence, and the final outputs are QA answers. Persistent-memory agents, long-context baselines and human open-/closed-book studies provide comparisons of storage/retrieval and evidence availability.

paragraphs.en: EMemBench generates personalized trajectories through interaction and derives verifiable episodic-memory questions using programmatic templates in text and visual games.

paragraphs.zh: 研究包含单跳与多跳回忆、归纳、时间、空间、逻辑和对抗问题，以环境底层信号计算答案并控制可回答性，减少固定题库的局限。
paragraphs.en: Templates cover single/multi-hop recall, induction, temporal, spatial, logical and adversarial questions, deriving ground truth and answerability from environment signals.

paragraphs.zh: 准确率评价经历相关问题的答案正确性，F1 衡量模型对“可回答／不可回答”的校准，分别汇总七类问题。自体验测试使用各方法自己的轨迹，受控暴露测试使用共同日志，从而比较记忆机制和证据读取条件。
paragraphs.en: Accuracy measures correctness on experience-grounded questions; F1 measures calibration of answerable versus unanswerable questions, aggregated across seven categories. Self-experience evaluation uses each method’s own trajectory, whereas controlled exposure uses a common log to compare memory mechanisms and evidence access.

paragraphs.zh: 评测以15种文字游戏和视觉游戏中的轨迹作为记忆材料，最终输出为记忆问答。持久记忆智能体、长上下文基线以及人类开卷／闭卷研究分别提供存储检索和证据可用性的比较。
paragraphs.en: Trajectories from 15 text games and visual games provide memory evidence, and the final outputs are QA answers. Persistent-memory agents, long-context baselines and human open-/closed-book studies provide comparisons of storage/retrieval and evidence availability.

body.zh: MineExplorer在Minecraft中设置隐含一至四跳前置依赖，智能体需从指令和环境发现路径，再通过移动、采集、制作、放置与攻击完成目标。
body.en: MineExplorer constructs Minecraft tasks with implicit one-to-four-hop prerequisites, requiring agents to infer dependencies and act through movement, collection, crafting, placement and attacks.

body.zh: 用于研究智能体能否从环境反馈发现未明示的前置条件，并协调多跳依赖。按依赖深度比较终点成功和里程碑进展，可分析失败集中在依赖发现还是后续执行。
body.en: It studies whether agents discover unstated prerequisites from environmental feedback and coordinate multihop dependencies. Comparing final success with milestone progress across dependency depths helps locate failures in prerequisite discovery versus later execution.

body.zh: 最终目标成功率 TSR 衡量完整任务达成，里程碑平均完成比例 MSR 衡量部分依赖链进展。二者按一至四跳任务分别汇总，用于区分成功抵达终点与只完成部分前置条件。
body.en: Final-task success rate (TSR) measures complete objective attainment; mean milestone completion (MSR) measures partial prerequisite-chain progress. Results by one-to-four-hop depth distinguish reaching the final goal from completing only some prerequisites.

body.zh: 任务实例由前置依赖图和规则里程碑定义，依赖深度为一至四跳。论文交互协议最多300步、每步0.1秒，并保留至多20个历史画面，形成短时动作窗口内的依赖探索测试。
body.en: Task instances are defined by prerequisite graphs and rule-based milestones at depths of one to four hops. The paper’s protocol permits 300 steps of 0.1 seconds and at most 20 history frames, testing dependency discovery within a short action window.

body.zh: MirrorCraft把同一Minecraft世界复制为原版与隐藏规则修改版，比较铁甲、钻石和附魔三条进展任务；地形、出生点与资源位置逐对匹配。
body.en: MirrorCraft pairs vanilla Minecraft worlds with copies containing hidden rule changes, evaluating Iron Armor, Diamond and Enchantment progression under matched terrain, spawn and resources.

body.zh: 研究通过六组服务端规则干预，考察熟悉配方与掉落变化后智能体如何利用行动反馈；十个原版世界分布于五种受控生物群系。
body.en: Six server-side rule suites test adaptation when familiar recipes or drops change, using ten vanilla worlds across five controlled biomes.

body.zh: 服务器里程碑给出任务成功率和最深进展；成对 RIE 汇总规则干预版相对匹配原版世界的表现差。铁甲、钻石和附魔任务分别使用50、50、75次高层技能动作预算。
body.en: Server milestones determine success rate and deepest progress; paired RIE summarizes performance differences between intervened and matched vanilla worlds. Iron-armor, diamond and enchantment tasks use budgets of 50, 50 and 75 high-level skill actions, respectively.

body.zh: 成对比较保留匹配世界与动作预算，RIE汇总规则改变后的表现差；不同规则可同时影响知识适用性、资源路线和里程碑进展。
body.en: Paired comparisons match worlds and budgets; RIE summarizes changes that can involve knowledge applicability, resource routes and milestone progression.

body.zh: TickingCollabBench在Minecraft中设置灾前避难所建造、消失资源限时采集和互补武器首领战，要求属性不同的智能体在风险与截止时间下合作。
body.en: TickingCollabBench combines shelter construction before disasters, disappearing-resource collection and complementary-weapon boss fights for heterogeneous Minecraft teams.

body.zh: 用于研究异质智能体如何在动态风险、互补技能和截止时间下协同。同步／异步、集中／分布式的对照可分析任务分工、通信与模型推理延迟对团队完成的影响。
body.en: It studies heterogeneous-agent coordination under dynamic hazards, complementary skills and deadlines. Synchronous/asynchronous and centralized/decentralized comparisons analyze how division of labor, communication and inference latency affect team completion.

body.zh: 团队任务成功率衡量是否在风险和截止时间下完成共同目标，分别比较同步／异步与集中／分布式执行。真实推理延迟和推理暂停条件分别报告，以呈现时间消耗对协作结果的影响。
body.en: Team success rate measures completion of the shared goal under hazards and deadlines, comparing synchronous/asynchronous and centralized/decentralized execution. Real-inference-latency and paused-inference conditions are reported separately to expose the effect of elapsed time on coordination.

body.zh: 可行性与成功率随团队配置变化；真实延迟、推理暂停及拥有全局元数据的oracle分别提供不同时间与信息条件下的参照。
body.en: Feasibility and success vary by team setup; real latency, paused inference and globally informed oracles provide distinct timing/information references.

body.zh: Craftium 基于可定制三维世界提供单智能体、多智能体与程序化环境接口。策略读取渲染图像并输出移动、视角和交互动作，开发者通过地图与规则配置任务；ChopTree 是其中的砍树示例。
body.en: Craftium provides single-agent, multi-agent and procedural environments in customizable 3D worlds. Policies read rendered images and issue movement, view and interaction actions; developers configure tasks through maps and rules. ChopTree is a tree-chopping example.

body.zh: 用于研究视觉强化学习的训练效率，以及同一平台内地图、规则和多智能体设置变化的影响。可定制任务支持把导航、对象交互和资源操作组合为不同训练目标。
body.en: It supports research on visual-RL training efficiency and effects of changing maps, rules and multi-agent configurations within one platform. Custom tasks combine navigation, object interaction and resource operations into different training objectives.

body.zh: ChopTree 以砍倒的树木数计分，每棵树奖励1，回合累计回报即采伐数量。论文以五次运行的均值和标准误汇总该示例的学习表现。
body.en: ChopTree scores the number of trees felled, awarding one reward per tree, so episode return equals the tree count. The paper summarizes learning on this example with the mean and standard error over five runs.

body.zh: 论文中的 ChopTree 示例采用64×64 RGB、八个离散动作和初始钢斧，2000步终止。该示例固定输入、装备和预算；Craftium 平台还可另行配置世界规则与多智能体任务。
body.en: The paper’s ChopTree example uses 64×64 RGB, eight discrete actions, an initial steel axe and a 2,000-step limit. It fixes observation, equipment and budget; the Craftium platform separately supports configurable world rules and multi-agent tasks.

body.zh: EVAAA在三维具身环境中为智能体设置饥饿、口渴、体温与损伤变量，要求通过感知和行动把内部状态维持在可存活范围。
body.en: EVAAA equips embodied agents with satiation, hydration, temperature and damage variables that must remain within viable bounds through environmental interaction.

body.zh: 平台以内部生理变化生成奖励，研究目标如何由自身需求驱动；Unity环境支持视觉、嗅觉、温度和碰撞输入，以及训练课程和未见测试场景。
body.en: Rewards arise from physiological dynamics to study internally motivated goals. Unity environments combine sensory modalities, curricular training and unseen testbeds.

body.zh: 食物／水资源选择任务以500步内是否消费当前急需资源判定成功，并比较相同设置下 DQN、PPO 与 DreamerV3 的成功率。温度调节等其他任务另以存活时间或内部状态的相应指标评价。
body.en: Food/water choice succeeds when the urgently needed resource is consumed within 500 steps; success rates compare DQN, PPO and DreamerV3 under matched settings. Other tasks, such as thermoregulation, use their corresponding survival-time or internal-state measures.

body.zh: 食物／水选择任务操纵饥饿与缺水状态，测量500步内取得急需资源的表现；温度调节任务操纵热环境并评价生理状态维持。各任务分别定义状态变量、时限和成功条件。
body.en: Food/water choice manipulates hunger and thirst and measures urgent-resource acquisition within 500 steps; thermoregulation varies thermal conditions and evaluates physiological-state maintenance. Each task defines its own state variables, horizon and success condition.

body.zh: MineAnyBuild以Minecraft建筑为载体，给模型多模态人类需求，让其输出可执行的建筑蓝图矩阵，再由Mineflayer自动完成放置。
body.en: MineAnyBuild presents multimodal building instructions and asks models for executable blueprint matrices, which Mineflayer then constructs automatically in Minecraft.

body.zh: 用于研究从多模态需求推导三维结构、空间关系与常识约束。4000项空间规划任务支持把建筑生成质量与针对空间关系的问答表现并列分析，自动施工则提供计划执行后的可观察产物。
body.en: It studies deriving 3D structures, spatial relations and commonsense constraints from multimodal requirements. Its 4,000 planning tasks support joint analysis of building quality and spatial QA, while automatic construction produces observable realizations of the plans.

body.zh: 评分同时考察生成建筑质量和空间问答准确率；建筑质量包含GPT-4.1加权判断，评价对象是计划产物及其空间关系。
body.en: Evaluation combines artifact quality, including GPT-4.1-weighted judgments, with spatial-QA accuracy, assessing generated plans and their spatial relationships.

body.zh: 生成蓝图、自动施工和空间问答构成评测链路，质量分数评价建筑产物及其关系，模型承担的是空间计划与回答生成角色。
body.en: Blueprint generation, automatic construction and spatial QA form the evaluation pipeline, with artifact/relationship quality assessing the model's planning and answering roles.

body.zh: Minecraft Universe以3452个可组合原子任务和任务组合机制构建开放世界评测框架，涵盖导航、工具、制作、采矿、战斗和建造等目标。
body.en: Minecraft Universe combines a catalog of 3,452 atomic tasks with compositional task generation for navigation, tools, crafting, mining, combat and building.

body.zh: 框架关注开放目标难以统一程序化评分的问题，以视频评判产生任务进度和控制、材料使用、效率、错误识别、创造性等诊断。
body.en: The framework addresses evaluation of open-ended goals using video judgments of progress and diagnostics including control, material use, efficiency, error recognition and creativity.

body.zh: AutoEval 根据游玩视频以 GPT-4o 给出任务进度，以及控制、材料使用、效率、错误识别和创造性诊断。主实验覆盖30项原子与5项组合任务；简单任务用30个种子，六项难度对照任务各用10个种子。

body.zh: MineNPC-Task将专家玩家在Minecraft共玩时提出的采集、导航、建造与物品管理请求整理为参数化模板，配以明确前置条件和状态验证器。
body.en: MineNPC-Task turns expert Minecraft co-play requests for gathering, navigation, building and inventory management into parameterized templates with preconditions and state validators.

body.zh: 研究面向具备记忆的人机共同决策智能体，记录计划、执行、澄清、记忆读写与修复事件，并限定知识与证据来自游戏世界内部。
body.en: The work studies memory-aware mixed-initiative agents, logging plans, execution, clarification, memory operations and repairs under an in-world evidence policy.

body.zh: 状态验证器逐项判断子任务成功，并由事件日志归类失败、澄清与修复及记录路由延迟。八位专家的共玩试验包含44个高层请求和216个子任务；生成的 Mineflayer 技能最多经历三轮审核。
body.en: State validators determine subtask success; event logs categorize failures, clarification and repair and record routing latency. The eight-expert co-play study contains 44 high-level requests and 216 subtasks, with generated Mineflayer skills receiving up to three review rounds.

body.zh: 结果对应八专家参与的人机共玩试验，玩家可辅助修复与重规划；验证器和事件日志刻画子任务执行及交互过程。
body.en: Results characterize an eight-expert co-play pilot with human-assisted repairs/replanning, using validators and event logs for subtask and interaction analysis.

body.zh: BEDD汇集Minecraft BASALT人类示范和偏好评价，支持寻找洞穴、建瀑布、圈养同类动物和修建村庄风格房屋四类难以精确编码的目标。
body.en: BEDD supplies demonstrations and preferences for four Minecraft BASALT goals: cave finding, waterfall building, animal corralling and village-style house construction.

body.zh: 数据含约2600万图像动作对、近14000段人类视频和3000余个人工成对判断，用于模仿学习、人类反馈学习及固定参考榜单比较。
body.en: Approximately 26 million image-action pairs, nearly 14,000 videos and over 3,000 pairwise human ratings support imitation, human-feedback learning and reference-leaderboard comparisons.

body.zh: 四类 BASALT 目标用人工成对偏好与 TrueSkill 评价完成质量，ObtainDiamondShovel 用资源制作奖励评价明确目标。留出种子中的智能体读取像素与任务描述并执行键鼠动作，示范数据统计与在线成绩分别汇总。
body.en: Four BASALT objectives use paired human preferences and TrueSkill to evaluate completion quality; ObtainDiamondShovel uses crafting rewards for an explicit objective. On held-out seeds, agents read pixels and task descriptions and issue keyboard/mouse actions; demonstration statistics and online scores are aggregated separately.

body.zh: BEDD同时发布人类示范、偏好标注和参考评价流程。四项开放目标保留BASALT定义，ObtainDiamondShovel作为明确奖励目标的对照；数据拟合与留出世界中的在线执行分别组织。
body.en: BEDD releases demonstrations, preference labels and a reference evaluation workflow. Four open-ended goals retain BASALT definitions; ObtainDiamondShovel supplies an explicit-reward comparison. Dataset fitting and online execution in held-out worlds are organized separately.

body.zh: IGLU 2022 设置离线澄清识别和交互建造两条赛道。交互 Builder 读取第一视角图像、物品栏、建造区张量与位置，根据清晰指令增删方块，使已有结构变为目标结构。
body.en: IGLU 2022 has offline clarification and interactive construction tracks. The interactive Builder reads first-person images, inventory, a building-area tensor and position, then adds or removes blocks under clear instructions to transform an initial structure into the target.

body.zh: 用于研究建造指令中的歧义识别、空间语言理解与结构编辑。将离线澄清识别和交互 Builder 分为两条赛道，可以分别分析“何时需要澄清”和“如何按清晰指令完成操作”。
body.en: It studies ambiguity detection, spatial-language understanding and structural editing in building instructions. Separate clarification and interactive Builder tracks analyze when clarification is needed and how clear instructions guide actions.

body.zh: 交互赛道采用方块差异 F1，比较产出结构与目标结构相对初始网格所需的增删操作，并按所需编辑数量加权。留出初始／目标网格提供测试实例，任务完成或超时结束回合。
body.en: The interactive track uses block-difference F1, comparing output and target edits relative to the initial grid and weighting by required edit count. Held-out initial/target grids provide test instances, and episodes end at completion or timeout.

body.zh: 交互Builder按结构编辑评分，离线澄清轨道按分类与检索指标评分；两条赛道分别体现语言落地中的执行和歧义识别。
body.en: The interactive builder scores structural edits, while offline clarification uses classification/retrieval measures, separating execution from ambiguity detection.

body.zh: Neural MMO 2.0是大规模多智能体、多任务强化学习平台，默认128个智能体在程序化地图中生存，并支持任务、地图和对手的留出泛化。
body.en: Neural MMO 2.0 supports massively multi-agent, multi-task reinforcement learning, with 128 agents by default and held-out tasks, maps and opponents.

body.zh: 用于研究多任务策略如何从共享世界机制中学习，并迁移到未见任务、地图与对手。可组合任务谓词把训练目标与平台规则解耦，便于比较任务条件变化下的策略表现。
body.en: It studies learning multitask policies from shared world mechanics and transferring to unseen tasks, maps and opponents. Composable task predicates separate objectives from platform rules, enabling comparisons under changing task conditions.

body.zh: 以官方 DistanceTraveled 谓词为例，把小组成员相对出生点的 L∞ 位移之和除以目标距离，并截断至[0,1]；全组无人存活时记零。该分数衡量位移目标的完成进度，其他任务由各自谓词计分。
body.en: The official DistanceTraveled predicate divides summed group-member L-infinity displacement from spawn by a target distance and clips it to [0,1], returning zero when nobody survives. This measures displacement-goal progress; other tasks use their own predicates.

body.zh: 平台默认在程序化世界中运行128个智能体；观测按智能体提供，任务谓词使用全局状态计分。DistanceTraveled 的距离阈值、分组、地图与时限确定一个实例，留出任务和对手构成其他评测设置。
body.en: The platform defaults to 128 agents in procedural worlds, supplying per-agent observations while scoring task predicates from global state. Distance threshold, grouping, map and horizon define a DistanceTraveled instance; held-out tasks and opponents define additional evaluation settings.

body.zh: NeurIPS 2022 Neural MMO Challenge采用v1.6环境，16支队伍共128个角色在程序化世界中采集、生存、战斗与交易，并应对NPC及缩圈压力。
body.en: The NeurIPS 2022 Neural MMO Challenge uses v1.6, with 16 teams and 128 agents gathering, surviving, fighting and trading amid NPC and shrinking-zone pressure.

body.zh: 竞赛加入装备、职业分化与市场机制，研究多智能体策略在资源稀缺、地图变化和异质对手下的鲁棒性，区别于后来的2.0任务平台。
body.en: Equipment, specialization and markets create robustness challenges under scarce resources, changing maps and diverse opponents, distinct from the later 2.0 task platform.

body.zh: PvE 以队伍取得第一名的比例计分，PvP 依据完整排名更新 TrueSkill；两条赛道分别汇总。竞赛安排每日100场和每周1000场评估，以重复对局估计队伍在不同对手组合下的表现。
body.en: PvE scores the proportion of first-place finishes, while PvP updates TrueSkill from full rankings; the tracks are aggregated separately. Daily 100-match and weekly 1,000-match evaluations estimate team performance across opponent combinations.

body.zh: 此条对应NeurIPS 2022的v1.6竞赛，PvE与PvP分别保留对手、难度和赛程；成绩反映资源经营、生存与战斗的综合队伍表现。
body.en: This entry concerns the v1.6 NeurIPS 2022 competition, retaining distinct PvE/PvP opponents, stages and schedules for combined economic, survival and combat performance.

body.zh: Avalon在程序化三维世界中提供20类具身生存任务，角色需导航地形、寻找或获取食物并避开危险，从简单技能逐渐组合出复杂目标。
body.en: Avalon offers 20 embodied survival tasks in procedural 3D worlds, combining navigation, food gathering or hunting and hazard avoidance.

body.zh: 所有任务共享奖励、动力学和动作空间，仅以环境变化改变要求，因而可研究同任务新世界、跨任务迁移，以及基础技能的组合泛化。
body.en: Shared rewards, dynamics and actions allow changes in environments to test within-task generalization, transfer and composition of basic skills.

body.zh: 按任务和世界统计能量回报，并以人类与随机策略参照归一化。论文先在16项基础任务上训练，再对20项任务各50个固定世界测试，分别比较新世界、未见任务与组合技能表现。
body.en: Energy returns are collected per task/world and normalized against human and random-policy references. Policies train on 16 base tasks and are tested on 50 fixed worlds for each of 20 tasks, comparing new-world, unseen-task and compositional-skill performance.

body.zh: 策略使用96×96 RGBD及身体、手部、能量和时间信息，输出21维动作。各任务共享动力学与动作空间，环境生成和训练／测试任务划分分别控制场景泛化与技能迁移。
body.en: Policies receive 96×96 RGBD plus body, hand, energy and time information and output 21-dimensional actions. Tasks share dynamics and action spaces; environment generation and train/test task splits separately control scene generalization and skill transfer.

paragraphs.zh: 策略使用96×96 RGBD及身体、手部、能量和时间信息，输出21维动作。各任务共享动力学与动作空间，环境生成和训练／测试任务划分分别控制场景泛化与技能迁移。
paragraphs.en: Policies receive 96×96 RGBD plus body, hand, energy and time information and output 21-dimensional actions. Tasks share dynamics and action spaces; environment generation and train/test task splits separately control scene generalization and skill transfer.

body.zh: IGLU 2021将自然语言建造对话落地为方块世界操作，Silent Builder读取已有完整对话，在指定区域复建目标结构。
body.en: IGLU 2021 grounds construction dialogue in a block world; Silent Builder reads an existing dialogue and reconstructs a target in a designated region.

body.zh: 研究把语言理解与具身空间操作结合，提供人类级、离散和连续三种动作接口；观察包含64×64图像、六色库存、建造网格与姿态。
body.en: The benchmark links language understanding with embodied spatial actions through human-level, discrete and continuous interfaces, using images, colored inventory, grid state and pose.

body.zh: 报告平均奖励、完整结构成功率与基于归一化汉明距离的完成度，分别反映执行收益、完全重建和部分结构匹配。各子任务固定初始与目标状态，匹配考虑平移旋转，离开指定区域终止。
body.en: Evaluation reports mean reward, full-structure success and completion based on normalized Hamming distance, reflecting execution return, exact reconstruction and partial structural matching. Each subtask fixes initial/target states, accounts for translation/rotation and terminates when the builder leaves the area.

body.zh: Silent Builder依据已有对话执行结构重建；Architect生成作为离线轨道，主动澄清属于后续研究方向，三种动作接口分别保留。
body.en: Silent Builder reconstructs structures from existing dialogue; Architect generation is offline, active clarification is deferred and three action interfaces remain distinct.

body.zh: NetHack Learning Dataset收集人类服务器轨迹与AutoAscend符号机器人轨迹，提供压缩记录、加载和流式处理工具，支持从大规模示范学习策略。
body.en: The NetHack Learning Dataset combines human-server and AutoAscend trajectories with compressed recording, loading and streaming tools for demonstration learning.

body.zh: 人类部分含约100亿状态转移，机器人部分约30亿带动作与分数转移；两者信息不同，研究如何在复杂长程决策中利用这些数据。
body.en: Human data contain roughly ten billion state transitions, while bot data add three billion action/score transitions, enabling study of heterogeneous demonstrations for long-horizon decisions.

body.zh: 示范训练后的策略在 NLE 中在线执行，以1024回合的累计回报评价游戏表现，并汇总十个训练种子的均值与标准差。论文的共享网络和默认15亿训练帧构成方法对照条件。
body.en: Policies learned from demonstrations are executed online in NLE and evaluated by episode return over 1,024 episodes, reporting mean and standard deviation across ten training seeds. A shared network architecture and default 1.5 billion training frames define the method-comparison conditions.

body.zh: NLD-NAO人类日志提供状态轨迹，NLD-AA机器人数据额外提供动作与奖励；在线回报评价学习后的NLE游玩策略。
body.en: NLD-NAO human logs provide state trajectories, while NLD-AA bot data add actions/rewards; online returns evaluate learned NLE policies.

body.zh: Jelly Bean World以不重置的二维网格世界研究持续学习，代表任务要求采集软糖、避开洋葱，并不断寻找尚未耗尽的资源区域。
body.en: Jelly Bean World studies continuing learning in non-resetting 2D grid worlds; its representative task collects jelly beans, avoids onions and seeks undepleted areas.

body.zh: 用于研究同一持续运行世界中的长期学习、资源耗尽后的行为调整，以及局部视觉和气味信息对探索的作用。非平稳的资源分布使早期有效策略的后续适应成为评价重点。
body.en: It studies long-term learning in a continuously running world, adaptation after resource depletion, and the role of local vision and scent in exploration. Nonstationary resource availability makes continued adaptation of initially effective behavior central.

body.zh: 以10万步滑动窗口内的每步平均奖励衡量持续表现，观察资源耗尽后能否维持采集收益。固定奖励实验运行1000万步，并汇总20次独立运行。
body.en: Sustained performance is measured as reward per step in a 100,000-step sliding window, showing whether returns persist as local resources are depleted. Fixed-reward experiments run for ten million steps and aggregate 20 runs.

body.zh: 固定奖励的单智能体采集实验使用局部视觉、可选气味以及前进和左右转动作，在同一不重置世界中持续运行。多任务、多智能体和多模态配置属于平台提供的其他扩展。
body.en: The fixed-reward, single-agent gathering experiment uses local vision, optional scent, and forward/left/right actions in one continuously running world. Multitask, multi-agent and multimodal configurations are additional platform extensions.

body.zh: DSLE将Dark Souls: Remastered首领战包装为Gymnasium式环境，平台覆盖22个首领，每个环境步都在实际运行的游戏中执行动作。
body.en: DSLE exposes Dark Souls: Remastered boss encounters through Gymnasium-style interfaces, with each environment step executing actions in the running game; the platform covers 22 bosses.

body.zh: 研究用实时战斗、高维视觉和稀疏终局奖励检验学习难度，并设DSLE-5作为五首领代表集，涵盖近战、狭窄空间、环境危险、多目标和快速战斗。
body.en: DSLE-5 samples five encounters spanning melee, constrained arenas, hazards, multiple targets and fast combat to study visual learning under sparse terminal rewards.

body.zh: 以首领击败胜率、生存时间和造成伤害分别衡量战斗成功、坚持时间与有效攻击。结果按首领和固定装备属性设置分别汇总，DSLE-5用于五种代表战斗的比较。
body.en: Boss-defeat rate, survival time and damage dealt measure combat success, endurance and effective attack. Results are grouped by boss and fixed equipment/stat configuration, with DSLE-5 comparing five representative fights.

body.zh: DSLE-5的五首领集与22首领扩展分别组织，固定存档、装备及属性。协议使用灰度画面与14种离散动作，默认持续250毫秒；游戏物理、动画和AI变化由实际运行产生。
body.en: DSLE-5 and the 22-boss extension are organized separately with fixed saves, equipment and stats. The protocol uses grayscale images and 14 discrete actions held for 250 ms by default; physical, animation and AI variation arises from the running game.

body.zh: FootsiesGym基于简化二维格斗游戏FOOTSIES，智能体根据双方状态和己方私有蓄力信息选择移动与攻击，争取击败对手。环境保留接近、试探和出招时机形成的双人零和博弈。
body.en: FootsiesGym builds on the minimalist 2D fighter FOOTSIES. Agents use both players’ state and private self-charge information to select movement and attacks, seeking to defeat the opponent through spacing, probing and attack timing.

body.zh: 研究保留格斗策略的循环克制和非传递性，以向量化模拟器提高训练吞吐，比较策略对固定对手与近似最佳回应的表现。
body.en: A vectorized simulator supports efficient study of cyclic, nontransitive strategies through fixed-opponent and approximate-best-response comparisons.

body.zh: 分别报告对随机或不动对手的胜率，以及对专门训练的近似最佳回应的胜、负、平率，后者估计固定策略可被针对的程度。实验使用五个训练种子，每个最佳回应另训练三个种子。
body.en: Evaluation reports win rates against random or no-op opponents and win/loss/draw rates against trained approximate best responses, estimating how a fixed policy can be exploited. Experiments use five policy-training seeds and three seeds per best response.

body.zh: 默认配置使用85维观察、六种动作、四帧跳帧、八帧动作延迟和4000步超时；九动作蓄力模式单列。近似最佳回应提供可利用性的下界，固定弱对手测试反映基础对战能力。
body.en: Defaults use 85 features, six actions, frame skip four, an eight-frame action delay and a 4,000-step timeout; the nine-action charge mode is separate. Approximate best responses lower-bound exploitability, while weak fixed opponents test basic playing strength.

body.zh: HASARD以Doom构造视觉安全强化学习任务，智能体同时追求目标奖励并限制危险成本，套件提供三档难度和两套动作空间。
body.en: HASARD creates vision-based safe-RL tasks in Doom, requiring agents to obtain reward while controlling safety costs across three difficulty levels and two action spaces.

body.zh: 用于研究第一视角三维决策中的安全约束学习，分析追求目标回报时如何控制危险成本。任务变化、难度课程和动作空间为比较安全强化学习算法提供不同条件。
body.en: It studies safety-constrained learning in first-person 3D environments: how policies pursue task reward while limiting hazardous costs. Task variations, difficulty curricula and action spaces provide distinct conditions for comparing safe-RL algorithms.

body.zh: Armament Burden以成功交付武器的回报衡量任务收益，以累计超载成本衡量安全代价，分别报告两者。任务要求把收集到的武器运回交付点，单局最多2100 tick，用于比较负重约束下的采集运输策略。
body.en: Armament Burden reports reward for successfully delivered weapons and cumulative overload cost as separate task and safety outcomes. Agents collect weapons and return them to a delivery point within 2,100 ticks, comparing collection-and-transport policies under load constraints.

body.zh: Armament Burden使用160×120 RGB和移动、转向、使用、跳跃等动作，过量负重触发安全代价。套件其他场景各自定义危险事件，按任务、难度、动作版本和成本预算组织比较。
body.en: Armament Burden uses 160×120 RGB and movement, turning, use and jump actions, with excessive load incurring safety cost. Other suite scenarios define their own hazards; comparisons are organized by task, difficulty, action version and cost budget.

body.zh: Kinetix以统一二维物理引擎生成大量控制任务，策略操作电机与推进器，使绿色物体接触蓝色目标，同时避免碰撞红色危险物。
body.en: Kinetix generates diverse 2D physics-control tasks in which motors and thrusters bring green objects to blue targets while avoiding red hazards.

body.zh: Jax2D加速引擎支持大规模混合质量任务预训练，研究从程序化训练向人类设计关卡的零样本迁移，以及预训练后微调的收益。
body.en: The accelerated Jax2D engine enables large-scale mixed-quality pretraining, studying zero-shot transfer to human-designed levels and subsequent fine-tuning.

body.zh: 以人类设计留出关卡的解决率衡量零样本控制表现，并按S/M/L任务规模分别汇总五个训练种子的结果。预训练后微调实验另外观察适应新任务后的收益。
body.en: Solve rate on human-designed held-out levels measures zero-shot control, aggregated separately by S/M/L task size over five training seeds. Additional fine-tuning experiments examine improvement after adaptation.

body.zh: 完全观察设置提供实体属性、位置、旋转、速度和连接关系，原实验使用50亿次交互训练。手工留出关卡处于程序化训练分布的支持范围，任务规模和微调条件分别记录。
body.en: Fully observed settings expose entity properties, positions, rotations, velocities and connections, with five billion training interactions in the original experiment. Human-designed holdouts remain within the support of procedural training; task size and fine-tuning conditions are recorded separately.

paragraphs.zh: Kinetix以统一二维物理引擎生成大量控制任务，策略操作电机与推进器，使绿色物体接触蓝色目标，同时避免碰撞红色危险物。
paragraphs.en: Kinetix generates diverse 2D physics-control tasks in which motors and thrusters bring green objects to blue targets while avoiding red hazards.

paragraphs.zh: Jax2D加速引擎支持大规模混合质量任务预训练，研究从程序化训练向人类设计关卡的零样本迁移，以及预训练后微调的收益。
paragraphs.en: The accelerated Jax2D engine enables large-scale mixed-quality pretraining, studying zero-shot transfer to human-designed levels and subsequent fine-tuning.

paragraphs.zh: 以人类设计留出关卡的解决率衡量零样本控制表现，并按S/M/L任务规模分别汇总五个训练种子的结果。预训练后微调实验另外观察适应新任务后的收益。
paragraphs.en: Solve rate on human-designed held-out levels measures zero-shot control, aggregated separately by S/M/L task size over five training seeds. Additional fine-tuning experiments examine improvement after adaptation.

Human-designed holdouts remain within the support of procedural training; task size and fine-tuning conditions are recorded separately.
