body.zh: FightLadder提供实时格斗游戏的像素交互平台，既支持单人挑战内置角色，也支持双人竞争，用于研究竞争型多智能体强化学习。
body.en: FightLadder offers pixel-based real-time fighting for both built-in-opponent play and two-player competition, targeting competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning.

body.zh: 论文同时提供算法基线与策略表现、可利用性评价，比较击败固定角色和形成不易被针对策略之间的差异，展示对手循环的研究需求。
body.en: Baselines and performance/exploitability measures distinguish beating fixed characters from learning robust competitive policies and reveal challenges in opponent-dependent training.

body.zh: Ryu镜像对局记录回合胜率，并以固定对手池中的对战矩阵和Elo比较策略。针对固定策略训练的RL攻击者胜率另作近似可利用性诊断；图像输入、动作宏和动作保持时长为共同控制条件。
body.en: Ryu mirror matches yield round win rates and a fixed-pool matchup matrix with Elo ratings. Win rates of RL attackers trained against a fixed policy provide a separate approximate-exploitability diagnostic. Image input, action macros and action duration are matched control conditions.

body.zh: 单人内置角色挑战与双人竞争构成两类任务，Genesis版本的Ryu镜像是其中一个固定角色对抗设置。评级由指定对手池拟合，左右侧、帧堆叠及奖励配置随实验记录。
body.en: Built-in-character challenges and two-player competition are separate task types; Genesis-version Ryu mirrors are one fixed-character competitive setting. Ratings are fitted within a specified opponent pool, with side assignment, frame stacking and reward configuration recorded per experiment.

body.zh: OCAtari扩展Atari学习环境，从游戏画面或内存状态高效提取对象表示，使智能体可基于物体位置与属性进行强化学习。
body.en: OCAtari extends Atari environments with efficient object-state extraction, enabling reinforcement learning from object positions and attributes.

body.zh: 研究把对象发现、表示学习和策略学习纳入同一框架，比较对象信息与像素输入，并单独分析提取质量和资源效率。
body.en: The framework connects object discovery, representation learning and policy learning, comparing object and pixel inputs while separately assessing extraction quality and efficiency.

body.zh: 在线PPO实验报告人类归一化游戏分数，用于比较对象表示下的游玩效果；对象提取质量与资源效率是另两类评价。图4涵盖Asterix等八款游戏，每款以三个种子训练2000万帧。
body.en: Online PPO experiments use human-normalized game scores to compare play with object representations; extraction quality and resource efficiency are separate evaluations. Figure 4 covers eight games including Asterix, using three 20-million-frame seeds per game.

body.zh: 图4的对象控制实验以相邻两帧移动物体坐标为输入，覆盖Asterix、Bowling、Boxing、Freeway、Kangaroo、Pong、Seaquest和Tennis。平台支持列表反映环境可用范围，游戏分数对应这一具体控制设置。
body.en: Figure 4 uses moving-object coordinates from two adjacent frames in Asterix, Bowling, Boxing, Freeway, Kangaroo, Pong, Seaquest and Tennis. Platform support lists describe availability; game scores correspond to this specific control setup.

body.zh: VideoGameBench要求视觉语言模型凭原始画面、目标与控制说明，在十款1990年代电子游戏中持续推进完整游戏，其中三款保密。智能体以按钮组合、动作序列和持续时间控制游戏。
body.en: VideoGameBench asks VLMs to progress through ten 1990s video games from raw frames, goals and control instructions, with three games held out. Agents issue button combinations, action sequences and durations.

body.zh: 研究尽量减少专用状态与辅助支架，比较实时交互和Lite推理暂停模式，观察视觉、导航、记忆管理及响应延迟对长程进展的影响。
body.en: The work minimizes game-specific scaffolding and compares real-time play with paused-inference Lite to examine perception, navigation, memory and latency.

body.zh: Doom II以到达预定义关卡检查点的比例表示游戏进度，其他游戏使用各自目标对应的进度标准。起点、时限和重开规则固定；实时与Lite推理暂停模式分别报告结果。
body.en: Doom II measures progress as the proportion of predefined level checkpoints reached; other games use progress criteria tied to their objectives. Start states, time limits and restart rules are fixed, with real-time and inference-paused Lite results reported separately.

body.zh: 套件包含十款游戏，公开与保密任务共同用于检验跨游戏迁移。此处展开的Doom II协议使用关卡进度计分，其他游戏按各自目标设定进度标准；Lite模式改变模型推理期间游戏是否继续运行。
body.en: The ten-game suite combines public and held-out games to examine cross-game transfer. Doom II uses level progress, while other games define progress through their own objectives. Lite changes whether the game continues during model inference.

body.zh: COOM基于Doom构造视觉强化学习任务序列，让智能体依次学习不同三维场景，同时保留先前学到的行为，研究持续学习而非单次零样本游玩。
body.en: COOM uses Doom-based visual task sequences to study continual reinforcement learning: agents learn successive environments while retaining earlier performance.

body.zh: 套件以不同视觉与目标变化分析灾难性遗忘、前向迁移和样本效率；第一视角输入让表示变化与行为学习共同影响序列训练。
body.en: Visually and behaviorally varied sequences examine catastrophic forgetting, forward transfer and sample efficiency under egocentric perception.

body.zh: 击杀相关指标计量任务表现，序列平均表现汇总整体成绩；遗忘量比较旧任务前后表现，前向迁移刻画先前训练对新任务学习的影响。Run and Gun以相同八任务顺序和预算比较各方法。
body.en: Killing-related measures supply task scores and sequence-average performance summarizes the overall result. Forgetting compares past and later old-task performance; forward transfer measures effects on learning new tasks. Run and Gun compares methods under the same eight-task order and budget.

body.zh: Run and Gun跨域序列每局最多2500步，按序训练且不再访问旧任务。视觉域变化和明确任务边界定义训练条件，历史任务测试用于观察知识保持。
body.en: The Run and Gun sequence caps episodes at 2,500 steps and trains sequentially without revisiting old tasks. Visual-domain changes and explicit task boundaries define training conditions; tests on past tasks measure retention.

body.zh: LevDoom在Doom的四类射击或生存场景中设置有序修改等级，用更低难度场景训练，再观察策略面对更高等级环境时的表现。
body.en: LevDoom defines ordered modification levels across four Doom shooting/survival scenarios, training at lower levels and testing on higher-level environments.

body.zh: 研究将视觉强化学习的泛化问题转化为可控关卡变化，结合障碍物、敌人类型及环境复杂度，比较已有算法对未见变化的适应性。
body.en: The benchmark controls level modifications involving obstacles, enemy types and complexity to compare visual-RL adaptation to unseen environments.

body.zh: 四类场景按目标分别报告击杀数或存活帧数，比较策略从低等级训练到高等级测试时的表现变化。每10万训练步测试30局，汇总五次训练运行。
body.en: The four scenarios report kills or survival frames according to their objectives, comparing performance from lower-level training to higher-level tests. Evaluation uses 30 episodes per 100,000 training steps across five runs.

body.zh: 实验在等级0–1训练1000万步，在等级2–4测试，等级变化涉及外观、障碍和敌人。160×120 RGB经处理成为84×84灰度输入，各场景保留自己的动作与任务目标。
body.en: Experiments train ten million steps on levels 0–1 and test levels 2–4, varying appearance, obstacles and enemies. The 160×120 RGB input is processed into 84×84 grayscale; scenarios retain their own actions and objectives.

body.zh: Atari-HEAD同步记录人类Atari操作与眼动，包含20款游戏的117小时数据、800万动作示范和3.28亿注视样本。
body.en: Atari-HEAD records human Atari actions and eye movements across 20 games, with 117 hours, eight million action demonstrations and 328 million gaze samples.

body.zh: 研究用高质量注意与动作轨迹支持注视预测和模仿学习，并以AGIL等策略检验预测注意力是否有助于实际游戏控制。
body.en: The dataset supports gaze prediction and imitation, with AGIL-style policies investigating whether learned attention improves actual control.

body.zh: 数据侧分别评价动作预测与注视预测；在线AGIL等实验以平均游戏分数检验预测注意力对控制的作用。在线分数由每游戏500个随机种子回合汇总，区分数据拟合与实际策略执行。
body.en: Action and gaze prediction are evaluated on the dataset; online AGIL-style experiments use mean game score to test whether predicted attention benefits control. Online scores aggregate 500 seeded episodes per game, separating data fitting from policy execution.

body.zh: 半逐帧人类采集提供示范与眼动标签，在线实验则以图像、可选预测显著图和18类动作执行策略。在线回合上限108000帧，动作以Boltzmann参数1采样。
body.en: Semi-frame-by-frame human collection supplies demonstrations and gaze labels. Online policies use images, optional predicted saliency and 18 action classes, with a 108,000-frame cap and Boltzmann parameter one for action sampling.

body.zh: RL Unplugged提供离线强化学习数据、基线与评测协议，覆盖Atari和模拟运动控制等领域；Atari部分从DQN回放中学习，再到游戏环境评价策略。
body.en: RL Unplugged provides offline-RL data, baselines and evaluation protocols across Atari and simulated control; its Atari policies learn from DQN replay before environment evaluation.

body.zh: 研究强调数据学习和策略选择的可比较性，明确哪些任务允许在线选择模型，哪些任务必须依靠离线选择，避免把额外交互混入离线训练收益。
body.en: The suite standardizes learning and policy selection, distinguishing online model selection from offline selection so additional interaction does not obscure comparisons.

body.zh: Atari轨道以数据生成混合策略中的最佳策略为参照归一化在线游戏分数，再报告跨游戏中位数及bootstrap区间。46款游戏各包含五条DQN训练流、每流5000万转移；九款允许在线调参，37款用于离线策略选择评测。
body.en: Atari scores are normalized against the best policy in the data-generating mixture, then summarized by a cross-game median and bootstrap intervals. Each of 46 games has five DQN streams of 50 million transitions; nine allow online tuning and 37 evaluate offline policy selection.

body.zh: 训练输入为固定回放数据，策略选择按在线可用与纯离线两种协议区分。Atari使用四帧图像堆叠与离散动作；运动控制部分采用各自的数据、动作空间和计分标准。
body.en: Training uses fixed replay data, with policy selection separated into online-access and fully offline protocols. Atari uses four stacked frames and discrete actions; the locomotion/control components have their own datasets, action spaces and scoring rules.

paragraphs.en: RL Unplugged provides offline-RL data, baselines and evaluation protocols across Atari and simulated control; its Atari policies learn from DQN replay before environment evaluation.

body.zh: Age of LLM让两个语言模型在13×7回合制格子战场对抗，目标可以是摧毁基地或通过外交结束；战争迷雾与私密信息限制状态可见性。
body.en: Age of LLM pits two language models on a 13×7 turn-based battlefield, with base destruction or diplomatic endings under fog of war and private information.

body.zh: 研究把经济、军事与外交放入严格JSON行动接口，以逐回合行为和消息考察对抗不确定性下的决策、信念追踪与执行可靠性。
body.en: Economic, military and diplomatic choices use strict JSON, enabling trace-based analysis of decisions, belief tracking and reliability under adversarial uncertainty.

body.zh: 胜负反映规则机制下的对抗结果，非法动作比例衡量JSON接口执行可靠性，不同结局的回合数反映比赛持续时间。统计按规则版本分别报告，每场不保留跨局记忆。
body.en: Outcomes measure competition under the game rules, invalid-action rate measures JSON-interface reliability, and turns by ending type describe match duration. Statistics are reported by rule version without cross-game memory.

body.zh: 语料包含54场未交换双方位置的比赛，模型读取可见棋盘、上轮结果和最近40条外交记录。规则版本与固定席位限定该组描述性统计的比赛条件。
body.en: The corpus contains 54 games without swapping sides. Models read the visible board, previous-turn results and 40 recent diplomatic messages; rule version and fixed seats define the conditions of these descriptive statistics.

body.zh: Civilization V版CivBench让语言模型担任多人游戏的战略决策者，根据每回合结构化Markdown简报选择胜利方向、科技、政策和外交。
body.en: The Civilization V CivBench casts language models as multiplayer strategists using per-turn structured Markdown briefings to choose victory direction, research, policies and diplomacy.

body.zh: 研究认为数百回合后的胜负信号过稀，因而训练状态价值估计器，预测最终获胜概率，用连续进度分析不同模型与智能体配置的战略表现。
body.en: Because terminal outcomes are sparse, learned value estimators predict eventual win probability and provide progress signals for comparing models and agent setups.

body.zh: 用学习式状态价值模型逐回合估计最终获胜概率，并据此计算进度加权相对竞争地位；实际对局结果用于跨局Elo。论文汇总307局、七种模型及多个智能体配置，并控制开局、规则与文明差异。
body.en: A learned state-value model estimates eventual win probability at each turn and supports progress-weighted relative standing. Actual match outcomes feed cross-game Elo. The study covers 307 games, seven models and multiple agent setups, controlling starts, rules and civilization effects.

body.zh: 本条对应Civilization V：语言模型负责战略目标、科技、政策和外交，VPAI承担战术执行。价值预测提供密集过程信号，终局胜负及其评级记录完整比赛结果。
body.en: This entry covers Civilization V: language models choose strategic goals, technology, policies and diplomacy, while VPAI executes tactics. Value estimates provide dense progress signals; outcomes and ratings describe full-game results.

body.zh: FM-Bench以足球俱乐部经营模拟评估长期智能体，模型在20个游戏年内处理转会、合同、设施、青年培养与阵容，并面对董事会解雇风险。
body.en: FM-Bench evaluates agents managing football clubs over 20 game years through transfers, contracts, facilities, youth development and squad decisions, with dismissal risk.

body.zh: 用于研究长期经营中短期成绩与资产增长的取舍，以及市场竞争如何改变资源配置。跨决策重新开启会话的设置还支持分析智能体自管理记忆对累积后果的作用。
body.en: It studies tradeoffs between short-term sporting results and long-term asset growth, and how market competition changes resource allocation. Fresh conversations at decision stops also support analysis of self-managed memory under cumulative consequences.

body.zh: 确定性总分结合累积竞技荣誉、实际净资产增量与阵容价值，提前退出按协议折扣，因此同时衡量竞技成绩和长期经营产出。各队使用相同起始预算，运行三个种子；单人和共享市场Arena分别比较。
body.en: A deterministic score combines accumulated honors, real net-worth growth and squad value, discounting early exits under the protocol. It measures sporting results and long-term management output. Teams share starting budgets and run three seeds; solo and shared-market Arena results are separate.

body.zh: 20年经营过程使用26个工具和约340至400个决策停点。每次决策重新开启会话，历史档案与智能体自写笔记承载跨回合信息；单人轨道使用冻结脚本世界，Arena中的球队共享市场。
body.en: The 20-year management process uses 26 tools and roughly 340–400 decision stops. Each stop opens a fresh conversation; archives and agent-written notes retain information. Solo uses a frozen scripted world, whereas Arena teams share a market.

body.zh: RTSGameBench基于Beyond All Reason，提供完整对战、诊断小游戏与可扩展任务生成，研究视觉语言模型在大规模战场中的战略推理。
body.en: RTSGameBench uses Beyond All Reason for full matches, diagnostic minigames and task generation, studying VLM strategic reasoning on large battlefields.

body.zh: 研究结合局部画面、小地图和结构状态，由RTSGameAgent的状态机管理单位；不同对抗与合作配置考察兵力、资源与盟友行为协调。
body.en: Local views, minimaps and structured state feed an agent whose finite-state machinery manages units, supporting varied competitive and cooperative configurations.

body.zh: 五类诊断按目标报告完成率、胜率、排名、耗时及伤害效率，分别观察编队、防御、生存、配合和攻坚结果。任务包括目标编队、多线防御、混战生存、队伍配合和突破工事。
body.en: Five diagnostics report objective-specific completion rates, wins, ranks, time and damage efficiency for formation, defense, survival, coordination and assault. Tasks cover target composition, multi-front defense, free-for-all survival, team coordination and fortification attack.

body.zh: 五诊断任务分别采用一分钟有迷雾或15秒无迷雾决策；完整比赛与任务生成是资源的其他组成，小游戏保留各自目标与动作限制。
body.en: Five diagnostics use minute decisions with fog or 15-second decisions without fog; full matches and task generation are separate components with task-specific constraints.

body.zh: Civilization VI版CivBench通过76个MCP工具和文字叙述层，让语言模型进行完整文明经营；一局超过300回合并产生数千次查询与管理调用。
body.en: The Civilization VI CivBench provides 76 MCP tools and textual narration for full-game management across 300-plus turns and thousands of tool calls.

body.zh: 研究关注长期计划能否落实，以及智能体是否主动查询潜在战略状态；只有实际查询的信息进入观察，因此工具访问与主动监控行为分别可分析。
body.en: The work studies plan execution and proactive monitoring of latent strategic state, with observations limited to explicitly queried information.

body.zh: PMR统计主动查询战略状态的比例，RAG@10统计先前承诺在随后十回合内落实的比例，终局结果另记。原始研究有23次有效运行，使用共同地图与游戏种子、存档、版本和行动手册。
body.en: PMR measures the rate of proactive strategic-state queries; RAG@10 measures the fraction of prior commitments executed within ten turns. Terminal results are recorded separately. The 23 valid runs share map/game seeds, saves, version and playbook.

body.zh: 本条对应Civilization VI的工具驱动完整对局。模型只接收实际查询返回的信息，行为指标刻画共享行动手册条件下的监控与执行，终局成绩反映整局经营结果。
body.en: This entry covers tool-driven full games of Civilization VI. Models receive information they actually query; behavioral metrics characterize monitoring and execution under the shared playbook, while terminal results capture full-game management.

body.zh: TowerMind以轻量塔防环境连接语言模型与即时战略决策，智能体建造或升级防御、部署单位，阻止敌人抵达拥有20点生命的基地。
body.en: TowerMind provides a lightweight tower-defense setting in which agents build or upgrade defenses and deploy units to protect a 20-health base.

body.zh: 研究用文字、结构状态与图像输入比较决策和动作幻觉，设置五个内置关卡，同时报告语言模型、人类专家和强化学习基线的表现。
body.en: Five built-in levels compare textual, structured and visual inputs, studying decisions and invalid actions with language models, human experts and RL baselines.

body.zh: 以漏入基地的敌人数计防守得分：每漏一只扣1分，范围为−20至0，0分表示没有漏敌；合法动作率单独衡量命令执行。五关各运行五个种子，每16游戏步决策一次，文字与图文条件分别汇总。
body.en: Defensive score counts enemies reaching the base: each costs one point, yielding −20 to 0, with zero meaning no leaks. Legal-action rate measures command execution separately. Five levels each use five seeds and one decision per 16 game steps; text-only and visual conditions are aggregated separately.

body.zh: 基地初始生命为20，智能体用坐标和12类命令建造、升级、出售或调遣单位。图文条件在文字状态、规则与最近三步历史之外增加512×512画面，比较重点是同一塔防任务下的输入与模型差异。
body.en: The base starts with 20 health. Agents issue coordinates and 12 command types to build, upgrade, sell or deploy units. Visual conditions add a 512×512 image to text state, rules and three recent interactions, comparing input and model differences within the same defense tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 研究用文字、结构状态与图像输入比较决策和动作幻觉，设置五个内置关卡，同时报告语言模型、人类专家和强化学习基线的表现。
paragraphs.en: Five built-in levels compare textual, structured and visual inputs, studying decisions and invalid actions with language models, human experts and RL baselines.

paragraphs.zh: 以漏入基地的敌人数计防守得分：每漏一只扣1分，范围为−20至0，0分表示没有漏敌；合法动作率单独衡量命令执行。五关各运行五个种子，每16游戏步决策一次，文字与图文条件分别汇总。
paragraphs.en: Defensive score counts enemies reaching the base: each costs one point, yielding −20 to 0, with zero meaning no leaks. Legal-action rate measures command execution separately. Five levels each use five seeds and one decision per 16 game steps; text-only and visual conditions are aggregated separately.

paragraphs.zh: 基地初始生命为20，智能体用坐标和12类命令建造、升级、出售或调遣单位。图文条件在文字状态、规则与最近三步历史之外增加512×512画面，比较重点是同一塔防任务下的输入与模型差异。
paragraphs.en: The base starts with 20 health. Agents issue coordinates and 12 command types to build, upgrade, sell or deploy units. Visual conditions add a 512×512 image to text state, rules and three recent interactions, comparing input and model differences within the same defense tasks.

body.zh: Factorio Learning Environment让语言智能体通过Python代码与工具经营工厂，接收执行输出和错误反馈，逐步安排采集、设备、物流与生产链。
body.en: Factorio Learning Environment lets language agents manage factories through Python code/tools, using execution output and errors to develop resource, machine and logistics chains.

body.zh: 用于研究开放式生产链规划、工厂空间布局、程序合成及故障修复。执行输出和错误反馈让研究者分析模型如何把高层生产目标转为可运行的工具程序，并持续扩大工厂。
body.en: It supports research on production-chain planning, factory layout, program synthesis and error repair. Execution output and error feedback expose how models translate high-level production objectives into working tool programs and expand a factory.

body.zh: Open-play按固定版本的生产分数评价工厂扩张，地图、初始资源、科技、API及计量窗口共同确定得分条件。代码提交次数衡量模型交互预算，游戏时间衡量生产过程预算，两者分别记录。
body.en: Open-play evaluates factory expansion using the production score of a fixed version, conditioned on map, initial resources, technology, API and measurement window. Code submissions measure model-interaction budget, while game time measures production budget; both are recorded separately.

body.zh: Open-play在程序化地图上评价开放式工厂增长，Lab-play在固定资源下设置33项有界任务。两条轨道分别研究持续生产扩张与明确目标完成，并使用各自任务设置。
body.en: Open-play evaluates open-ended factory growth on procedural maps; Lab-play defines 33 bounded tasks with fixed resources. The tracks study sustained production expansion and explicit goal completion under their own setups.

body.zh: Mini Honor of Kings提供轻量王者荣耀环境及地图编辑器，允许研究者定制场景；论文的实际任务是五名英雄协作攻击黑暗暴君。
body.en: Mini Honor of Kings offers a lightweight environment and map editor; the paper's evaluated task uses five heroes cooperating against the Dark Dragon.

body.zh: 研究在保留多智能体挑战的同时降低计算需求，用随机首领技能和英雄差异检验协同策略，并比较常用多智能体强化学习算法。
body.en: The work reduces computational cost while retaining coordination challenges from stochastic boss skills and heterogeneous heroes, comparing common MARL algorithms.

body.zh: 以队伍对黑暗暴君的累计伤害衡量合作攻击效果，并通过学习曲线比较训练过程。七种场景配置各用五个种子训练一万回合，比较不同MARL算法。
body.en: Cumulative team damage to the Dark Tyrant measures coordinated attack, while learning curves compare training progress. Each of seven configurations uses five seeds and 10,000 training episodes to compare MARL algorithms.

body.zh: 五名英雄的局部观察包含己方与首领位置、生命，动作包括八方向移动、攻击和技能；集中训练可使用联合观察。等级、装备、技能和队伍组成构成七种实验配置，地图编辑器支持其他场景。
body.en: Five heroes observe allied and boss positions and health and select eight-direction movement, attacks and skills; centralized training can access joint observations. Level, equipment, skills and team composition define the seven configurations, with an editor supporting other scenarios.

body.zh: TextStarCraft II把星际争霸资源、建筑、单位、敌情和历史摘要转成文字，让模型通过执行器调度的建造、生产与研究宏动作经营完整对局。
body.en: TextStarCraft II converts resources, buildings, units, enemy information and history into text, enabling full-game management through executor-scheduled build, production and research macros.

body.zh: 研究提出Chain of Summarization，把单帧状态压缩与多帧战略总结相结合，考察语言模型能否利用游戏知识和历史选择长期行动。
body.en: Chain of Summarization combines single-frame compression with multi-frame strategic summaries to study whether language models turn knowledge and history into long-term decisions.

body.zh: 闭环比赛按内置Zerg AI难度和提示条件报告胜局数、总局数与胜率，模型调用次数和耗时作为交互开销单列。Chain of Summarization与其他摘要方式在相同比赛条件下比较。
body.en: Closed-loop matches report wins, total games and win rates by built-in Zerg AI difficulty and prompt condition; model calls and elapsed time are separate interaction costs. Chain of Summarization is compared with alternative summaries under matched match conditions.

body.zh: Protoss对Zerg AI的比赛由语言模型发出文字宏动作，执行器承担底层操作，地图、摘要频率与提示保持固定。静态知识问答和专家意见提供附加诊断，采用各自的分析对象。
body.en: In Protoss-versus-Zerg-AI matches, a language model issues text macro commands and an executor handles low-level actions, with fixed map, summary frequency and prompts. Static knowledge questions and expert assessments provide separate diagnostics.

body.zh: WGSR-Bench将妙算兵棋截图和行为记录转成态势理解、对手建模与策略生成三组问题。模型识别局势、推断风险及收益偏好，并依据给定情境选择或撰写策略。
body.en: WGSR-Bench turns MiaoSuan screenshots and behavior records into situation-awareness, opponent-modeling and policy-generation questions. Models interpret situations, infer risk/reward preferences, and select or write scenario-specific strategies.

body.zh: S-POE结构将战场认知、对手特质和策略生成分开，用于定位战略推理中的具体薄弱环节，并与不同经验水平的人类参与者比较。
body.en: S-POE separates battlefield understanding, opponent traits and policy generation to diagnose components of strategic reasoning and compare models with humans of different expertise.

body.zh: MM-SA态势多选题按正确率评分；PsyR-OM分别评价特质归因和策略预测。PGG的开放策略回答由Qwen2.5-VL-72B按事实、逻辑、原则、结果预测与表达完整性评分，另设创新加分并汇总至0–100分。
body.en: MM-SA uses multiple-choice accuracy; PsyR-OM evaluates trait attribution and strategy prediction. Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores PGG responses for facts, logic, principles, outcome prediction and completeness, with an innovation bonus and a 0–100 aggregate.

body.zh: 评测单元为给定战场情境下的问答、推断及策略文本，三组得分分别刻画感知、对手理解和方案质量。论文另讨论将这些组件接入兵棋智能体。
body.en: Evaluation units are scenario questions, inferences and policy text; the three scores characterize perception, opponent understanding and plan quality. The paper also discusses integrating these components into a wargame agent.

body.zh: Hokoff汇集王者荣耀预先采集的真实对局数据，分别支持1v1离线强化学习和3v3离线多智能体强化学习，提供配套基准框架。
body.en: Hokoff supplies precollected Honor of Kings gameplay for 1v1 offline RL and 3v3 offline MARL, with a corresponding benchmark framework.

body.zh: 研究围绕复杂层级动作、不同数据质量、泛化与多任务学习比较行为克隆和离线强化学习，并提出适配按钮、目标和参数结构的基线。
body.en: The work compares behavior cloning and offline RL across data quality, generalization and multitask settings, including a baseline tailored to hierarchical actions.

body.zh: 以对多个PPO参考对手的在线胜率衡量离线学习策略，按英雄阵容、数据质量及对手训练阶段分别比较。行为克隆和离线强化学习使用相同来源的预采集对局数据。
body.en: Online win rate against multiple PPO references evaluates policies learned offline, with results separated by hero lineup, data quality and opponent training stage. Behavior cloning and offline RL use the same sources of precollected matches.

body.zh: 数据集、训练阶段与在线对手评测共同构成协议；1v1和3v3采用各自任务配置，胜率对应特定参考对手与动作结构。
body.en: Datasets, offline training and online opponent evaluation jointly define the protocol. The 1v1 and 3v3 settings retain their own configurations and reference-opponent win rates.

body.zh: SMACv2让多个智能体分别控制StarCraft II单位，在局部观察下通过移动、停止、攻击或治疗配合击败敌队，专注合作战斗微操。
body.en: SMACv2 assigns individual StarCraft II units to decentralized agents that coordinate movement, stopping, attacks or healing from local observations.

body.zh: 改进版随机化起始位置和单位构成，减少固定地图脚本策略的作用，以可配置能力分布研究多智能体强化学习的泛化。
body.en: Randomized starting positions and unit compositions reduce reliance on fixed scripts and provide configurable capability distributions for studying MARL generalization.

body.zh: 环境以battles_won除以battles_game计算队伍胜率，另记录超时；训练中的全局状态访问、视野、兵种分布、地图和步进共同定义场景。
body.en: Team win rate is battles_won divided by battles_game, with timeouts recorded separately; global-state access, sight range, unit distributions, maps and stepping define settings.

body.zh: 评测对象是随机战斗场景中的去中心化协作，观测与可用动作随配置变化；单位经济、生产建造和整局科技运营属于其他RTS任务层级。
body.en: Evaluation concerns decentralized cooperation in randomized combat, with observations and available actions set by configuration; full-game economics, construction and technology are distinct RTS layers.

body.zh: Honor of Kings Arena通过Python接口提供王者荣耀1v1对抗，包含20个可控制英雄，围绕不同控制对象与不同对手研究竞争强化学习泛化。
body.en: Honor of Kings Arena exposes 1v1 gameplay through Python and provides 20 controllable heroes for competitive-RL generalization across controlled and opposing characters.

body.zh: 环境给出英雄公开和私有信息、兵线、防御塔、水晶及比赛阶段特征，动作分解为按钮、目标、移动或技能方向，保留MOBA战斗与推塔目标。
body.en: Structured observations cover hero state, creeps, towers, crystals and match phases; hierarchical actions combine buttons, targets and movement/skill directions.

body.zh: 胜率衡量获胜表现，奖励和每帧伤害补充过程信息；模型池Elo表示给定策略池中的相对位置。貂蝉迁移实验在同英雄训练后更换行为树对手英雄，进行98场测试。
body.en: Win rate measures match success; reward and damage per frame add process information, and model-pool Elo indicates relative standing within the pool. Diao Chan transfer tests change the behavior-tree opponent’s hero after mirror training and use 98 matches.

body.zh: 平台包含20个可控制英雄及分层按钮、目标和方向参数。貂蝉迁移实验固定控制英雄、出装与升级顺序，按对手英雄和行为树难度比较，呈现固定运营条件下的对手适应。
body.en: The platform offers 20 heroes and hierarchical button, target and direction parameters. Diao Chan transfer fixes the controlled hero, purchases and upgrades and varies opponent hero and behavior-tree difficulty to test adaptation under fixed management choices.

paragraphs.zh: Honor of Kings Arena通过Python接口提供王者荣耀1v1对抗，包含20个可控制英雄，围绕不同控制对象与不同对手研究竞争强化学习泛化。
paragraphs.en: Honor of Kings Arena exposes 1v1 gameplay through Python and provides 20 controllable heroes for competitive-RL generalization across controlled and opposing characters.

paragraphs.zh: 环境给出英雄公开和私有信息、兵线、防御塔、水晶及比赛阶段特征，动作分解为按钮、目标、移动或技能方向，保留MOBA战斗与推塔目标。
paragraphs.en: Structured observations cover hero state, creeps, towers, crystals and match phases; hierarchical actions combine buttons, targets and movement/skill directions.

paragraphs.zh: 胜率衡量获胜表现，奖励和每帧伤害补充过程信息；模型池Elo表示给定策略池中的相对位置。貂蝉迁移实验在同英雄训练后更换行为树对手英雄，进行98场测试。
paragraphs.en: Win rate measures match success; reward and damage per frame add process information, and model-pool Elo indicates relative standing within the pool. Diao Chan transfer tests change the behavior-tree opponent’s hero after mirror training and use 98 matches.

paragraphs.zh: 平台包含20个可控制英雄及分层按钮、目标和方向参数。貂蝉迁移实验固定控制英雄、出装与升级顺序，按对手英雄和行为树难度比较，呈现固定运营条件下的对手适应。
paragraphs.en: The platform offers 20 heroes and hierarchical button, target and direction parameters. Diao Chan transfer fixes the controlled hero, purchases and upgrades and varies opponent hero and behavior-tree difficulty to test adaptation under fixed management choices.

body.zh: Gym-μRTS把完整微型即时战略对局接入强化学习接口，角色需分配工人采集资源、生产部队、调度单位并击败对手。
body.en: Gym-μRTS exposes full micro-RTS games for reinforcement learning, requiring resource gathering, unit production, movement and combat.

body.zh: 研究以低成本模拟和训练技术降低完整RTS的计算负担，通过消融分析各项扩展方法，并在单机条件下训练可对抗既有竞赛机器人的策略。
body.en: The work combines efficient simulation and training techniques for affordable full RTS, using ablations and single-machine training against prior competition bots.

body.zh: 在单地图上对13个固定对手各进行100局，以累计胜率比较完整RTS策略，模型大小和运行耗时提供效率指标。论文从四个训练种子中选最佳策略，单局上限为4000 tick。
body.en: On one map, policies play 100 games against each of 13 fixed opponents; aggregate win rate compares full-RTS play, while model size and runtime measure efficiency. The paper selects the best of four training seeds and caps each game at 4,000 ticks.

body.zh: 完全观察实验输入27个二值特征平面，逐单位选择采集、返还、生产、移动、攻击或等待。胜负联合反映资源运营与战斗，单地图和最佳种子选择定义该实验的测试范围。
body.en: Fully observed experiments use 27 binary feature planes and per-unit harvest, return, production, movement, attack or wait actions. Outcomes jointly reflect economic management and combat; one map and best-seed selection define the tested scope.

body.zh: BVR Sim 将超视距空战建成可配置的在线强化学习环境，支持多种飞机、传感器、武器和脚本对手。策略读取实体化战术信息，输出目标航向、高度、速度与武器释放命令，由机型专属内环执行。
body.en: BVR Sim is an online reinforcement-learning environment for beyond-visual-range air combat, with configurable aircraft, sensors, weapons and scripted opponents. Entity-based observations feed tactical heading, altitude, speed and weapon-release commands executed by aircraft-specific controllers.

body.zh: 研究重点是部分可观测交战中的能量与有限弹药管理，以及统一战术接口能否支持异构机型策略迁移；Python与加速C++后端也服务于高吞吐训练。
body.en: It studies energy and limited-weapon management under partial observability, and whether a common tactical interface transfers policies across aircraft. Python and accelerated C++ backends support training throughput.

body.zh: 以冻结策略在各机型上的胜率衡量跨机型迁移，每个策略—机型组合测试960回合。策略仅在F-16上训练，测试时通过机型专属控制器在其他飞机上对阵同一1对1脚本对手。
body.en: Per-aircraft win rate measures transfer of a frozen policy over 960 episodes per policy–aircraft pair. A policy trained only on F-16 is tested on other aircraft through aircraft-specific controllers against the same scripted 1v1 opponent.

body.zh: 资源包括跨机型迁移和多代理训练集成两类实验；前者衡量冻结策略在机型控制器适配后的交战胜率，后者记录MAPPO/HAPPO与多机环境的集成表现。
body.en: The resource includes transfer and multi-agent integration experiments. Transfer measures frozen-policy wins with adapted aircraft controllers; integration records MAPPO/HAPPO operation in multi-aircraft environments.

body.zh: R2D-RL通过共享内存与逐周期同步，将RoboCup二维足球服务器及HELIOS球员接入Python多智能体学习。环境同时提供门前训练场景与11对11全场比赛。
body.en: R2D-RL connects the RoboCup 2D server and HELIOS player clients to Python multi-agent learning through shared memory and cycle-level synchronization, supporting both front-goal scenarios and full-field 11v11 play.

body.zh: 其研究问题是如何在局部观察和稀疏进球奖励下学习传球、无球支援与团队进攻，并比较高层离散动作、参数化动作、合法掩码和EPV奖励塑形。
body.en: It examines passing, off-ball support and coordinated attacks under local observations and sparse scoring rewards, comparing discrete and parameterized actions, masks and EPV reward shaping.

body.zh: 进球率衡量多攻击者能否突破HELIOS防守，结果报告三个训练种子的均值和标准差。Support Option、Passing Lane和Compact Defense各训练500万步，每局最多300步。
body.en: Goal rate measures whether multiple attackers can beat HELIOS defenders, reported as mean and standard deviation across three training seeds. Support Option, Passing Lane and Compact Defense use five million training steps each and a 300-step episode cap.

body.zh: 三种门前场景分别强调支援选择、传球通道与密集防守，全场11对11提供另一任务层级。学习策略负责play_on阶段，其他比赛模式由HELIOS执行。
body.en: The three front-goal scenarios emphasize support options, passing lanes and compact defense, while full-field 11v11 provides another task level. Learned policies control play_on; HELIOS handles other modes.

body.zh: SVI-Bench以篮球、足球与冰球的真实比赛录像及解说、报告和统计构成多模态语料，将体育团队互动作为可核验规则与结果的动态微世界。模型处理视频与问题，而非操控场上球员。
body.en: SVI-Bench combines real basketball, soccer and hockey broadcasts with commentary, reports and statistics, using team sports as a microworld with explicit rules and outcomes. Models analyze videos and questions rather than control players.

body.zh: 九项任务沿动态场景理解、因果推理、策略模拟和智能体综合四个层次组织，考察从识别事件到解释成因、推演变化及综合分析的能力链。
body.en: Nine tasks span dynamic scene understanding, causal reasoning, strategic simulation and agentic synthesis, testing a progression from event recognition to explanations, counterfactual analysis and synthesis.

body.zh: 问答和结果预测报告准确率，检索报告R@1；描述与战略解释采用0–5分裁判评分，长报告分别评价事实与重点事件覆盖。视频生成使用轨迹重叠mIoU、视觉一致性或目标达成率，T9按最终事实答案的正确率评分。
body.en: QA and forecasting use accuracy; retrieval uses R@1. Description and strategic explanation use 0–5 judge scores, and reports measure factuality and salient-event coverage. Generation uses trajectory mIoU, visual consistency or goal accuracy; T9 scores final factual-answer correctness.

body.zh: 九任务覆盖短片、完整比赛与跨语料分析，模型输出分别为答案、报告或生成视频。各任务保留独立指标；T9由工具检索多模态证据并输出可核对的事实答案。
body.en: The nine tasks span clips, full games and cross-corpus analysis, producing answers, reports or videos. Metrics remain task-specific; T9 retrieves multimodal evidence with tools and returns a verifiable factual answer.

body.zh: MMBench为连续控制研究提供200项跨领域与具身形态的任务，配有语言指令、示范和可选图像。论文以Newt共享世界模型结合示范预训练及多任务在线交互。
body.en: MMBench provides 200 continuous-control tasks across domains and embodiments, with language instructions, demonstrations and optional images. Newt combines demonstration pretraining with shared multitask online world-model learning.

body.zh: 研究关注在线强化学习的多任务扩展、数据效率、开环控制和未见任务适应；电子游戏构成控制套件中的一个子集，机器人与具身任务提供更广泛的迁移背景。
body.en: The research addresses multitask scaling, data efficiency, open-loop control and adaptation to unseen tasks. Video games form one subset of a broader control suite.

body.zh: Ms. Pac-Man与Space Invaders以单局总回报计分，再按各游戏预设上下界线性归一化至[0,1]，比较共享多任务策略的控制表现。每局固定1000步，与相同输入条件的基线比较。
body.en: Ms. Pac-Man and Space Invaders use episode return, linearly normalized to [0,1] by preset game-specific bounds, to compare shared multitask control. Episodes last 1,000 steps and baselines share input conditions.

body.zh: 200任务资源同时包含电子游戏、机器人及其他具身控制。Atari主实验读取128维RAM和任务文字，连续输出经ALE转换为离散动作；可选图像条件和跨形态迁移来自套件的其他实验。
body.en: The 200-task resource includes games, robotics and other embodied control. Primary Atari experiments use 128-dimensional RAM and task text, mapping continuous outputs to discrete ALE actions; optional images and cross-embodiment transfer are separate suite conditions.

body.zh: VolleyBots在物理仿真中让无人机进行排球运动，任务从单机练习延伸至多机合作与竞争。策略同时协调三维飞行、触球时机和队伍战术。
body.en: VolleyBots simulates drone volleyball under physical dynamics, ranging from individual drills to cooperative and competitive teams. Policies combine three-dimensional flight, contact timing and strategic play.

body.zh: 套件连接低层运动控制与高层策略，比较RL、MARL和博弈算法；论文还研究分层策略以及仿真策略向真实无人机的零样本部署。
body.en: The suite connects low-level control with strategy through RL, MARL and game-theoretic baselines, and studies hierarchical policies and zero-shot deployment on real drones.

body.zh: Easy二传扣球对二传触球、攻击者触球、向下扣球和落入目标区四个事件分别记0或1，以平均值衡量阶段完成度。每局上限800步，汇总五个种子结果，部分完成与全流程完成得到不同分数。
body.en: Easy set-and-spike assigns binary indicators to setter contact, attacker contact, downward spiking and target landing. Their mean measures staged completion within an 800-step cap, aggregated over five seeds, distinguishing partial from complete execution.

body.zh: 双无人机实例使用40维观察及给定锚点附近初始化，连续动作控制推力与机体运动。套件还含多机比赛、其他训练任务和真实无人机部署，各自采用对应的控制与计分条件。
body.en: The two-drone example uses a 40-dimensional observation, initialization near specified anchors and continuous thrust/body-control actions. Team matches, other drills and real-drone deployment use their own control and scoring conditions.

paragraphs.zh: VolleyBots在物理仿真中让无人机进行排球运动，任务从单机练习延伸至多机合作与竞争。策略同时协调三维飞行、触球时机和队伍战术。
paragraphs.en: VolleyBots simulates drone volleyball under physical dynamics, ranging from individual drills to cooperative and competitive teams. Policies combine three-dimensional flight, contact timing and strategic play.

paragraphs.zh: 套件连接低层运动控制与高层策略，比较RL、MARL和博弈算法；论文还研究分层策略以及仿真策略向真实无人机的零样本部署。
paragraphs.en: The suite connects low-level control with strategy through RL, MARL and game-theoretic baselines, and studies hierarchical policies and zero-shot deployment on real drones.

paragraphs.zh: Easy二传扣球对二传触球、攻击者触球、向下扣球和落入目标区四个事件分别记0或1，以平均值衡量阶段完成度。每局上限800步，汇总五个种子结果，部分完成与全流程完成得到不同分数。
paragraphs.en: Easy set-and-spike assigns binary indicators to setter contact, attacker contact, downward spiking and target landing. Their mean measures staged completion within an 800-step cap, aggregated over five seeds, distinguishing partial from complete execution.

paragraphs.zh: 双无人机实例使用40维观察及给定锚点附近初始化，连续动作控制推力与机体运动。套件还含多机比赛、其他训练任务和真实无人机部署，各自采用对应的控制与计分条件。
paragraphs.en: The two-drone example uses a 40-dimensional observation, initialization near specified anchors and continuous thrust/body-control actions. Team matches, other drills and real-drone deployment use their own control and scoring conditions.

body.zh: GRF-MARL在Google Research Football基础上统一多智能体环境设置与评测，并覆盖学院练习和5对5、11对11完整比赛。平台还提供种群自博弈、预训练策略和足球分析工具。
body.en: GRF-MARL standardizes multi-agent settings and evaluation on Google Research Football, covering academy drills and full 5v5 and 11v11 matches, with population self-play, pretrained policies and football analytics.

body.zh: 研究关注观察编码、奖励密度、参数共享与训练方法如何影响团队配合，以及如何提高大规模完整比赛的训练效率和比较一致性。
body.en: It studies how observation encodings, reward density, parameter sharing and training methods affect teamwork, training efficiency and consistent comparison in larger matches.

body.zh: 测试胜率衡量学院场景的进攻成功，传球与控球统计补充团队行为诊断。六类场景包括3对1、传射、跑传射、角球和难易反击，非守门员采用19种离散动作。
body.en: Test win rate measures attacking success in academy scenarios, with passing and possession statistics diagnosing teamwork. Six scenarios cover 3v1, passing, running passes, corners and easy/hard counterattacks; non-goalkeepers use 19 discrete actions.

body.zh: 学院场景在球权交换时终止，由内置AI控制守门员，主要观察进攻协作；完整比赛、观察编码和稀疏或稠密奖励分别定义不同实验条件。
body.en: Academy episodes end on possession exchange with AI goalkeepers, primarily measuring coordinated offense. Full matches, encodings and sparse/dense rewards define separate conditions.

body.zh: LM Fight Arena让多模态模型在Mortal Kombat II中直接对抗，读取采样画面、血量、位置、朝向与近期动作，再将自然语言按钮组合转换为模拟器操作。
body.en: LM Fight Arena pits multimodal models against each other in Mortal Kombat II. Agents read sampled frames, health, positions, facing and recent actions, then issue natural-language button combinations translated into emulator inputs.

body.zh: 其目标是把视觉理解与连续战术决策置于动态对抗中，通过统一角色和提示条件比较模型，而不是只判断静态图像或孤立问答。
body.en: It combines visual interpretation and sequential tactical decisions in dynamic competition, comparing models under common character and prompting conditions.

body.zh: 论文循环赛让双方使用Liu Kang，以胜率和获胜方剩余血量作为结果。输入包含十帧采样图像和最近五个动作，同一模拟器、角色和系统提示控制接口差异。
body.en: The round robin uses Liu Kang mirror matches and reports win rate and winner remaining health. Inputs include ten sampled frames and five recent actions, with matched emulator, character and system prompt.

body.zh: 成绩对应Mortal Kombat II的Liu Kang镜像赛，输入同时包含采样图像和结构化状态。论文使用每模型配对一次的循环赛，以具体对手池内的胜负和剩余血量描述表现。
body.en: Results describe Liu Kang mirror matches with both sampled images and structured state. One match per model pairing yields pool-specific wins and remaining-health outcomes.

body.zh: Memory Maze让第一人称代理在随机三维迷宫中，依颜色提示反复寻找目标；同一回合内地图与物体位置固定，记忆保存离开视野的目标与路径信息。
body.en: Memory Maze asks a first-person agent to repeatedly retrieve color-cued targets in randomized 3D mazes. Layout and object positions stay fixed within an episode, requiring memory of information no longer visible.

body.zh: 资源同时包含在线RL任务、离线轨迹数据与记忆探针，重点考察随时间整合观察、自我定位和空间地图保持，并以人类表现提供参照。
body.en: It combines an online RL benchmark, offline trajectories and memory probes to study temporal integration, localization and spatial-map retention, with a human reference.

body.zh: 每正确到达目标奖励1，单局总回报即目标到达数，用于比较记忆支持的反复导航。9、11、13、15格迷宫分别采用1000至4000步预算，成绩按迷宫尺寸报告。
body.en: Each correct target visit earns one point, so episode return equals targets reached and measures memory-supported repeated navigation. Maze sizes 9, 11, 13 and 15 use budgets of 1,000–4,000 steps, with results reported by size.

body.zh: 标准任务采用64×64 RGB和六个离散导航动作，同一回合内地图和目标位置固定。ExtraObs增加可用信息，在线导航、离线轨迹学习及记忆探针分别观察记忆的使用与表征。
body.en: Standard tasks use 64×64 RGB and six navigation actions, with map and target positions fixed within an episode. ExtraObs expands available information; online navigation, offline learning and probes examine memory use and representation.

body.zh: MATE构建摄像机与移动目标两支队伍的非对称合作竞争：摄像机调整方向和视角覆盖目标，目标则在仓库间运输货物并避免暴露。
body.en: MATE creates an asymmetric cooperative–competitive game: cameras control direction and viewing angle to track targets, while mobile targets transport cargo among warehouses and avoid exposure.

body.zh: 平台用于研究局部感知下的团队合作、通信、规模扩展、稳健性和非对称自博弈；两队拥有不同动作空间与奖励结构，可分别评估学习方法。
body.en: It studies cooperation, communication, scaling, robustness and asymmetric self-play under local perception. The teams have distinct action spaces and reward structures.

body.zh: 摄像机以平均目标覆盖率衡量追踪效果，其中一个实验设置为4台摄像机、8个目标和9个障碍。运输队以归一化回报计分：成功运输获得固定运费及随耗时、暴露而衰减的赏金，同时计入运送效率与隐蔽性。
body.en: Cameras use mean target-coverage rate, including a four-camera, eight-target and nine-obstacle setting. Target-team normalized return combines fixed freight for deliveries with bounty that decays with time and detection, capturing efficiency and stealth.

body.zh: 两队在不同动作空间和目标下相互对抗，队内可研究通信与合作。局部或完整观察、队伍规模，以及规则底层执行的分层控制分别构成实验变体，双方成绩按本队目标报告。
body.en: The teams compete with different actions and objectives, while within-team communication and coordination can be studied. Local/full observations, team size and hierarchical rule-based execution define separate variants; each team is scored against its own objective.

body.zh: BotzoneBench基于Botzone竞赛平台，在八种完全或不完全信息游戏中让语言模型逐级挑战固定强度机器人；输入包含规则、文字状态、合法动作及适用历史。
body.en: BotzoneBench uses the Botzone platform to test LLMs against fixed graded bots across eight perfect- and imperfect-information games, supplying rules, text states, legal actions and relevant history.

body.zh: 固定技能锚点使评价可以随新模型加入持续比较，并降低全模型两两循环赛成本；研究关注模型在不同确定性、随机性与隐藏信息条件下的策略水平。
body.en: Fixed skill anchors support longitudinal comparison and reduce the cost of all-pairs model tournaments, exposing strategic differences across deterministic, stochastic and hidden-information games.

body.zh: 多数游戏以排除平局后的胜率及挑战锚点的等级进度计分，井字棋采用和局率适应其胜负结构。评测轮换座位并固定种子，完全信息配对运行32局、不完全信息配对64局。
body.en: Most games use win rate excluding draws and progress through anchor levels; tic-tac-toe uses draw rate to match its outcome structure. Seats are rotated and seeds fixed, with 32 games per perfect-information pairing and 64 per imperfect-information pairing.

body.zh: 锚点层级由各游戏的专用机器人定义，成绩在对应游戏内解释；合法动作供应明确了辅助决策条件，座位轮换和固定种子为跨模型比较提供共同基础。
body.en: Specialized bots define game-specific anchor tiers. Supplied legal moves specify supported decision conditions, while seat rotation and fixed seeds provide common comparison settings.

body.zh: Chess-World-Model从一千万盘真实国际象棋构造状态跟踪数据：输入合法棋步序列，输出序列执行后的完整棋盘状态，不要求模型选择下一步。
body.en: Chess-World-Model builds a state-tracking dataset from ten million real chess games: models receive legal move sequences and predict the resulting complete board state rather than select a move.

body.zh: 研究通过统一接口比较Transformer与多种递归架构，探查状态转移表达能力；真实棋局与均匀随机合法走子划分用于区分规则学习和常见局面捷径。
body.en: It compares Transformers and recurrent architectures under a common interface, using real-game and uniformly random legal-play splits to distinguish transition-rule learning from familiar-position shortcuts.

body.zh: 核心ExactState要求75个标签全部正确，另报告标签准确率与整条轨迹的完全正确性；分布外随机走子使真实棋局上接近饱和的模型仍显露错误。
body.en: ExactState requires all 75 labels to be correct; label accuracy and trajectory exactness provide additional diagnostics. Random-play evaluation exposes failures hidden by saturation on real games.

body.zh: 评测以离线合法走子序列为输入、棋盘标签为输出，真实棋局与随机走子划分分别刻画分布内和分布外状态更新；完全匹配体现精确追踪程度。
body.en: Offline move sequences map to board labels. Real-game and random-play splits characterize in- and out-of-distribution updates; exact matching measures tracking precision.

body.zh: DungeonBench以D&D 2014规则内容构建战斗模拟器，向代理提供战术观察、当前决策与可执行选项，覆盖移动、攻击、法术、反应及有限资源选择。
body.en: DungeonBench implements D&D-2014-style combat with tactical observations, pending decisions and executable options for movement, attacks, spells, reactions and scarce resources.

body.zh: 它关注地形、行动经济、时机窗口与规则交互共同作用时的战术判断，并通过Encounter单场与Day连续遭遇区分局部取胜和跨战斗资源预算。
body.en: It studies decisions shaped jointly by geometry, action economy, timing and rule interactions. Encounter tests local fights; Day links fights to test resource budgeting.

body.zh: Encounter包含20种遭遇，每场景三个种子，比较胜率、剩余生命、存活比例与决策工具成本；Day以五个含3至5场战斗的日程，检查持续生命、法术位和休整安排。

body.zh: MTG-Causal-RL将万智牌对战包装为Gymnasium环境，使用56张卡池的五种60张套牌；代理接收3077维局部观察，通过合法掩码选择478种离散动作。
body.en: MTG-Causal-RL wraps Magic: The Gathering in Gymnasium, using five 60-card archetypes from a 56-card pool, 3,077-dimensional partial observations and 478 masked discrete actions.

body.zh: 环境显式给出手工结构因果模型、干预预测与因子信用轨迹，使研究同时考察胜负、因果信用分配、策略可审计性及留一套牌迁移。
body.en: A hand-specified structural causal model exposes intervention predictions and factor credit traces, supporting studies of wins, causal credit assignment, auditability and leave-one-archetype-out transfer.

body.zh: 对随机、启发式、masked PPO及因果变体报告对战胜率和配对bootstrap区间；留出对手前后胜率差衡量迁移，因果因子校准另评价因果接口。主结果采用两个配对种子、每对手30局。
body.en: Random, heuristic, masked PPO and causal variants are compared by win rate with paired-bootstrap intervals. Win-rate changes against held-out opponents measure transfer; factor calibration evaluates the causal interface separately. Main results use two paired seeds and 30 games per opponent.

body.zh: 任务使用56张卡池和五种60张套牌，3077维局部状态与478种掩码动作限定交互。论文建议的七种子、每对手300局属于完整评测方案；已报告主结果的规模见评价方式。
body.en: Interaction uses a 56-card pool, five 60-card decks, 3,077 local-state features and 478 masked actions. The proposed seven-seed, 300-game-per-opponent setting is the full evaluation recipe; the scale of reported main results is stated above.

body.zh: OpenGuanDan提供四人、双队、多轮掼蛋模拟与逐玩家独立接口，支持学习策略、规则机器人及人类交互；每名玩家只见自己的手牌和公开出牌历史。
body.en: OpenGuanDan provides four-player, two-team, multi-round GuanDan with independent player APIs for learned agents, rule bots and human interaction. Players observe their own hand and public play history.

body.zh: 研究集中于隐藏信息、可变出牌组合和合作竞争混合目标，考察大规模信息集及动作空间中的决策学习，并提供人机对局作为额外参照。
body.en: It studies hidden information, variable card combinations and mixed cooperative–competitive objectives, with human matches as an additional reference.

body.zh: 总体胜率比较组队竞争表现，每轮1、2、3点奖励的比例呈现不同名次组合带来的收益。实验以同一策略控制每支队伍，每个策略配对运行1000局，人类比赛结果单独报告。
body.en: Overall win rate compares team strength; proportions of one-, two- and three-point round rewards describe returns from different finishing combinations. One policy controls each team in 1,000 games per policy pairing, with human matches reported separately.

body.zh: 同策略队友的对战研究固定组队下的掼蛋竞争，多轮奖励保留升级得分结构。独立玩家接口还支持规则机器人、学习策略及人类参与，各类对局按实际玩家构成区分。
body.en: Same-policy teams test competition under fixed teaming, with round rewards preserving the multi-round scoring structure. Independent player interfaces also support rule-based agents, learned policies and humans; games are distinguished by their actual player composition.

body.zh: PTCG-Bench在宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏中评估语言模型代理，通过harness将局部状态和历史转为提示，再执行带类型和参数的动作请求。
body.en: PTCG-Bench evaluates LLM agents in the Pokémon Trading Card Game, using a harness to render partial observations and history into prompts and execute typed, parameterized action requests.

body.zh: 资源同时研究固定策略的对战水平、积累经验后的自我改进，以及ReAct与模块化harness设计对成绩的影响，强调代理系统与模型本体共同决定表现。
body.en: It studies fixed-policy playing strength, improvement through accumulated experience and the effects of ReAct and modular harness design on agent performance.

body.zh: Glicko-2评级及其不确定性衡量对手池中的相对水平，两两胜率给出直接对战结果；重试前非法动作率和工具调用量衡量执行可靠性与开销。固定策略轨道在预设牌组池中循环对战，主要使用镜像牌组。
body.en: Glicko-2 ratings and uncertainty measure relative strength within the pool, while pairwise win rates give direct match results. Pre-retry invalid-action rates and tool calls measure execution reliability and cost. The fixed-policy track uses a round robin over a preset deck pool, primarily mirror decks.

body.zh: 固定策略循环赛评价当前对战水平，纵向轨道评价经验积累后的变化；固定牌组池、主要镜像牌组与动作验证规则共同界定harness条件下的表现。
body.en: Fixed-policy tournaments measure current strength; longitudinal trials measure change with experience. Deck pools, mirror matches and validation rules define harness-conditioned performance.

body.zh: Valet以RECYCLE规则语言统一编码21种传统不完全信息卡牌游戏，覆盖不同文化、玩家数、牌组、胜利条件及隐藏和揭露信息机制。
body.en: Valet encodes 21 traditional imperfect-information card games in RECYCLE, spanning cultures, player counts, decks, victory conditions and information-hiding mechanisms.

body.zh: 资源旨在让算法研究跨游戏比较稳健性，而非围绕单一扑克变体；CardStock实现向玩家提供可见信息和合法选择，基线以确定化处理未知手牌。
body.en: It enables cross-game robustness studies beyond a single poker variant. CardStock supplies visible information and legal options; determinization handles hidden hands in the baseline.

body.zh: 每游戏分别报告最终分数分布、平均分支因子和局长，前者描述策略结果，后两者描述搜索复杂度。基线运行100局全随机对战，以及100局首位MCTS对其他随机玩家；每决策10次确定化，每次搜索预算为合法选项数的100倍。
body.en: Each game reports final-score distributions, branching factor and game length: scores describe outcomes, while the latter two characterize search complexity. Baselines use 100 all-random games and 100 games with first-seat MCTS against random players; each decision uses ten determinizations, each with 100 times the legal-option count in search budget.

body.zh: 21种游戏按RECYCLE定义的具体规则变体运行，分数保留各自胜利条件与尺度。CardStock提供当前玩家可见信息和合法选择，未知手牌通过确定化采样处理；基线中的MCTS固定坐在首位。
body.en: The 21 games use their RECYCLE-defined rule variants and retain their own victory conditions and score scales. CardStock supplies visible information and legal choices, with unknown hands sampled by determinization; baseline MCTS occupies the first seat.

body.zh: 该国际象棋基准围绕1118道Lichess谜题研究冻结语言模型的自动提示优化，并用短对局检查谜题提升能否迁移到交互走子。
body.en: This benchmark uses 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study automatic prompt optimization for frozen LLMs, with short gameplay rollouts testing transfer beyond puzzle answers.

body.zh: 研究比较六种优化算法及八个目标模型，利用精确答案与引擎评价构成可更新、低成本的搜索反馈，同时观察优化提示的跨模型泛化。
body.en: It compares six optimization methods and eight target models using exact answers and engine evaluation as renewable, inexpensive feedback, including cross-model prompt transfer.

body.zh: 交互轨道以Stockfish评价下的centipawn regret衡量每个已接受棋步相对最佳选择的价值损失，非法尝试率单独报告。基础与优化提示按三个种子配对，从指定开局对弈，最多接受十个模型棋步；评分使用Stockfish 18深度20。
body.en: The interactive track uses Stockfish-based centipawn regret to measure the value lost by each accepted move relative to the best choice, reporting invalid attempts separately. Base and optimized prompts use three paired seeds from specified openings, at most ten accepted model moves, and Stockfish 18 at depth 20 for scoring.

body.zh: 谜题轨道与十步交互轨道分别评价静态答案和短时走子；regret基于每个提示实际到访并接受的棋步，非法率同时描述指令执行可靠性。
body.en: Puzzles and ten-move rollouts separately measure static answers and short gameplay. Regret uses each prompt’s visited, accepted moves; invalid rates describe execution reliability.

body.zh: Concept基准取自桌游的词语猜测机制：模型根据概念图标与线索组合推测目标词，研究如何由有限、间接的属性证据形成最佳解释。
body.en: The Concept benchmark asks models to infer target words from combinations of concept icons and clues, studying abductive reasoning from sparse, indirect attribute evidence.

body.zh: 论文采用最终线索与人类游戏日志构建不同难度的猜词条件，分析模型能否结合多个提示，以及线索逐渐加入时推理如何变化。
body.en: It uses final clue sets and human game logs to vary guessing conditions, examining clue integration and changes as further hints become available.

body.zh: 按猜中目标词的比例和所需猜测次数计分。最终线索条件一次提供线索集合；动态条件按人类日志逐步揭示线索并加入既有错误猜测，以比较模型在证据增加时的候选词更新。
body.en: Evaluation measures the proportion of target words recovered and the number of guesses required. Final-clue conditions provide the clue set at once; dynamic conditions replay clues and recorded wrong guesses incrementally, testing candidate-word updates as evidence grows.

body.zh: 两种条件均来自人类桌游记录，评测对象为给定图标和线索下的词语推断。动态版本使用预先记录的信息序列，难度取决于线索组合及揭示过程。
body.en: Both conditions derive from human game records and assess word inference from icons and clues. The dynamic version uses a prerecorded information sequence, with difficulty determined by clue combinations and their disclosure.

paragraphs.zh: 两种条件均来自人类桌游记录，评测对象为给定图标和线索下的词语推断。动态版本使用预先记录的信息序列，难度取决于线索组合及揭示过程。
paragraphs.en: Both conditions derive from human game records and assess word inference from icons and clues. The dynamic version uses a prerecorded information sequence, with difficulty determined by clue combinations and their disclosure.

body.zh: DSGBench用统一文字交互组织六种复杂策略游戏，结合不同难度与任务目标，记录决策轨迹并提供细粒度过程评价。
body.en: DSGBench organizes six complex strategic games through a common textual interface, with varied difficulties, objectives, decision traces and fine-grained process evaluation.

body.zh: 用于研究语言模型如何把文字状态转化为资源分配、生产发展和战术决策。套件同时记录终局胜负和过程统计，使经济运营、科技推进与战斗结果可以分别分析。
body.en: It studies how language models turn textual state into resource allocation, development and tactical decisions. Terminal outcomes and process statistics support separate analyses of economic management, technology progress and combat results.

body.zh: StarCraft II以胜率表示对战结果，RPM衡量每分钟资源，EER衡量资源使用，SUR衡量人口使用，TCR衡量科技完成。每场景运行10局，过程指标分别记录经济和科技发展。
body.en: StarCraft II uses win rate for match outcomes, RPM for resources per minute, EER for resource use, SUR for supply use and TCR for technology completion. Ten games per scenario provide outcome and economic/technology progress statistics.

body.zh: StarCraft II是六游戏套件中的宏观策略轨道，接口包含训练、建造、研发、侦察与战斗五类命令。同步或异步交互、内置AI或模型对手以及不同难度构成各自比较条件。
body.en: StarCraft II is the macro-strategy track in the six-game suite, using training, construction, research, scouting and combat commands. Synchronous/asynchronous interaction, built-in/model opponents and difficulty define separate comparison conditions.

body.zh: LudoBench围绕飞行棋的骰子随机性、吃子、安全格与终点推进，构建480个手工单步局面；模型看到规则、棋盘与骰点，选择移动棋子并解释。
body.en: LudoBench contains 480 handcrafted decision spots involving dice, captures, safe squares and finishing in Ludo. Models receive rules, board and die value, select a piece and explain.

body.zh: 十二类行为权衡把发展、完成和风险选择分开，另用相同棋盘加入人格或报复叙事，研究决策偏好及提示敏感性；资源也提供四人模拟器。
body.en: Twelve categories isolate development, finishing and risk choices. Persona and grudge narratives on identical boards test behavioral preferences and prompt sensitivity; a four-player simulator accompanies the spots.

body.zh: 每类40局面，比较模型与有限深度Expectiminimax基线的一致率、各类行为率和回退前非法率；引擎验证动作，失败时可随机选择合法动作。
body.en: Forty spots per category measure agreement with depth-limited Expectiminimax, behavioral rates and pre-fallback invalid rates. The engine validates choices and can fall back to random legal moves.

body.zh: 主评价为480个单步场景，有限深度Expectiminimax提供比较参照；相同棋盘上的中性和报复提示形成配对行为分析，模拟器另支持完整四人比赛。
body.en: The primary evaluation uses 480 single-decision spots with depth-limited Expectiminimax as a reference. Matched narrative prompts analyze behavior; the simulator separately supports full matches.

body.zh: ChessArena把国际象棋完整对弈与状态理解、单步选择及谜题诊断结合，在四种信息模式下比较语言模型与基线，检验规则遵循和策略判断。
body.en: ChessArena combines full chess matches with state understanding, single-move selection and puzzles, comparing LLMs and baselines across four information modes to examine rules and strategy.

body.zh: 研究利用不同观察条件区分棋盘表示、状态跟踪和实际走子表现，并以微调模型展示针对性训练能否改善交互棋力。
body.en: Different observation conditions probe board representation, state tracking and move selection, while a fine-tuned baseline tests whether targeted training improves interactive play.

body.zh: 完整比赛报告胜平负、Glicko评级及评级偏差，比较指定对手池中的实际棋力。双方轮换执棋颜色，200步封顶判和；状态理解、单步选择和谜题另用各自诊断评分。
body.en: Full games report win/draw/loss outcomes, Glicko ratings and rating deviation within the specified opponent pool. Colors are alternated and games capped at 200 moves as draws; state understanding, single-move selection and puzzles have separate diagnostic scores.

body.zh: 四种模式控制棋盘与历史信息，输入包括FEN及最近十步UCI等模式相关内容，接口支持UCI和SAN解析。合法步供应另有设置，完整比赛至多允许五次非法重试。
body.en: Four modes control board and history information, including FEN and ten recent UCI moves where applicable, with UCI/SAN parsing. Legal-move provision is a separate setting; full games permit at most five invalid retries.

body.zh: GAMA-Bench在八种经典博弈情境中组织多名语言模型玩家互动，提供随游戏参数变化的动态评分，以比较不同规模与结构下的决策行为。
body.en: GAMA-Bench organizes multi-agent LLM interaction in eight classical game-theory scenarios, with dynamic scoring that adapts to game parameters and settings.

body.zh: 研究关注模型的策略稳健性、跨设置泛化和提示方法的效果；参数可变的环境让评价超出固定双人问题，并观察重复互动中的行为调整。
body.en: It studies robustness, generalization across settings and prompting effects beyond fixed two-player tasks, including adaptation during repeated interaction.

body.zh: 代表任务让十个同模型代理在0至100同时选数，争取最接近全体均值的三分之二；每局20轮、重复五次。原始分数为跨玩家和轮次的平均选数与下界0之差，越小越接近均衡；归一化至0–100后，分数越高表示表现越好。
body.en: The representative task has ten same-model agents choose numbers from 0 to 100, aiming closest to two-thirds of the group mean, for 20 rounds in five repeated games. Raw score averages each choice minus the lower bound zero across players and rounds; lower is closer to equilibrium. Rescaling to 0–100 makes higher scores better.

body.zh: 八种博弈使用各自参数和归一化规则汇总，总分反映这些指定情境中的行为。猜均值实例采用同模型群体，其他玩家构成与提示方法形成不同实验配置。
body.en: The eight games aggregate behavior under their own parameters and normalization rules. The guessing example uses a homogeneous model population; other player compositions and prompting methods define different experimental configurations.

body.zh: GUARD使用开放动物移动、人口及基础设施数据生成现实导向的双人矩阵与安全博弈实例，包含反偷猎和基础设施保护等效用建模情境。
body.en: GUARD generates realistic two-player matrix and security-game instances from open animal-movement, demographic and infrastructure data, including anti-poaching and protection scenarios.

body.zh: 研究针对随机博弈实例缺乏真实结构及目标价值数据难获得的问题，提供可调效用函数、游戏参数和预配置集合，分析随机基准的退化性。
body.en: It addresses unrealistic random instances and inaccessible target-value data through configurable utilities, game parameters and preconfigured collections, while analyzing degeneracy in random games.

body.zh: 论文比较纳什与Stackelberg均衡求解算法，包括线性规划、增量策略生成和无遗憾自博弈；依据效用、运行时间、支持集大小及收敛行为比较真实与随机实例。
body.en: Evaluation compares Nash and Stackelberg solvers, including linear programming, incremental strategy generation and no-regret self-play, using utility, runtime, support size and convergence on real and randomized instances.

body.zh: 资源单位为效用矩阵、保护目标及巡逻计划实例，运行时间和收敛刻画求解效率，均衡效用与支持集刻画所得策略结构；各实例保留现实数据和效用假设。
body.en: Units are matrices, protection targets and patrol schedules. Runtime/convergence characterize solver efficiency; equilibrium utility and support characterize strategy under data and utility assumptions.

body.zh: Game Reasoning Arena以OpenSpiel封装棋盘与矩阵游戏，让语言模型与随机、启发式及强化学习代理通过统一文字接口互动；早期版本名为Board Game Arena。
body.en: Game Reasoning Arena wraps OpenSpiel board and matrix games in a common textual interface for LLM, random, heuristic and RL agents. An earlier version was named Board Game Arena.

body.zh: 框架支持API模型、本地部署与分布式执行，研究不同代理的决策结果和推理文本分布；多后端设计服务于系统性、可扩展的游戏比较。
body.en: API models, local deployment and distributed execution support systematic comparisons of decisions and rationale distributions across agent types.

body.zh: 引擎以终局回报、胜负平和非法动作记录评价策略，固定种子与模型参数后比较。井字棋示例的目标是形成三连线，输入为文字棋盘、合法动作和可选历史，输出包含action与reasoning字段。
body.en: Engine reward, win/loss/draw outcomes and invalid actions evaluate policies under fixed seeds and model parameters. The tic-tac-toe example seeks three-in-a-row, taking a textual board, legal actions and optional history and returning action and reasoning fields.

body.zh: 论文在七个封装游戏上展示统一框架，井字棋提供一个具体接口实例。终局结果来自游戏引擎，推理文本分布为附加生成行为分析；API、本地和分布式后端属于执行配置。
body.en: The paper demonstrates the shared framework across seven wrapped games, with tic-tac-toe as one interface example. Terminal outcomes come from the engine; reasoning-text distributions are additional generation analyses. API, local and distributed backends are execution configurations.

body.zh: GameBench以九种规则环境评估语言代理，包括资源部署、词语选择、棋盘封锁、团队战斗及隐藏阵营互动，玩家使用当前可见状态与环境规定动作。
body.en: GameBench evaluates language agents across nine rule-based environments involving deployment, word choice, board blocking, team combat and hidden alignments, using player-visible states and environment-defined actions.

body.zh: 研究比较基础模型、思维链与Reasoning Via Planning脚手架，观察战略选择、团队配合和身份推断在跨领域游戏中的表现，并以人类作为参照。
body.en: It compares base models, chain-of-thought and Reasoning Via Planning scaffolds across strategic decisions, team coordination and hidden-role inference, with human references.

body.zh: 评价保留各游戏胜负或收益，再以游戏频率倒数重采样及一万次bootstrap拟合加权Bradley–Terry评级和区间；代理状态可在比赛内保留，比赛之间重置。
body.en: Per-game outcomes or payoffs feed inverse-frequency resampling and 10,000 bootstrap weighted Bradley–Terry fits. Agent state can persist within a match and resets between matches.

body.zh: 整体评级汇总九种异质游戏，策略、协作与身份推断子集提供同一批对局的不同观察视图；团队实例允许同代理复制，反映该组队条件下的结果。
body.en: Overall ratings aggregate nine heterogeneous games. Strategic, cooperative and hidden-role subsets are views of the same matches; duplicated teammates define the evaluated team condition.

paragraphs.zh: GameBench以九种规则环境评估语言代理，包括资源部署、词语选择、棋盘封锁、团队战斗及隐藏阵营互动，玩家使用当前可见状态与环境规定动作。
paragraphs.en: GameBench evaluates language agents across nine rule-based environments involving deployment, word choice, board blocking, team combat and hidden alignments, using player-visible states and environment-defined actions.

paragraphs.zh: 研究比较基础模型、思维链与Reasoning Via Planning脚手架，观察战略选择、团队配合和身份推断在跨领域游戏中的表现，并以人类作为参照。
paragraphs.en: It compares base models, chain-of-thought and Reasoning Via Planning scaffolds across strategic decisions, team coordination and hidden-role inference, with human references.

paragraphs.zh: 评价保留各游戏胜负或收益，再以游戏频率倒数重采样及一万次bootstrap拟合加权Bradley–Terry评级和区间；代理状态可在比赛内保留，比赛之间重置。
paragraphs.en: Per-game outcomes or payoffs feed inverse-frequency resampling and 10,000 bootstrap weighted Bradley–Terry fits. Agent state can persist within a match and resets between matches.

paragraphs.zh: 整体评级汇总九种异质游戏，策略、协作与身份推断子集提供同一批对局的不同观察视图；团队实例允许同代理复制，反映该组队条件下的结果。
paragraphs.en: Overall ratings aggregate nine heterogeneous games. Strategic, cooperative and hidden-role subsets are views of the same matches; duplicated teammates define the evaluated team condition.

body.zh: GTBench构建十种语言驱动博弈任务，涵盖完全与不完全信息、静态与动态、确定性与概率性条件，让模型与其他模型或专用基线竞争。
body.en: GTBench contains ten language-driven game-theory tasks spanning information, temporal and stochastic structures, comparing LLMs against each other and specialized baselines.

body.zh: 研究利用不同游戏类别、均衡与帕累托效率分析策略行为，并比较代码预训练及CoT、ToT推理方法，提供失误类型以补充总体得分。
body.en: It analyzes strategy, equilibrium and Pareto efficiency across game classes, examining code pretraining, CoT/ToT prompting and detailed error profiles.

body.zh: 重复囚徒困境以累计收益衡量整段互动结果，并以Normalized Relative Advantage比较指定对手下的归一化相对优势。代理根据历史逐轮选择合作或背叛，语言模型、Tit-for-Tat与随机对手分别列出，推理提示固定。
body.en: Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma uses cumulative payoff over the interaction and Normalized Relative Advantage against specified opponents. Agents select cooperation or defection from the history, with language-model, Tit-for-Tat and random opponents reported separately under fixed reasoning prompts.

body.zh: 套件包含十类语言驱动博弈；此处展开的是历史依赖的重复双人决策。收益矩阵、对手策略与重复互动设置定义该实例的成绩，其他博弈保留各自均衡、信息结构与评分条件。
body.en: The suite contains ten language-driven games; this entry details history-dependent repeated two-player decisions. The payoff matrix, opponent policy and repeated-interaction setup determine its scores, while other games retain their own equilibrium, information and scoring conditions.

body.zh: LLM CHESS以工具调用完成整盘国际象棋：模型可查询Unicode棋盘与合法UCI棋步，并通过make_move执行操作；系统不提供既往棋步历史。
body.en: LLM CHESS tests complete chess games through tools for a Unicode board, legal UCI moves and move execution, without supplying prior-move history.

body.zh: 资源将规则遵循与延伸交互中的策略质量一起评估，先对随机对手比较大量模型，再让部分强推理模型挑战不同技能等级引擎以估计棋力。
body.en: It evaluates rule following and move quality during extended interaction, first against random play and then against variable-strength engines for selected reasoning models.

body.zh: 归一化胜负差衡量比赛成绩，违规致负记录执行失败，每步优劣分类与局长补充策略过程信息。模型固定执黑，对每个引擎等级进行30局、每局最多100回合；等级结果另用于内部Elo估计。
body.en: Normalized win–loss difference measures match performance, violation losses record execution failure, and move-quality categories and game length add process information. Models always play Black for 30 games per engine level with a 100-turn cap; level results also support an internal Elo estimate.

body.zh: 工具提供当前Unicode棋盘与合法UCI动作，交互不提供既往走子历史。胜负描述完整比赛结果，走子质量描述局部策略选择，违规致负反映该工具和重试协议下的执行可靠性。
body.en: Tools provide the current Unicode board and legal UCI moves without prior-move history. Outcomes describe full games, move quality describes local decisions, and violation losses reflect execution reliability under the tool and retry protocol.

body.zh: PokerBench收集11000个翻牌前与翻牌后德州扑克决策场景，由受训扑克玩家参与构建。模型根据牌局叙述和行动历史输出行动及下注或加注金额。
body.en: PokerBench contains 11,000 preflop and postflop poker decision scenarios constructed with trained players. Models output an action and wager amount from a spot description and history.

body.zh: 其核心用途是快速诊断策略选择，并提供监督微调数据；论文同时通过模型间实际比赛检查静态成绩与对战表现的关系。
body.en: It offers a quick diagnostic of strategic choices and data for supervised fine-tuning, with separate gameplay experiments validating the relationship between benchmark scores and match performance.

body.zh: Action Accuracy只比较行动类别是否与参考答案一致；Exact Match进一步要求下注或加注金额匹配。主要实验采用按行动抽取的五样例提示及固定解码设置，对照玩家构建的参考标签比较原始与微调模型。
body.en: Action Accuracy checks agreement on the action category; Exact Match additionally requires the bet or raise amount to match. Main experiments use action-sampled five-shot prompts and fixed decoding, comparing original and fine-tuned models against player-constructed reference labels.

body.zh: 主要协议为翻牌前和翻牌后局面的单步决策，成绩对应参考行动与金额的一致性。论文另用模型间完整对局检查静态得分与比赛结果的关系，微调实验考察同一参考决策分布上的学习效果。
body.en: The primary protocol tests single decisions in preflop and postflop situations, measuring agreement with reference actions and amounts. Full games between models examine the relationship with match outcomes, while fine-tuning tests learning within the reference-decision distribution.

body.zh: TMGBench以144类2×2博弈构造策略推理题，模型读取收益与情境描述，回答均衡或策略组合问题。基础博弈可改写为故事，也可按顺序、并行或嵌套方式组合。
body.en: TMGBench builds reasoning questions from 144 classes of 2×2 games. Models read payoffs and scenario descriptions and answer equilibrium or strategy-combination questions; games may be narrated as stories or composed sequentially, in parallel or by nesting.

body.zh: 研究关注博弈类型覆盖、表述变化下的稳健性、理性推理和心智理论问题，试图通过可扩展组合减少对少数熟悉经典游戏的依赖。
body.en: It studies type coverage, robustness to narrative variation, rational reasoning and theory-of-mind questions through extensible game compositions.

body.zh: 按给定问题的参考策略或均衡答案计算准确率；复杂组合还采用全部子问题均正确的判定。相同数学博弈的故事改写用于比较表述稳健性，结构组合用于比较多层求解表现。
body.en: Accuracy measures agreement with reference strategy or equilibrium answers; composite questions may require every subanswer to be correct. Narrative rewrites compare robustness around the same mathematical game, while structural compositions test multilayer solutions.

body.zh: 评测对象为离线博弈求解，输入是已给定的规则、收益和问题，输出是策略答案。不同版本分别改变语言包装与组合结构，各类准确率保留其题目条件。
body.en: This is offline game solving: inputs provide rules, payoffs and questions, and outputs are strategy answers. Versions vary narrative packaging and compositional structure, with accuracies interpreted within their item conditions.

body.zh: Pgx是用JAX实现、针对GPU与TPU向量化的棋盘游戏模拟器套件，包含国际象棋、将棋、围棋、双陆棋及小型变体，为批量强化学习提供统一状态与合法动作掩码。
body.en: Pgx is a JAX board-game simulator suite vectorized for GPUs and TPUs, including chess, shogi, Go, backgammon and smaller variants, with common state and legal-mask interfaces.

body.zh: 平台研究重点是大规模并行模拟如何加快训练迭代，并用Gumbel AlphaZero展示真实策略学习；吞吐效率与代理棋力分别评价。
body.en: It studies how parallel simulation accelerates training and demonstrates Gumbel AlphaZero learning, separating simulator throughput from policy strength.

body.zh: 成对完整对局经BayesElo估计相对棋力，每款游戏的参考模型锚定1000分；引擎吞吐量另衡量批量模拟效率。策略实验涵盖五种棋盘变体、每任务两次训练运行，评测时每步使用32次搜索。
body.en: Paired full games fit BayesElo strength, with each game’s reference anchored at 1,000; throughput separately measures batched simulation efficiency. Policy experiments cover five board variants with two training runs each and 32 simulations per evaluation move.

body.zh: 模拟器提供当前玩家状态与合法动作掩码，实验使用共同网络和超参数，训练400轮、约1.05亿帧。评级在各游戏内独立拟合，GPU/TPU吞吐测试和策略学习实验对应不同评价对象。
body.en: The simulator provides player-specific state and legal-action masks. Experiments share networks and hyperparameters and train for 400 iterations, about 105 million frames. Ratings are fitted per game; GPU/TPU throughput tests and policy-learning experiments evaluate different objects.

body.zh: Ludii用ludeme这种高层游戏概念描述棋盘规则，将游戏表示为可理解、可扩展的概念结构；引擎可据此生成合法动作并执行完整对局。
body.en: Ludii describes board games through ludemes, high-level game concepts assembled into readable, extensible rule structures. Its engine generates legal moves and executes complete playouts.

body.zh: 平台服务于通用游戏AI、规则设计与游戏历史研究，核心问题是在表达广泛规则的同时兼顾简洁性和计算效率，减少专用引擎间的接口差异。
body.en: It supports general game AI, design and historical research, aiming to combine broad rule expressiveness with concise descriptions and efficient computation.

body.zh: 以单位时间完成的随机完整推演数等性能指标衡量规则解释与状态推进效率。系统论文在可比游戏上将Ludii、GDL推理器和Regular Boardgames进行对照，评分对象是引擎计算性能。
body.en: Completed random playouts per unit time and related performance statistics measure rule-interpretation and state-transition efficiency. The system paper compares Ludii, GDL reasoners and Regular Boardgames on comparable games, evaluating engine computation.

body.zh: ludeme规则描述、合法动作生成和完整对局执行构成通用引擎接口。论文的量化比较集中于运行效率，后续策略训练或比赛由建立在该引擎上的具体实验定义。
body.en: Ludeme descriptions, legal-action generation and complete execution form the general engine interface. Quantitative comparisons in the paper focus on runtime efficiency; downstream policy training and matches are defined by experiments built on that interface.

paragraphs.zh: ludeme规则描述、合法动作生成和完整对局执行构成通用引擎接口。论文的量化比较集中于运行效率，后续策略训练或比赛由建立在该引擎上的具体实验定义。
paragraphs.en: Ludeme descriptions, legal-action generation and complete execution form the general engine interface. Quantitative comparisons in the paper focus on runtime efficiency; downstream policy training and matches are defined by experiments built on that interface.

body.zh: MAgIC将两个社会推理游戏和三个博弈论情境组成多智能体竞赛，模型根据角色私有信息、公开讨论及互动历史作出线索、投票和资源决策。
body.en: MAgIC combines two social-deduction games and three game-theory scenarios. Models use role-private information, discussion and history for clues, votes and resource decisions.

body.zh: 研究以认知、适应、理性与协作等维度描述互动，并加入概率图模型提示方法，探索显式建模其他玩家能否改善判断、欺骗与合作行为。
body.en: It examines cognition, adaptability, rationality and collaboration, using probabilistic graphical modeling prompts to test explicit representations of other players.

body.zh: Chameleon与Undercover报告投票、身份推断、欺骗及角色胜率；公共物品游戏采用三人五轮、七种倍增系数和三席轮换，区分个人收益、最高分胜率与公共返还。
body.en: Chameleon and Undercover report voting, deduction, deception and role wins. The public-goods game uses three players, five rounds, seven multipliers and seat rotation, separating individual payoff, winning and communal returns.

body.zh: 隐藏身份诊断按游戏与角色解释，公共物品任务分别记录个人争胜和群体返还；五种情境共同组成社会互动画像，各指标保留其具体收益与信息条件。
body.en: Hidden-role diagnostics are game/role-specific; public goods separates individual winning and communal return. Five scenarios form an interaction profile with distinct information and payoffs.

body.zh: Agent Island是七名不同模型参与的淘汰与陪审团游戏，代理通过私聊、公开陈述和投票争取生存，最终由淘汰者在候选决赛者间投票。
body.en: Agent Island is a seven-model elimination and jury game. Agents use private chats, public pitches and votes to survive, with eliminated players selecting the eventual winner.

body.zh: 资源以随对手变化的合作、冲突和说服替代固定题库，研究动态竞赛能否保持评测区分度，并利用完整游戏日志分析投票与模型偏好。
body.en: It replaces fixed questions with adaptive cooperation, conflict and persuasion, studying dynamic discrimination and using game logs to analyze voting and model preferences.

body.zh: 获胜频率与Bayesian Plackett–Luce技能后验区间用于排名，描述动态对手池中的相对竞争表现。论文记录49种模型的999局比赛，采用匿名名字、随机抽样与发言顺序及随机平票处理控制位置因素。
body.en: Win frequency and Bayesian Plackett–Luce skill posteriors with intervals rank relative competitive performance in the dynamic pool. The paper records 999 games with 49 models, using anonymous names, random sampling/speaking order and random tie-breaking to control positional factors.

body.zh: Plackett–Luce技能由给定模型池的动态对局拟合，日志同时支持投票与偏好分析；发布资源以游戏记录和分析数据为主，描述完整淘汰与陪审团机制。
body.en: Plackett–Luce skill is fitted to the model pool’s dynamic games. Released logs and analysis data also support voting and preference studies of elimination and jury mechanics.

body.zh: Avalon-ToM-Bench从阿瓦隆的非对称信息机制构建视角受限问题，要求模型判断角色知识、动机及相应推断或行动陈述，而非控制完整游戏。
body.en: Avalon-ToM-Bench derives perspective-constrained questions from Avalon’s asymmetric information, asking models about role knowledge, motives, inferences and actions rather than complete gameplay.

body.zh: 将认识状态与动机状态、推断与行动两条轴交叉，分别检验模型知道他人掌握什么信息、追求什么目标，以及这些判断如何支持后续选择。规则理解对照与隐藏表示分析用于定位错误环节。
body.en: The benchmark crosses epistemic versus motivational states with inference versus action, testing what others know, what they want and how these judgments support choices. Rule-understanding controls and hidden-state analyses locate different sources of error.

body.zh: 按子能力报告二元判断准确率、宏平均F1及各类成绩的宏平均，评价角色视角下陈述判断的正确性。数据含97个场景、408条陈述；规则理解对照、线性探针与激活干预另作机制诊断。
body.en: Binary-judgment accuracy, macro-F1 and macro-averaged category scores measure correctness under the assigned perspective. The data contains 408 statements across 97 scenarios; rule-understanding controls, linear probes and activation interventions provide separate mechanism diagnostics.

body.zh: 97个场景固定角色视角和信息权限，408条陈述作为二元判断样本。生成答案、线性探针与激活干预分别形成行为评价和表示层分析。
body.en: The 97 scenarios fix role perspectives and information permissions, yielding 408 binary judgments. Generated answers, linear probes and activation interventions provide behavioral and representation-level analyses.

body.zh: GPTNT基于Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes，让拆弹员读取炸弹视觉界面、手册专家读取说明，两者通过消息交流，在倒计时结束前共同拆除模块。
body.en: GPTNT uses Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes: a Defuser sees the bomb, an Expert sees the manual, and they exchange messages to disarm modules before a live countdown expires.

body.zh: 研究将信息不对称、沟通歧义与实时压力放在同一任务中，比较模型单独理解说明和异步协作执行时的差距，并分析状态跟踪与错误恢复。
body.en: It combines asymmetric information, ambiguous communication and time pressure, contrasting manual understanding with asynchronous collaboration and examining state tracking and recovery.

body.zh: 十个固定难度2或3的拆弹任务分别统计首次尝试成功率（pass@1）、解决模块数、超时及错误累计导致的爆炸。实时异步模式与暂停计时的同步模式分开报告，以区分任务结果和时序开销。
body.en: Ten fixed difficulty-2/3 missions are scored by first-attempt success (pass@1), modules solved, timeouts and strikeouts. Real-time asynchronous and timer-paused synchronous results are reported separately, exposing the effect of timing overhead.

body.zh: 异步模式保留实时计算与沟通开销，同步模式暂停计时以分析能力组成；ManualVQA提供说明理解的离线参照，交互轨道以成功拆弹为任务终点。
body.en: Asynchronous play includes computation and communication time; synchronous play pauses the clock for analysis. ManualVQA supplies offline manual comprehension, while interaction targets defusal.

body.zh: M3-BENCH以24种混合动机游戏评估语言代理的社会行为，同时保留行动、推理和沟通内容，观察最终收益之外的互动过程。
body.en: M3-BENCH evaluates LLM social behavior in 24 mixed-motive games, retaining actions, reasoning and communication to examine interaction processes beyond final payoff.

body.zh: 框架分为行为轨迹、推理过程与沟通内容三种视角，研究内部分析、对外交流和实际行动是否一致，以及模型能否将推理转化为有效互惠。
body.en: Behavioral, reasoning and communication analyses examine consistency between deliberation, speech and action, including whether models translate reasoning into effective reciprocity.

body.zh: 十轮重复困境示例根据动作轨迹统计合作、条件互惠、报复、宽恕及末轮背叛，衡量合作行为如何随对手历史变化。玩家每轮先交流再选择合作或背叛，双方知道固定时限。
body.en: The ten-round repeated-dilemma example measures cooperation, conditional reciprocity, retaliation, forgiveness and final-round defection from action traces, tracking responses to opponent history. Players communicate before cooperating or defecting and know the fixed horizon.

body.zh: 十轮困境是24种游戏中的一个实例，行为统计直接取自动作序列。推理过程与沟通评分作为独立分析层次，配对对象与评委配置定义相应比较条件。
body.en: The ten-round dilemma is one of 24 games, with behavior statistics derived from actions. Reasoning and communication scores form separate analysis layers, each interpreted under its pairings and judge configuration.

body.zh: MINDGAMES基于TextArena统一四种博弈：Colonel Blotto、重复囚徒困境、Codenames和Secret Mafia，提供交互接口、TrueSkill排名及完整轨迹记录。
body.en: MINDGAMES unifies Colonel Blotto, Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma, Codenames and Secret Mafia on TextArena, with shared interaction, TrueSkill ratings and full trajectory logs.

body.zh: 研究比较隐藏信息信念、重复对手建模、非对称知识合作和持续欺骗，并以比赛数据分析规则遵循及排行榜是否被对手错误主导；MG-Ref提供冻结参考池。
body.en: It examines beliefs, opponent modeling, asymmetric-knowledge cooperation and deception, analyzing rule adherence and error-driven rankings. MG-Ref supplies a frozen reference pool.

body.zh: Blotto示例以对局胜负及TrueSkill相对排名评价策略，非法输入与兵力分配错误另列为规则执行结果。双方同时将固定兵力分配到多个战场，本轮对手分配保持隐藏。
body.en: The Blotto example scores strategy through match outcomes and relative TrueSkill ratings, reporting invalid inputs and allocation errors separately. Players simultaneously distribute a fixed troop budget across battlefields while the opponent’s current allocation remains hidden.

body.zh: 四种游戏分别设置动作验证和比赛阶段；Blotto以版本规定的预算、战场数和轮次组织分配，胜负与错误统计共同刻画策略及规则执行表现。
body.en: The four games have distinct validation and stages. Version-specific Blotto budgets, battlefields and rounds define allocation; outcomes and errors characterize strategy and execution.

body.zh: Multicultural Spyfall让四名非间谍与一名间谍围绕隐藏地点或食物问答：非间谍知道实体并寻找间谍，间谍则试图推断实体且避免暴露。
body.en: Multicultural Spyfall uses four non-spies and one spy in question-based play about a hidden location or food. Non-spies know the entity and seek the spy; the spy infers it while avoiding detection.

body.zh: 研究把文化实体和非英语表达融入动态社会推理，观察语言熟练度、本地知识、规则遵循与策略完整性如何共同影响多模型竞争。
body.en: It introduces culturally specific entities and non-English interaction to study the joint effects of language proficiency, local knowledge, rule following and strategy.

body.zh: 按角色、语言和文化条件统计胜率与Bradley–Terry相对评级，并单独处理格式失败。十轮协议前五轮问答、后五轮允许猜实体及投票，动作按阶段以JSON表达。
body.en: Win rates and Bradley–Terry ratings are stratified by role, language and culture, with formatting failures handled separately. The ten-round protocol uses five Q&A rounds followed by five rounds allowing entity guesses and votes, with phase-specific JSON actions.

body.zh: 五人十轮规则将文化实体、语言与角色权限结合；分角色和分文化结果呈现知识、表达与社会推理在这一具体信息结构中的共同作用。

body.zh: ParliamentBench以Secret Hitler为基础组织五人政府形成与隐藏阵营博弈：玩家提名总理、表决政府、执行政策，并在阶段间讨论。
body.en: ParliamentBench implements five-player government formation and hidden-alignment play based on Secret Hitler, with chancellor nominations, government votes, policy enactment and discussion.

body.zh: 研究通过模型互战、人机对战和在线游戏参照，分析信息不对称下的推理、说服与欺骗一致性，关注玩家是否能长期维持隐藏身份叙事。
body.en: Model, human and online-game comparisons examine reasoning, persuasion and deceptive consistency under asymmetric information, including sustained hidden-role behavior.

body.zh: 阵营胜率评价比赛结果，身份识别准确率、欺骗保持率、政府通过率和局势影响描述推断与互动过程。五人配置为三名自由派、一名法西斯及希特勒，政府投票前和政策后各有一轮随机顺序讨论。
body.en: Faction win rate measures match outcomes; role-recognition accuracy, deception retention, government approval and game-state impact characterize inference and interaction. The five-player setup has three liberals, one fascist and Hitler, with randomized discussions before votes and after policies.

body.zh: 五人角色结构、讨论顺序与指定对手构成实验版本；身份识别、欺骗保持和局势影响为论文定义的辅助诊断，与阵营胜率共同描述完整比赛行为。
body.en: Five-player roles, discussion order and opponents define the version. Paper-defined role recognition, deception retention and impact diagnostics complement faction wins.

body.zh: Social Gym将21种社会游戏组织成多智能体锦标赛，以规则确定的胜负评价协作、协商和对手适应；SPaRTan在游戏后反思轨迹，形成可迁移策略手册。
body.en: Social Gym organizes 21 social games into multi-agent tournaments with rule-decided outcomes. SPaRTan reflects on trajectories to produce transferable playbooks for subsequent games.

body.zh: 研究一方面比较不同模型与角色的社会推理差异，另一方面检查无需更新权重的自博弈、反思及迁移循环能否改善较弱角色表现。
body.en: It compares model- and role-dependent social reasoning and tests whether training-free self-play, reflection and transfer improve weaker roles.

body.zh: 阵营终局胜负和按角色统计的胜率评价狼人杀对局，Bradley–Terry模型将锦标赛结果转换为相对Elo评级。有限状态机组织发言、投票与夜间技能，最多40轮。
body.en: Faction outcomes and role-conditioned win rates score Werewolves play; a Bradley–Terry model converts tournament results into relative Elo ratings. A finite-state machine schedules speech, votes and night abilities for at most 40 rounds.

body.zh: 狼人杀是21游戏中的一个角色化实例，Elo由指定锦标赛池拟合；SPaRTan的手册效果按基础模型、角色及后续游戏分别观察。
body.en: Werewolves is one role-conditioned instance among 21 games. Elo is fitted to the tournament pool; playbook effects are examined by model, role and subsequent game.
