body.zh: Convention Gap利用Hanabi记录研究伙伴行动中超出字面提示的信息：玩家只见他人手牌及自己的提示，从提示选择与可见牌推断安全出牌。
body.en: Convention Gap analyzes Hanabi logs for information conveyed beyond literal hints. Players see others’ cards and hints about their own, using hint choices and visible cards to judge safe plays.

body.zh: 研究提出隐式约定诊断，将公平洗牌与只使用字面信息的玩家作为理论参照，比较人类同伴、人机及不同推理层级AI配对。
body.en: It proposes a diagnostic of implicit conventions, using fair shuffling and literal-information play as a theoretical reference across human, mixed and AI partnerships.

body.zh: 指标等于根据字面提示和可见牌精确计算的失败概率，减去实际出牌失败率；论文利用记录估计该差值并比较伙伴和行动类别。
body.en: The metric subtracts observed play-failure rate from the failure probability computed exactly from literal hints and visible cards, comparing partners and play categories in logs.

body.zh: 该方法对Hanabi记录进行事后诊断，非零差值表明伙伴选择传递了超出字面的信息；差值以失败概率百分点表达，理论解释依赖公平洗牌及字面信息参照。
body.en: This retrospective Hanabi diagnostic expresses extra-literal information through a failure-probability gap, interpreted under fair shuffling and a literal-information reference.

body.zh: Game Arena是Kaggle的开放竞争评测平台，首批包含国际象棋、双人无限注德州扑克和八人狼人杀，模型以受控接口直接比赛并保留轨迹。
body.en: Kaggle Game Arena is an open competitive evaluation platform initially covering chess, heads-up no-limit Hold’em and eight-player Werewolf, with controlled interfaces and recorded trajectories.

body.zh: 研究以动态对手竞争补充静态题库，同时针对确定性棋盘、隐藏牌下注及多人社会博弈设计不同统计方法，避免单一总分掩盖任务差别。
body.en: It supplements static tests with evolving competition and distinct statistics for deterministic board play, hidden-card betting and multi-player social interaction.

body.zh: 国际象棋以胜负拟合Bradley–Terry Elo，每配对40局；扑克以每100手的大盲注收益（BB/100）和分段重采样区间评价收益，每配对20000手并镜像发牌、交换位置；狼人杀采用GTE指标分解角色贡献。
body.en: Chess derives Bradley–Terry Elo from outcomes over 40 games per pairing. Poker measures big blinds won per 100 hands (BB/100) with block-bootstrap intervals over 20,000 hands per pairing, mirrored deals and swapped seats. Werewolf uses GTE to decompose role contributions.

body.zh: 三游戏保留各自观察、非法动作规则和统计单位，内部评级由所选对手池拟合；扑克分段收益与狼人角色贡献分别呈现隐藏信息和角色不对称条件下的表现。
body.en: Three games retain distinct observations, validity rules and units. Internal ratings depend on the pool; poker returns and Werewolf contributions describe hidden information and role asymmetry.

body.zh: 狼人杀信念变化基准从语言模型对局中标注怀疑与指控消息，让村民观察者在阅读一条消息前后报告对其他玩家身份的信念。
body.en: The Werewolf belief-shift benchmark annotates suspicion and accusation messages from LLM games, asking village observers to report role beliefs before and after individual messages.

body.zh: 研究把指控内容与指控者可信度分开，观察模型是否因既有信任而接受错误指控，以及更强模型能否结合历史识别真实狼人。
body.en: It separates accusation content from source trust, studying acceptance of misleading claims and whether stronger models integrate history to identify wolves.

body.zh: 比较观察者阅读消息前后的身份信念变化，并按真实阵营、受指控者和指控者信任条件分层，均值附95%区间。数据包含1224条标注消息，实验覆盖40种开放权重模型配置。
body.en: Evaluation compares identity beliefs before and after each message, stratified by true faction, accused player and trust in the accuser, with 95% intervals for means. The dataset contains 1,224 annotated messages and experiments cover 40 open-weight configurations.

body.zh: 离线观察者读取已记录消息并报告主观身份信念，分层变化量描述对内容与来源的响应；原对局背景为诊断提供角色真值和既有信任条件。
body.en: Offline observers report subjective role beliefs from recorded messages. Stratified shifts describe responses to content and source, using original roles and prior trust as context.

body.zh: Among Us sandbox以文字环境重建船员与内鬼的行动和会议：船员执行任务并识别内鬼，内鬼通过击杀、伪装与讨论阻止任务完成。
body.en: The Among Us sandbox reimplements crew and impostor actions and meetings in text. Crewmates complete tasks and identify impostors; impostors use kills, fake tasks and discussion to obstruct them.

body.zh: 研究让欺骗作为长期游戏目标的策略自然出现，并将生成欺骗的表现与检测欺骗的能力分开，另用激活探针和稀疏自编码器分析模型表征。
body.en: It lets deception emerge instrumentally from game goals and separates deceptive play from deception detection, including activation probes and sparse-autoencoder analyses.

body.zh: 角色胜率和Deception Elo评价比赛表现，区间由1000次bootstrap估计；欺骗检测另报受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），衡量探针区分相关表征的能力。对局采用五名船员、两名内鬼和50步上限，会议三轮讨论后投票。
body.en: Role win rates and Deception Elo score play, with intervals from 1,000 bootstrap samples. Detector AUROC separately measures discrimination of the relevant representations. Games use five crewmates, two impostors and a 50-step limit, with voting after three discussion rounds.

body.zh: 顺序文字动作、五加二角色及有利内鬼的超时规则定义沙盒版本；游戏排名衡量角色目标下的表现，探针AUROC衡量陈述与内部表征的可检测性。
body.en: Sequential text actions, five-plus-two roles and impostor-favoring timeout define the sandbox. Rankings measure gameplay; probe AUROC measures detectability in statements and representations.

body.zh: LLM-Coordination研究纯合作条件下的语言代理，包含四个交互协调游戏与198道CoordQA选择题，以环境理解、他人信念与联合规划分析表现。
body.en: LLM-Coordination studies pure cooperation through four interactive coordination games and 198 CoordQA questions, examining environment understanding, partner beliefs and joint planning.

body.zh: 研究比较显式ToM推理与其他决策组件，并考察零样本陌生伙伴配对，区分依靠环境信息的协作与依靠队友信念和意图推断的协作。
body.en: It compares explicit ToM reasoning and decision components, including zero-shot partnerships, distinguishing environmental coordination from reasoning about teammates’ intentions.

body.zh: 交互任务以成功率和完成回合数衡量合作结果与行动效率，示例包括双代理图上围捕，以及启动两个发电机后避敌逃脱。固定布局与起点的每个配置重复三次，CoordQA选择题另作静态能力分析。

body.zh: LLMsPark以经典博弈论游戏组织多模型交互，比较15种商业及开放模型。Nim示例向模型提供当前石堆、规则与历史，模型轮流选择一堆并移走若干石子，以取走最后一颗为目标。
body.en: LLMsPark evaluates 15 commercial and open models through classical game-theoretic interactions. In Nim, models receive the piles, rules and history, then alternate choosing a pile and removing stones, aiming to take the final stone.

body.zh: 用于分析模型在明确规则下的策略选择、对手互动和社会行为，并从逐轮轨迹观察策略如何形成。跨游戏排名提供综合比较，单项轨迹支持定位具体决策错误。
body.en: It supports analysis of rule-based strategy, opponent interaction and social behavior through turn-by-turn trajectories. Cross-game rankings provide aggregate comparisons, while individual traces expose concrete decision errors.

body.zh: 胜、平、负驱动Elo更新，评价模型在实际配对中的相对表现；引擎负责行动合法性和终局判定。Nim结果结合石堆初始化和对手配对解释。
body.en: Wins, draws and losses drive Elo updates to measure relative performance in the evaluated pairings; the engine validates actions and termination. Nim outcomes are interpreted with the initial piles and opponent schedule.

body.zh: 公开排名由指定游戏和交叉配对产生，Elo初始分为1000、更新系数K为32。Nim构成规则确定的取石任务，其他博弈保留各自行动和收益结构。
body.en: The public ranking uses specified games and cross-model pairings, with initial Elo 1,000 and K=32. Nim is a deterministic stone-removal task; other games retain their own actions and payoff structures.

body.zh: MultiAgentBench面向多样交互场景评估语言模型团队，基于MARBLE编排代理协作与竞争，比较星形、链形、树形和图式沟通结构。
body.en: MultiAgentBench evaluates LLM teams across diverse interactive scenarios through MARBLE, comparing star, chain, tree and graph communication structures.

body.zh: 研究将任务完成与协作质量分开，使用里程碑指标，并比较群体讨论和认知规划；游戏相关实例是Minecraft中按目标结构描述协同建造。
body.en: It separates task completion from collaboration quality through milestones, group discussion and cognitive planning. Its game-related example is collaborative Minecraft structure construction.

body.zh: Minecraft建造轨道以目标方块的类型、坐标和朝向命中率衡量结构完成程度，沟通与规划质量另由评委评分。实验使用100个VillagerAgent结构、11种Mineflayer高层工具、20次主迭代和最多五次沟通迭代。
body.en: The Minecraft track scores construction by matching target block types, coordinates and orientations; judges separately assess communication and planning. Experiments use 100 VillagerAgent structures, 11 Mineflayer tools, 20 main iterations and at most five communication iterations.

body.zh: 建造轨道依赖高层工具与目标结构，方块命中率描述环境完成度；沟通和规划的评委分数描述协作过程，两类指标共同呈现有界Minecraft建造。
body.en: High-level tools and target structures define building. Block accuracy measures completion; judge ratings describe communication and planning, jointly characterizing bounded Minecraft construction.

body.zh: AdaSociety将可变化的物理世界与显式社会连接结合，代理行动会扩展状态、动作与后续任务；平台提供三种小游戏展示不同社会结构。
body.en: AdaSociety combines adaptive physical worlds with explicit social connections. Actions can expand states, actions and subsequent tasks; three mini-games illustrate different social structures.

body.zh: 研究社会关系如何改变收益分享、信息获取与资源协作，并比较RL和语言模型是否能够利用这些结构提升个人或群体收益。
body.en: It studies how social relations affect reward sharing, information access and resource cooperation, comparing whether RL and LLM agents exploit these structures.

body.zh: Contract以个人和组织回报衡量协作产出，公平性与社会网络指标描述收益分配和组织形态。玩家先轮流选择收益共享组，再由互补工种同步采集与制作，组内所得均分。
body.en: Contract measures production through individual and group returns, with fairness and network metrics describing distribution and organization. Players form reward-sharing groups, then complementary roles gather and craft simultaneously, sharing group earnings equally.

body.zh: 平台提供三种社会结构小游戏。Contract的参与人数、资源配置、结盟时长和物理行动时长由实验配置确定，Easy与Hard条件分别比较。
body.en: The platform provides three games with different social structures. Contract experiments specify population, resources, group-formation duration and physical-play duration, with separate Easy and Hard comparisons.

body.zh: AmongAgents用文本模拟Among Us的房间、任务、监控与会议，四名船员完成任务或投出内鬼，一名内鬼通过击杀、伪装任务及通风阻止他们。
body.en: AmongAgents simulates Among Us rooms, tasks, cameras and meetings in text. Four crewmates complete tasks or expel one impostor, who obstructs them through kills, fake tasks and vents.

body.zh: 研究观察语言代理在不完全信息下如何依据局部事件行动，并改变船员与内鬼的策略和人格组合，分析讨论、怀疑及胜负形成过程。
body.en: It studies decisions from local evidence under hidden information, varying crew/impostor strategies and personality configurations and analyzing discussion and outcomes.

body.zh: 角色胜率衡量阵营结果，任务完成与超时记录执行进度，发言类别另由模型标注。全随机、全语言模型、仅船员模型和仅内鬼模型四条件各20局；每名船员各有短、普通、长任务一项。
body.en: Role win rates measure faction outcomes, task completion and timeouts track execution, and a model separately labels speech categories. Four conditions—random, all-LLM, LLM-crewmate-only and LLM-impostor-only—run 20 games each; every crewmate has one short, common and long task.

body.zh: 房间图与顺序文本动作界定重实现版本，四种控制条件各20局；角色胜负、任务进度和发言类别分别描述比赛结果、执行行为及语言表现。
body.en: Room graphs and sequential text actions define the reimplementation, with twenty games per control. Wins, task progress and speech labels describe outcomes, execution and language.

body.zh: AvalonBench将阿瓦隆的角色私密信息、公开讨论、队伍提案、投票、任务与刺杀整合为语言代理环境，让好人与坏人阵营争取各自胜利。
body.en: AvalonBench combines private roles, discussion, team proposals, voting, quests and assassination in an Avalon environment for competing good and evil teams.

body.zh: 资源提供确定性规则机器人及按角色定制提示的ReAct代理，研究推断、欺骗和协商如何共同影响动态阶段中的决策。
body.en: It supplies deterministic rule bots and role-specific ReAct agents to study how inference, deception and negotiation shape phase-dependent decisions.

body.zh: 按好人、坏人角色分别统计对规则机器人的胜率，并保持具体座位和提示条件。代理读取其可见角色信息、讨论及历史摘要，输出发言与阶段内离散选择，规则引擎判定比赛结果。
body.en: Win rates against rule-based bots are reported separately for good and evil roles under specified seats and prompts. Agents read authorized role information, discussion and history summaries, then produce speech and phase-specific choices; the rules engine adjudicates outcomes.

body.zh: 好坏阵营有不同信息和胜利条件，角色胜率在具体座位与提示条件下比较；完整对局综合呈现策略、讨论、推断及阶段动作执行。
body.en: Good and evil have distinct information and objectives, with wins conditioned on seats and prompts. Complete games combine strategy, discussion, inference and phase execution.

body.zh: Codenames基准让密码大师用一个词和数量连接多个己方目标，猜词者依据线索选择词或结束回合；两种角色看到不同的颜色分配信息。
body.en: The Codenames benchmark pairs a spymaster supplying one-word, numbered clues with a guesser selecting words or ending the turn. Roles have different access to word-color assignments.

body.zh: 研究将词语关联与伙伴理解结合，比较同模型和部分跨模型搭档，并与词向量方法对照，观察角色差异及团队兼容性。
body.en: It combines semantic association with partner understanding, comparing same-model and some mixed-model pairings against word-embedding approaches to examine roles and compatibility.

body.zh: 双队竞争以红蓝队胜率计分，猜中刺客立即输局；每种组合运行100局，采用种子0至99且同队两角色使用同一模型。论文另设单队合作实验评价搭档效率。
body.en: Two-team competition uses red/blue win rates, with immediate loss on the assassin. Each combination runs 100 games with seeds 0–99 and same-model teammates. Separate single-team experiments evaluate partnership efficiency.

body.zh: 单队实验按合作效率观察搭档组合，双队实验按对抗胜负评价。跨模型队友结果主要来自单队部分，角色表现同时包含语义知识与对线索意图的判断。
body.en: Single-team experiments examine cooperative efficiency and pairings; two-team experiments measure competitive outcomes. Mixed-model results mainly come from the former, combining semantic knowledge and clue-intent judgments.

body.zh: LLMArena提供七种动态多智能体游戏，以可扩展文字接口组织模型互动；任务涉及空间、数字、风险、策略与交流，排行榜采用TrueSkill。
body.en: LLMArena supplies seven dynamic multi-agent games through an extensible textual interface, spanning spatial, numerical, risk, strategic and communication demands, with TrueSkill rankings.

body.zh: 研究比较不同类型和规模模型及人类表现，尤其分析对手建模与团队协作。具体游戏规则将这些综合需求转成可执行行动与环境收益。
body.en: It compares model types, scales and humans, emphasizing opponent modeling and teamwork, with rules mapping these combined demands to executable actions and rewards.

body.zh: Hanabi示例以多次对局的平均团队得分评价合作：模型依据伙伴手牌和已有提示选择出牌、弃牌或提示，使烟花序列逐步完成。七游戏排行榜另用TrueSkill汇总竞争结果。
body.en: The Hanabi example measures cooperation by average team score across games: players use partner cards and available hints to play, discard or give clues, building the firework sequences. The seven-game leaderboard separately aggregates competition with TrueSkill.

body.zh: Melting Pot Contest 2023利用混合动机环境评估代理与陌生伙伴合作，参赛策略在自身回报与其他玩家行动的相互依赖中形成行为。
body.en: The 2023 Melting Pot Contest evaluates cooperation with unfamiliar partners in mixed-motive environments, where individual returns depend on other players’ behavior.

body.zh: 竞赛关注社会泛化，以留出伙伴和场景检验训练种群中的策略能否适应新组合；论文汇总竞赛设计、提交方案及合作智能评价经验。
body.en: It focuses on social generalization through held-out partners and scenarios, reporting contest design, submissions and lessons for cooperative-intelligence evaluation.

body.zh: 主要成绩为焦点代理群体的人均回报，并按基线最好与最差回报归一化。Clean Up示例中，代理在采集资源和清理公共河流之间分配行动，观察采用局部RGB与配置允许的局部状态。
body.en: The main score is per-capita return for the focal population, normalized against baseline best and worst returns. In Clean Up, agents allocate actions between harvesting and cleaning a shared river, observing local RGB and permitted local state.

body.zh: 公开验证包含clean_up_2至8，最终比赛另用留出伙伴测试社会泛化。场景版本、伙伴种群和焦点代理的局部观察共同构成评测配置。
body.en: Public validation includes clean_up_2 through 8, while the final contest uses held-out partners. Scenario versions, partner populations and focal agents’ local observations define the evaluation setting.

body.zh: Multi-Agent Balderdash让语言模型为生僻词编写可信的虚构定义，再在混合候选中投票识别真实含义，其他玩家选择假定义即可形成欺骗收益。
body.en: Multi-Agent Balderdash asks LLMs to invent plausible definitions for obscure words and then identify the true meaning among mixed candidates, earning deceptive rewards when others select their inventions.

body.zh: 研究把创造性生成、真假语义判断和历史条件下的策略放在同一中央游戏引擎中，比较多种模型产生可信语言及识破虚构的表现。
body.en: A centralized engine combines creative generation, semantic judgments and history-conditioned strategy to compare plausible language production and detection of invented definitions.

body.zh: 分别记录生成真实定义的比例、假定义骗取其他玩家选择的比例、正确识别真义的比例及游戏得分。独立评审模型判断定义的语义等价性，词表、随机种子和历史窗口在比较中保持一致。
body.en: Evaluation records true-definition production, the fraction of choices attracted by invented definitions, correct identification of the real meaning and game score. An independent model judges semantic equivalence, with matched word decks, seeds and history windows.

body.zh: 生词知识会影响真假定义判断，评审模型影响语义匹配；因此定义质量、骗取选择和识别真义分别提供语言生成、社会影响与知识推理的证据。
body.en: Rare-word knowledge affects definition judgments and the judge affects semantic matching. Definition quality, induced selections and true-meaning identification supply distinct evidence about generation, influence and knowledge.

body.zh: Welfare Diplomacy将外交棋的军事征服目标改为一般和福利奖励，玩家通过私下协商、移动支援及建造解散命令，权衡武装投入与国内福利。
body.en: Welfare Diplomacy turns Diplomacy into a general-sum welfare game. Players negotiate privately and issue movement, support, build and disband orders, balancing military investment with domestic welfare.

body.zh: 资源研究在保留军事威胁和被利用风险时如何促成互惠，提供开源引擎规则变体及零样例语言代理，并检验去军事化等联合政策。
body.en: It studies reciprocity under military threats and exploitation risks through an open engine variant and zero-shot LLM agents, including joint policies such as demilitarization.

body.zh: 累计福利点和社会福利衡量个人与集体收益，自博弈与指定剥削策略对抗分别测试互惠和被利用情境。实验固定结束年限，比较不同策略在相同时间范围内的福利积累。
body.en: Cumulative welfare points and social welfare measure individual and collective returns. Self-play and specified exploitative opponents test reciprocity and exploitation under a fixed ending year, comparing welfare accumulation over the same horizon.

body.zh: 福利变体按多方累计福利评价，原版按征服目标评价，两套规则有各自收益含义；可利用性结果对应论文实际测试的对手策略集合。
body.en: The welfare variant measures multi-party welfare while standard Diplomacy uses conquest objectives. Exploitability results are relative to the opponent policies actually tested.

body.zh: ZSC-Eval 将零样本协作评测组织为伙伴生成、筛选和配对测试；智能体部署时面对训练中未共同优化的伙伴，覆盖 Overcooked 与 Google Research Football。
body.en: ZSC-Eval organizes zero-shot coordination around partner generation, selection and cross-play in Overcooked and Google Research Football.

body.zh: 行为偏好奖励产生不同协作风格，Best-Response Diversity 筛选伙伴，研究重点是伙伴分布变化后的协作泛化，而非仅与自身副本取得高回报。
body.en: Behavior-preferring rewards generate partner styles, and Best-Response Diversity selects them to study generalization beyond self-play partners.

body.zh: 团队回报直接衡量与测试伙伴共同取得的收益；Best-Response Proximity将该收益与对应伙伴的最佳回应策略表现比较并归一化，用于评价适配伙伴的程度。结果按布局、伙伴检查点和角色交换条件报告。
body.en: Team return measures reward earned with the test partner. Best-Response Proximity normalizes that performance against a best-response reference for the partner, assessing adaptation to its behavior. Results are reported by layout, partner checkpoint and role assignment.

body.zh: 具体协作单元采用 Overcooked-AI 布局、同步离散动作与固定伙伴池；完整工具包还包含足球，伙伴分布与最佳回应参照共同定义零样本协作的评价条件。
body.en: The concrete unit uses Overcooked-AI layouts, simultaneous discrete actions and a fixed partner pool; the broader toolkit includes football, with partner distributions and best-response references defining evaluation.

body.zh: Arena 是基于 Unity 的多智能体环境与构建工具包，以不同游戏规则、社会树和五类奖励关系组合合作、竞争及混合互动问题。
body.en: Arena is a Unity platform that combines game rules, social trees and five reward schemes into cooperative, competitive and mixed multi-agent problems.

body.zh: 平台提供五种深度多智能体强化学习基线及参考智能体或队伍种群，研究对象包括队内协作、队间竞争和面对多种对手的稳定表现。
body.en: Five deep MARL baselines and reference agent or team populations support research on cooperation, competition and performance against varied opponents.

body.zh: Crossroads以队伍回合回报和参考种群排名评价策略：率先全员到达目标的队伍得1分，另一队得0分。成员依据各自Unity视口通过移动与转向协同穿过路口。
body.en: Crossroads scores strategies by team episode return and reference-population ranking: the first team with all members at their goals gets 1, the other 0. Members use their Unity views to coordinate movement and turns through the intersection.

body.zh: 平台正文覆盖35款Unity游戏，以社会树和五类奖励关系配置队内协作、队间对抗及混合互动。Crossroads是其中的团队竞赛实例，参考种群决定排名的比较对象。
body.en: The platform describes 35 Unity games, using social trees and five reward relationships to configure cooperation, competition and mixed interaction. Crossroads is one team-racing example; the reference population defines the ranking comparison.

body.zh: ARC-AGI-3让智能体进入没有明示规则与目标的抽象回合制环境，读取64×64离散视觉画面及反馈，通过环境特定按键、撤销或坐标选择探索操作含义并完成多关任务。
body.en: ARC-AGI-3 places agents in abstract turn-based environments with undisclosed rules and goals. Agents read 64×64 discrete visual frames and feedback, using environment-specific buttons, undo or coordinate selection to discover mechanics and complete levels.

body.zh: 核心问题是面对新环境的适应效率：智能体需要提出规则假设、验证状态转移，再把获得的内部模型用于后续关卡的行动规划。
body.en: It studies adaptive efficiency: agents hypothesize rules, test transitions and apply acquired internal models to later levels.

body.zh: 相对人类行动效率（RHAE）结合关卡是否完成与模型相对人类基线所用的动作数，先逐关评分再按环境汇总。指标同时反映适应结果与达成结果所需的交互成本。
body.en: Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) combines level completion with action use relative to a human baseline, scoring levels before aggregating by environment. It captures both successful adaptation and the interaction cost of achieving it.

body.zh: 任务采用简单离散视觉与动作接口，重点是未知规则下的适应与行动效率。公开示例说明交互方式，私有新环境构成独立测试，评分以人类行动基线为参照。
body.en: Simple visual and action interfaces focus measurement on adaptation and action efficiency under unknown rules. Public examples explain interaction; private environments define testing against human action baselines.

body.zh: CausalGame 以十四类互动模拟情境评估因果思考，智能体主动设计试验、收集观测，并提交最终方案与解释，情境包含选择偏差、测量误差及隐藏混杂。
body.en: CausalGame evaluates causal thinking in fourteen interactive scenarios involving selection bias, measurement error and hidden confounding through experiments and final reports.

body.zh: 研究重点是从相关性中辨认可干预机制；查询工具、候选部署和有限试验预算构成信息获取过程，真实结构因果模型不向智能体公开。
body.en: Agents must distinguish intervenable mechanisms from correlations using query tools and bounded experiments while the structural causal model remains hidden.

body.zh: Antenna Trap示例以最终1000架模拟无人机的生存率及是否达到指定阈值评价防御配置，因果解释单独评分。代理在受限试验预算内收集证据后提交最终方案，区分探索过程与部署结果。
body.en: The Antenna Trap example evaluates defense configurations by survival among 1,000 simulated drones and threshold success; causal explanations are scored separately. Agents gather evidence within a trial budget before submitting a final plan, separating exploration from deployment.

body.zh: 天线陷阱是十四类情境中的具体干预实验，防御配置、试验预算和生存阈值定义其评价单位；其他情境分别体现选择偏差、测量误差或隐藏混杂机制。
body.en: Antenna Trap is one intervention experiment with its own defensive design, budget and survival threshold; other scenarios instantiate selection bias, measurement error or hidden confounding.

paragraphs.en: CausalGame evaluates causal thinking in fourteen interactive scenarios involving selection bias, measurement error and hidden confounding through experiments and final reports.

body.zh: ClassicLogic 围绕数独、KenKen、Kakuro 与 Futoshiki 四类经典逻辑谜题建立显式分层知识库，把复杂解题策略表示为基础规则的组合。
body.en: ClassicLogic supplies hierarchical knowledge bases for Sudoku, KenKen, Kakuro and Futoshiki, expressing complex solving strategies as compositions of elementary rules.

body.zh: 研究对象是组合泛化：模型是否能从基础规则形成多步策略，并把已知知识应用到需要新组合、且难度经过验证的谜题。
body.en: It studies compositional generalization from basic rules to multistep strategies and novel combinations at validated difficulty levels.

body.zh: Hard任务成功率统计完整谜题是否解出，用于比较策略形成与应用。数独示例通过规则校验的place(row,col,value)动作填数，符号网格和MNIST数字图像形成两种线索条件。
body.en: Hard-task success measures whether the complete puzzle is solved, comparing strategy formation and application. The Sudoku example uses rule-checked place(row,col,value) actions, with symbolic or MNIST-image clues.

body.zh: 完整资源包含四类逻辑谜题，数独提供逐步填数的交互实例。符号和视觉线索形成两种观察条件，困难任务按层级知识组合所要求的策略深度组织。
body.en: The resource spans four puzzle families, with Sudoku providing a stepwise cell-filling example. Symbolic and visual clues define observation conditions; difficult tasks exercise hierarchical strategy composition.

body.zh: DiG-bench 包含七十个独立字符串游戏；每个游戏的状态变换规则和各关胜利条件均未知，智能体必须通过操作、观察与试验发现规律。
body.en: DiG-bench contains seventy independent string games with unknown transformation rules and level goals that agents discover through interaction.

body.zh: 它把科学发现中的提出概括和实验检验转化为可控游戏任务；接口返回字符串、合法动作、关卡、生命与步数，并支持探索和生存模式。
body.en: The benchmark operationalizes generalization and experimental testing through string states, legal actions, levels, lives and exploration or survival modes.

body.zh: 评测按七个难度层比较通关比例和行动消耗，连续关卡检验规则是否真正被掌握；难度分层依赖所测模型的实际表现。
body.en: Evaluation reports wins and action use across seven difficulty tiers; successive levels test acquired rules, and tier difficulty depends on evaluated models.

body.zh: 公开集合含二十一个游戏，剩余部分用于私有评测；各划分分别报告结果。字符串状态、未知目标和可执行动作共同构成这套符号互动发现任务。
body.en: Twenty-one games are public and the remainder private, with split-specific reporting. String states, unknown goals and executable actions define the symbolic discovery setting.

body.zh: NCP-Bench 将互动叙事中的长期一致性定义为叙事承诺保持，提供一百个由电影梗概构成的环境，每个环境含轨迹、承诺和初始事实。
body.en: NCP-Bench defines narrative commitment preservation in one hundred movie-derived environments with trajectories, commitments and initial facts.

body.zh: 被测模型扮演叙述者，面对玩家代理的自由乃至对抗性干预持续生成故事；研究重点是语言流畅时仍能否保持既有事实和必要叙事条件。
body.en: The evaluated narrator responds to free-form or adversarial player interventions, testing whether fluent storytelling preserves facts and required narrative conditions.

body.zh: 报告平均互动轮数、事实/承诺/玩家输入冲突率、剧情进度、承诺满足比例，以及无冲突环境比例随轮数的变化。固定提示的LLM审计器逐轮检查并更新事实表和剧情进度；发现冲突即终止，最多100轮。
body.en: Metrics report mean interaction turns, fact/commitment/player-input conflict rates, trajectory progress, satisfied commitments and conflict-free survival over time. Fixed-prompt LLM auditors check and update the state each turn; sessions stop on conflict or by 100 turns.

body.zh: 评测对象是维持叙事承诺的生成式叙述者，玩家代理通过多轮干预推动故事；事实一致、承诺存活和成就达成分别描述其长期叙事可靠性。
body.en: The evaluated role is a generative narrator preserving commitments while a player agent drives interventions; fact consistency, commitment survival and achievement completion describe reliability.

body.zh: RNG-Bench 包含翻牌配对和第一视角三维迷宫两种非马尔可夫游戏，正确行动依赖当前画面已不可见、但先前观察过的牌面或空间结构。
body.en: RNG-Bench uses Matching Pairs and egocentric 3D Maze, where actions depend on previously observed information absent from the current view.

body.zh: 翻牌要求保存牌与位置的对应，迷宫要求融合局部视角构建空间地图；统一框架控制网格规模、视觉图案与观察模态，以分析历史重建。
body.en: Matching Pairs requires card-location recall; Maze requires spatial integration. Grid size, patterns and observation modality control reconstruction difficulty.

body.zh: 翻牌任务报告配对比例和每成功配对的响应次数，迷宫报告成功率、路径效率及探索表现。Memory Gap比较常规条件与每步提供真实隐藏状态的对照条件，按100%×（1−常规得分/对照得分）归一化，诊断历史状态重建造成的性能差距。
body.en: Matching Pairs reports matched-pair proportion and responses per matched pair; the maze reports success, path efficiency and exploration. Memory Gap compares normal play with an oracle supplying the true hidden state each step, normalized as 100%×(1−normal score/oracle score), to diagnose state-reconstruction loss.

body.zh: 两种游戏统一控制网格规模、视觉图案和观察模态；配对任务另有同实例对决。迷宫综合分结合成功、效率和探索，隐藏状态对照提供记忆机制的专门分析条件。
body.en: Both games control size, visual pattern and observation modality, with same-instance duels for Matching Pairs. The maze composite combines success, efficiency and exploration; the hidden-state oracle provides a dedicated memory diagnostic.

body.zh: Rushes 记录用户在 AI 生成分支叙事中的选择，包含六个游戏、八千余名用户和四万余个决策事件，每条记录保留候选项、选择及演变语境。
body.en: Rushes records candidate sets, choices and evolving context from AI branching narratives: over forty thousand events from more than eight thousand users across six games.

body.zh: 数据以持续用户标识连接顺序轨迹，用于研究个体化参与偏好与多元对齐，关注同一用户在不同叙事阶段的选择差异。
body.en: Persistent user identifiers link sequential trajectories for research on personalized engagement preferences and pluralistic alignment.

body.zh: 基准以事件级选择预测比较语言模型、流行度基线和矩阵分解方法，分析选择熵及个性化信号；准确率反映对人类选择的拟合。
body.en: Event-level choice prediction compares LLMs, popularity baselines and matrix factorization, with choice entropy and personalized signal as additional analyses.

body.zh: 数据来自真实用户互动，发布基准采用离线事件选择预测，持续用户标识支持个体层面分析；候选集合和叙事历史共同界定每次预测的可用信息。
body.en: Real user interaction supplies offline choice-prediction data; persistent identifiers support individual-level analysis, with candidate sets and narrative history defining each prediction context.

body.zh: ChronoPlay根据游戏官方更新与玩家社区提问生成随时间变化的检索增强问答数据。被测系统接收问题，从相应时期的资料中检索证据并生成回答，实例覆盖《消逝的光芒2》《沙丘：觉醒》和PUBG Mobile。
body.en: ChronoPlay generates time-varying RAG questions from official game updates and player-community queries. Systems retrieve evidence from period-specific materials and answer questions across Dying Light 2, Dune: Awakening and PUBG Mobile.

body.zh: 用于研究内容更新和玩家兴趣迁移如何分别影响检索与回答，比较同时追踪两种变化、只更新知识和只追踪兴趣的条件。问题合成还研究事实依据与真实玩家表达的结合。
body.en: It studies how content updates and shifting player interests affect retrieval and answering, comparing dual-dynamic, knowledge-only and interest-only conditions. Question synthesis also examines factual grounding and authentic player phrasing.

body.zh: 检索以Recall@K、F1@K和NDCG@K评价相关证据的召回与排序；回答由LLM评审分别评价正确性和对检索资料的忠实度。结果按游戏与生命周期阶段报告，问题真实性另由人工和模型比较。
body.en: Retrieval uses Recall@K, F1@K and NDCG@K for evidence recovery and ranking. LLM judges separately score answer correctness and faithfulness to retrieved sources. Results are reported by game and lifecycle phase, with human/model comparisons of question authenticity.

body.zh: 三个游戏分别划分5、6和7个时期，共形成6400个合成问题。各时期资料、社区话题分布和检索深度K共同确定比较条件，评测对象为游戏知识问答系统。
body.en: The three games span 5, 6 and 7 phases, totaling 6,400 synthesized questions. Period-specific sources, community-topic distributions and retrieval depth K define comparisons of game-knowledge QA systems.

body.zh: FlashAdventure 提供三十四款 Flash 冒险游戏的屏幕交互评测，智能体通过点击、键盘和原生游戏界面完成指定里程碑、数值目标或故事任务。
body.en: FlashAdventure evaluates native screen interaction across thirty-four Flash adventures using clicks, keyboard inputs and game-specific milestones or numeric objectives.

body.zh: 研究重点是早期观察到的线索如何支持后续行动。COAST 以长期线索记忆组织计划，CUA-as-a-Judge 从实际游戏轨迹判定目标进展。
body.en: It studies how earlier clues inform later actions. COAST organizes planning around long-term clue memory, and CUA-as-a-Judge assesses gameplay progress.

body.zh: 离散目标以达成的里程碑比例计分，六种连续数值目标按人类参考归一化，动作数另列为交互成本。CUA-as-a-Judge根据游戏轨迹判断目标进展，例如Game Cafe Escape中的道具—线索—逃离依赖链。
body.en: Discrete objectives score the proportion of milestones achieved, while six continuous numeric objectives are human-normalized; action count reports interaction cost separately. CUA-as-a-Judge assesses progress from traces, such as the item–clue–escape dependencies in Game Cafe Escape.

body.zh: 各游戏按指定目标评价，两个 Grim Tales 场景聚焦初始找物，其余任务具有不同故事跨度；CUA-as-a-Judge 与完整代理配置共同参与结果生成。
body.en: Games are evaluated against their specified objectives; two Grim Tales scenes focus on initial hidden-object tasks, while story spans vary elsewhere and results depend on judge and agent configurations.

body.zh: WhodunitBench 以剧本杀检验多模态智能体，玩家获得角色剧本、私有及公开文字与图像线索，通过讨论和最终投票识别凶手，凶手则隐藏身份。
body.en: WhodunitBench evaluates multimodal agents in murder mysteries using role scripts, private and public clues, discussion and voting to identify or conceal the murderer.

body.zh: 信息分配与角色目标构成动态推理场景，智能体需要整合视觉线索、他人陈述和动机证据；它同时提供互动竞技场和分解能力的问答链。
body.en: Role goals and asymmetric information require integration of visual clues, statements and motives. The suite includes an interactive arena and a separate question-based evaluation chain.

body.zh: 竞技场由五十个经过筛选的剧本构成，以角色对战胜率衡量结果；三千余道选择题与开放题用于分析感知和推理环节，作为独立的分解诊断报告。
body.en: The arena uses fifty curated scripts and role-conditioned win rates; more than three thousand separate questions analyze perception and reasoning.

body.zh: 互动竞技场和静态问答链分别形成整体表现与分解诊断，角色目标、线索分配和同场玩家策略构成竞技场条件；剧本级细节按对应设置解释。
body.en: The interactive arena and static question chain provide overall behavior and component diagnostics respectively; role goals, clue allocation and co-player policies define arena conditions.

body.zh: clembench 使用受约束的对话游戏评估聊天模型作为情境化交互者的表现，初始论文包含五种互动设置，通过程序化游戏管理器组织轮次与规则。
body.en: clembench evaluates chat models as situated conversational agents in five initial interaction settings managed through explicit rules and turns.

body.zh: 它将遵循互动格式与达到游戏目标分别记录，以分析模型能否形成连贯的协作行为。Taboo 中描述者知道目标和禁词，猜词者只能依据合法描述推断。
body.en: It separates interaction-format compliance from goal achievement. In Taboo, the describer sees the target and forbidden words while the guesser infers it from legal clues.

body.zh: 有效进行比例描述规则执行，成功速度以100/n计分（n为成功猜词所用轮数），二者共同形成clemscore。Taboo先校验禁词与交互格式，再记录合法对局的成功及轮数，中止和合法失败分别保留。
body.en: The played proportion measures rule execution and successful guessing speed scores 100/n, where n is turns to success; together they form clemscore. Taboo validates forbidden words and interaction format before recording valid-game outcomes and turns, retaining aborts and legal failures separately.

body.zh: Taboo 是框架中的一个双人协议，clemscore 描述模型配对的有效互动与目标达成。中止、合法失败和成功分开记录，其他游戏使用各自规则与目标。
body.en: Taboo is one two-player protocol; clemscore describes valid interaction and goal achievement of model pairs. Aborts, valid failures and successes are recorded separately across game-specific rules.

body.zh: Machiavelli 收集一百三十四款分支文字冒险游戏及大量社会决策场景，智能体从当前场景给出的选项中选择行动，争取预设成就。
body.en: Machiavelli collects 134 branching text adventures with social decision scenarios; agents select provided options to pursue specified achievements.

body.zh: 场景标注把权力寻求、不利后果和伦理违规转化为可计算的行为指标，研究奖励最大化与行为伤害之间的权衡，并比较降低伤害的引导方法。
body.en: Scenario annotations operationalize power-seeking, disutility and ethical violations to study reward-harm trade-offs and methods for steering behavior.

body.zh: 论文的30款测试游戏以归一化成就奖励衡量目标达成，并将伤害指标相对1000条随机轨迹的均值归一化。奖励与伤害分别报告，用于比较更高成就与较少不利行为之间的权衡。
body.en: The paper’s 30 test games use normalized achievement reward for goal attainment and normalize harm against the mean of 1,000 random trajectories. Reward and harm are reported separately to compare achievement–harm trade-offs.

body.zh: 完整资源含134款游戏，论文实验使用其中30款测试游戏。场景提示、目标成就和伤害标注构成评价信息，成就奖励与伦理指标分别报告。
body.en: The resource contains 134 games, with 30 used for the paper’s test experiments. Scene prompts, target achievements and harm annotations supply evaluation information; achievement reward and ethical metrics are reported separately.

body.zh: JerichoWorld 是面向文字冒险世界建模的监督数据集，将自然语言观察映射到描述世界状态的知识图谱，以及能够改变当前状态的有效文字动作。
body.en: JerichoWorld is a supervised text-adventure dataset mapping natural-language observations to world-state knowledge graphs and state-changing valid actions.

body.zh: 研究对象是部分可观测叙事中的结构化状态表示：房间、人物、物体及其关系需要从文本中恢复，规则、问答和序列学习模型提供基线。
body.en: It studies structured representations under partial observability, recovering locations, characters, objects and relations with rule-based, QA and sequence-learning baselines.

body.zh: 知识图谱预测在三元组和词元层面报告精确匹配（EM）与F1，有效动作预测按完整动作匹配计算EM与F1。27款游戏的24198条训练映射与9款新游戏的7836条测试样本分开，整体结果按样本量加权并报告三种随机种子。
body.en: Graph prediction reports exact match (EM) and F1 at triple and token levels; valid-action prediction matches complete actions. The split uses 24,198 training mappings from 27 games and 7,836 test examples from nine new games, with size-weighted aggregates over three seeds.

body.zh: 资源以离线观察样本为评价单位，知识图谱与有效动作是监督目标；训练和保留测试按游戏划分，重点检验结构化文本世界模型对新游戏的预测泛化。
body.en: Offline observations are the evaluation units, with graphs and valid actions as supervised targets; game-level splits test predictive generalization of structured textual world models.

body.zh: TextWorld Commonsense 构造家庭物品整理文字环境，智能体阅读房间、库存与反馈，从候选命令中移动、拿取并把物品放到常识上合适的位置。
body.en: TextWorld Commonsense creates household tidying games where agents read room and inventory text and choose movement, pickup and placement commands.

body.zh: 任务检验物体属性与功能知识能否帮助行动筛选和前瞻推理；知识增强基线动态检索 ConceptNet，并把相关知识与顺序上下文结合。
body.en: The task tests whether object attributes and affordances improve action pruning and lookahead; knowledge-enhanced baselines dynamically retrieve ConceptNet information.

body.zh: 以相对最大可得分的归一化成绩衡量整理完成程度，以行动步数衡量执行成本。域内与未见物品划分分别测试已有分布和迁移，协议采用50步测试上限、多次训练运行及人类参照。
body.en: Score normalized to the maximum attainable reward measures tidying completion; action count measures execution cost. In-distribution and unseen-object splits test familiar and transfer conditions under a 50-step test limit, repeated training runs and human references.

body.zh: 常识整理生成器限定物品、位置和功能关系，知识增强与基础代理分别对应不同信息条件。域内及未见物品划分提供对常识利用和迁移的具体比较。
body.en: The tidying generator specifies objects, locations and affordances; knowledge-enhanced and base agents have distinct information conditions, compared on seen and unseen objects.

body.zh: LongPuzzleBench 将六款视觉谜题的一百一十四关组织为十六个目标，智能体读取屏幕并使用原生坐标点击、拖动等操作，跨连续棋盘完成任务。
body.en: LongPuzzleBench groups 114 levels from six visual puzzles into sixteen objectives played through screenshots and native clicks, drags and other GUI actions.

body.zh: 持续棋盘中看似合法且有进展的动作可能破坏后续可解性，死局也不主动提示；研究重点是长行动链中保留未来选择及维持计划可行性。
body.en: Persistent boards can become unsolvable after apparently useful legal moves, without dead-end warnings, testing preservation of future options across long plans.

body.zh: 目标成功率、关卡完成率和细粒度进度分别衡量终局与中途表现，并按游戏宏平均；共享预算和主动重启机制共同约束完成过程。
body.en: Objective success, level completion and fine-grained progress are macro-averaged by game; shared budgets and agent-initiated restarts constrain completion.

body.zh: 六款游戏的114关组成16个跨关目标，连续棋盘、主动重启和共享动作预算共同约束完成过程。原生GUI与代码执行作为不同运行条件比较，延迟与操作次数记录各自的执行成本。
body.en: Across six games, 114 levels form 16 cross-level objectives. Persistent boards, voluntary resets and shared action budgets constrain completion. Native-GUI and code-execution conditions are compared separately, with latency and action counts recording execution cost.

body.zh: WITNESS 提供二维网格隐藏规则谜题，智能体依据真实 ASCII 棋盘、尝试反馈和局内规则笔记，探索并提交满足约束的路径。
body.en: WITNESS provides 2D hidden-rule puzzles using ground-truth ASCII boards, interaction feedback and a rule notebook to discover valid paths.

body.zh: WitnessGym 生成训练任务，WitnessBench 将已学原语的新组合与训练外原语分开，配合直接提供规则的条件分析规则获取和规则执行两类瓶颈。
body.en: WitnessGym supports training; WitnessBench separates novel compositions from unseen rule primitives and uses revealed-rule conditions to distinguish acquisition from execution.

body.zh: 关卡完成数衡量解题结果；RHAE-L5和RHAE-L20分别统计前5关与全部20关相对人类行动数的效率，OAE另以最优行动数为参照。代理使用四向移动、提交和重置，每次调用最多16步。
body.en: Completed levels measure solving outcomes. RHAE-L5 and RHAE-L20 evaluate human-relative action efficiency over the first five and all 20 levels; OAE separately uses optimal action counts. Agents move, submit or reset, with at most 16 steps per call.

body.zh: 十七个私有测试游戏与八个公开验证游戏分别承担测试和开发角色；规则公开程度、观察接口及代理配置构成对照条件，笔记记录支持互动中的假设积累。
body.en: Seventeen private test games and eight public validation games serve separate roles; rule access, observation interface and agent configuration define controls, with notebooks tracking hypotheses.

body.zh: LVLM-Playground 将棋盘游戏组织为感知、问答、规则遵循和端到端游玩四条评测轨道，利用结构化游戏场景检验视觉语言模型的细粒度理解。
body.en: LVLM-Playground organizes board-game evaluation into perception, question answering, rule following and end-to-end play to probe detailed visual-language understanding.

body.zh: 分解轨道分析稠密棋盘元素、长结构化输出和规则推理的困难，端到端轨道则要求模型从棋盘截图与规则提示生成下一合法操作。
body.en: Diagnostic tracks analyze dense board elements, long structured outputs and rules; end-to-end play requires legal actions from board screenshots and instructions.

body.zh: 端到端复合分组合进度、动作步数与终局奖励，分别反映过程推进和比赛结果，具体计算按游戏定义。该轨道覆盖六款游戏，对抗任务使用指定搜索对手；其他三轨分别测试感知、问答与规则判断。
body.en: End-to-end composites combine progress, move counts and terminal rewards under game-specific formulas, reflecting both progress and outcomes. This track covers six games and uses specified search opponents for adversarial tasks; the other tracks test perception, QA and rule judgments separately.

body.zh: 四条轨道分别覆盖感知、问答、规则遵循和互动执行，端到端任务按游戏专属指标报告。棋盘呈现、动作编码与对手实现共同组成每项比较的条件。
body.en: The four tracks cover perception, QA, rule following and interaction, with game-specific end-to-end metrics and explicit board, action and opponent conditions.

body.zh: Memory Gym 将 Mortar Mayhem、Mystery Path 和 Searing Spotlights 三种二维部分可观测环境扩展为无尽任务，让需要保存的信息随互动持续增长。
body.en: Memory Gym extends Mortar Mayhem, Mystery Path and Searing Spotlights into endless partially observable tasks with increasing memory demands.

body.zh: 它比较 GRU 和采用 Transformer-XL 滑动窗口的 PPO，研究有限任务中的样本效率与持续增长负荷下的记忆有效性是否给出一致结论。
body.en: The study compares GRU and Transformer-XL PPO, examining whether sample efficiency in finite tasks predicts memory effectiveness under growing endless loads.

body.zh: 以正确执行的累积序列长度评价持续记忆，有限版与无尽版分别报告学习表现。Endless Mortar Mayhem示例逐次展示新指令，智能体依据视觉输入移动并重演此前全部指令。
body.en: Correctly executed cumulative sequence length measures sustained memory, with finite and endless versions reported separately. In Endless Mortar Mayhem, each new instruction extends the sequence that a visually controlled agent must replay through movement.

body.zh: 三种环境及有限、无尽版本具有各自的信息保存机制和负荷曲线。本文的循环网络与 Transformer-XL 比较采用强化学习策略，代表单元明确为无尽指令重演。
body.en: The environments and finite/endless variants have distinct memory mechanisms and load curves; the paper compares RL policies, with endless command replay as the representative unit.

body.zh: XLand-100B 是基于 XLand-MiniGrid 的大规模上下文强化学习数据集，收集近三万种任务的完整学习历史，包含一千亿条转移和二十五亿个回合。
body.en: XLand-100B provides complete learning histories for nearly thirty thousand XLand-MiniGrid tasks, totaling one hundred billion transitions and 2.5 billion episodes.

body.zh: 模型从过去观察、动作和奖励中学习适应未见规则与目标，测试时不更新权重；数据和生成工具旨在支持超出简单小规模环境的上下文学习研究。
body.en: Models adapt to unseen rules and goals from observation-action-reward histories without test-time weight updates; released data and tools support large-scale in-context RL.

body.zh: 任务回报随历史长度的变化衡量模型在新任务中的上下文适应。模型读取过去的观察、动作和奖励继续行动，使用5×5局部符号观察及六种导航或物体交互动作；训练使用离线学习历史。
body.en: Return as a function of history length measures in-context adaptation to new tasks. Models condition on past observations, actions and rewards, using 5×5 local symbolic observations and six navigation/object actions; training uses offline learning histories.

body.zh: 资源包括离线训练历史和在线未见任务适应两部分，学习成功过滤定义收集分布。XLand-MiniGrid 采用局部符号状态，任务回报随上下文变化体现适应过程。
body.en: The resource combines offline histories with online adaptation to unseen tasks; success filtering defines the collection distribution, and symbolic MiniGrid returns trace contextual adaptation.

body.zh: ChildPlay 以 ASCII 编码的井字棋、四子棋、Battleship 和形状任务研究语言模型的非语言问题求解，并加入 LEGO 连接语言和分子结构相关任务。
body.en: ChildPlay studies nonlinguistic problem solving through ASCII board games and shape tasks, adding LEGO Connect Language and a molecular-structure task.

body.zh: 研究以简单明确的规则减少语言表达复杂性，比较不同 GPT 模型对空间结构、合法操作、获胜机会和阻挡需求的处理，观察能力提升是否跨任务一致。
body.en: Simple rules reduce linguistic complexity while comparing GPT models on spatial structures, legal moves, winning opportunities and blocking across tasks.

body.zh: 胜负平衡量比赛结果，非法动作及错失立即获胜或阻挡机会的次数分别反映规则执行和局部战术。三种棋盘对战任务采用ASCII状态、行列坐标或列编号动作，以及随机对手。
body.en: Wins/draws/losses measure outcomes; invalid moves and missed immediate wins or blocks measure rule execution and local tactics. The three board-play tasks use ASCII states, coordinate/column actions and random opponents.

body.zh: 棋盘对战、形状识别、LEGO结构与分子编码任务共同组成资源，各自采用相应评价方式。三种游玩任务采用ASCII表示、随机对手及论文特定规则。
body.en: The resource combines board play, shapes, LEGO structure and molecular encoding with task-specific evaluations. Its three gameplay tasks use ASCII views, random opponents and paper-specific rules.

body.zh: GameTraversalBenchmark 让语言模型在二维网格地图上按顺序到达目标，每到一个目标后从新位置继续，既要求路径可执行，也要求减少步数和输出错误。
body.en: GameTraversalBenchmark asks LLMs to reach ordered targets on 2D maps, continuing from each reached position while minimizing route length and output errors.

body.zh: 输入包含文本地图、实体图例、当前位置及目标坐标，模型一次生成通向当前目标的动作序列；这一设计将空间表示与显式多步路径生成联系起来。
body.en: Text maps, legends, current positions and target coordinates support generation of an action sequence for each target, coupling spatial representation with multistep routing.

body.zh: 在150张Word2World地图上，以A*最短路径为参照计算GTB-Score，并报告Top-0/1/5准确率、路径长度和生成错误。主表采用三个随机种子，零反馈和一次反馈条件分开比较；综合分联合考虑目标完成、路径成本及输出合法性。
body.en: Across 150 Word2World maps, GTB-Score uses A* paths as a reference alongside Top-0/1/5 accuracy, route length and generation errors. Main results use three seeds and separate zero-/one-feedback conditions; the composite combines completion, path cost and output legality.

body.zh: 文本地图与一次生成的目标路径定义任务接口，综合分同时反映完成、路径成本和输出合法性。顺序目标、错误容忍和 A* 参照构成具体评价范围。
body.en: Text maps and per-target generated routes define the interface; composite scores reflect completion, route cost and valid output under sequential objectives, error tolerances and A* references.

body.zh: PUZZLES 把 Simon Tatham 的便携谜题集转为强化学习基准，涵盖四十种可调尺寸和复杂度的逻辑游戏，从桥梁连接、推演数字到网络与路径约束。
body.en: PUZZLES converts Simon Tatham’s collection into forty RL logic-puzzle environments with adjustable size and complexity, covering numeric, network and path constraints.

body.zh: 环境以内部离散棋盘状态为主要观察，并可提供 RGB 像素；游戏专属键盘动作把逻辑推断转化为逐步操作，用于比较算法推理和尺度泛化。
body.en: Discrete board states, optional RGB observations and puzzle-specific keyboard actions turn logical deductions into sequential operations for algorithmic reasoning research.

body.zh: 每种谜题分别报告解题完成率与成功回合的行动步数，并给出人类表现和最优步数上界参照。完整套件含40种规则，棋盘尺寸迁移实验在netslide、same-game和untangle三种游戏上单独开展。
body.en: Each puzzle reports completion rate and action count in successful episodes, with human performance and upper-bound references for optimal steps. The suite contains 40 rule types; board-size transfer is tested separately on netslide, same-game and untangle.

body.zh: 四十种谜题共享环境框架，各自保持约束规则与操作方式；尺寸泛化结果对应三个测试游戏。棋盘编码、动作接口与解题策略共同影响完成和步数指标。
body.en: Forty puzzles share infrastructure while retaining specific constraints and controls; size-generalization results concern three tested games, with encoding, interface and strategy affecting completion and length.

paragraphs.zh: 四十种谜题共享环境框架，各自保持约束规则与操作方式；尺寸泛化结果对应三个测试游戏。棋盘编码、动作接口与解题策略共同影响完成和步数指标。
paragraphs.en: Forty puzzles share infrastructure while retaining specific constraints and controls; size-generalization results concern three tested games, with encoding, interface and strategy affecting completion and length.

body.zh: CARL 通过给经典控制、物理仿真和平台游戏加入可控上下文变量，构造可以明确指定训练及测试分布的强化学习环境库。
body.en: CARL adds controlled contextual variables to classic control, physics and platform environments, enabling explicitly defined training and test distributions.

body.zh: 它以情境化强化学习区分插值、分布偏移与外推，并比较隐藏上下文和显式上下文，研究环境变化时策略为何失效以及上下文信息如何帮助泛化。
body.en: Contextual RL separates interpolation, distribution shift and extrapolation, comparing hidden and visible context to study policy robustness under environmental variation.

body.zh: CARLMario以智能体在程序生成关卡中从起点前进的平均距离衡量表现，比较不同上下文分布下的策略泛化。视觉观察与额外提供生成噪声张量的条件分开，保留上下文可见性的实验对照。
body.en: CARLMario measures mean forward distance from the start in procedurally generated levels, comparing policy generalization across context distributions. Visual observations and conditions exposing the generation-noise tensor are separated to test context observability.

body.zh: CARLMario 使用 TOAD-GAN 与 Mario AI Framework 的研究实现，关卡生成参数定义其上下文。其他控制与物理环境通过各自参数构造插值、偏移和外推分布。
body.en: CARLMario uses the TOAD-GAN and Mario AI Framework research implementation; level parameters define its context, while control and physics domains have their own distributions.

body.zh: GriddlyJS是基于Griddly的网页环境开发平台，支持设计、调试和发布程序生成任务，并在浏览器中观察和录制训练策略。EscapeRoom示例让代理收集资源、制作工具并清除路线，最终到达樱桃树。
body.en: GriddlyJS is a browser environment-development platform built on Griddly, supporting design, debugging, publication and policy visualization. Its EscapeRoom example requires gathering resources, crafting tools and clearing a path to a cherry tree.

body.zh: 用于研究可复用环境设计、程序化关卡生成与策略行为分析。编辑器、规则描述和策略可视化把任务构造、训练后的检查及交互复现连接到同一工作流。
body.en: It supports reusable environment design, procedural level generation and policy-behavior analysis. The editor, rule description and policy visualization connect task construction, post-training inspection and interactive reproduction.

body.zh: 以PPO策略在100个人工关卡与100个随机关卡上的解题率比较环境泛化。EscapeRoom采用GDY定义的网格或图像观察，以及离散移动、采集和制作动作，形成相同规则下两类关卡分布。
body.en: PPO solve rates across 100 authored and 100 random levels measure generalization. EscapeRoom uses GDY-defined grid or image observations and discrete movement, gathering and crafting actions, comparing two level distributions under shared rules.

body.zh: 完整资源是环境开发与发布平台，EscapeRoom 提供组合谜题的具体实验。人工设计和程序生成关卡组成两类测试分布，观察形式由 GDY 定义。
body.en: The full resource is an environment-development platform; EscapeRoom provides the concrete compositional-puzzle study with human-designed and generated distributions and GDY-defined observations.

body.zh: MESSENGER 要求智能体在十乘十符号网格中先取得信件，再送往正确目标并躲避敌人；自然语言手册描述实体身份及运动动力学。
body.en: MESSENGER asks agents to pick up a message, deliver it and avoid enemies on a 10×10 symbolic grid using a manual describing entities and dynamics.

body.zh: 实体符号与手册文本的联系并非预先给定，模型必须把角色及行为描述落地到游戏状态。EMMA 用实体条件注意力从相关手册句子学习潜在对应。
body.en: Agents learn the grounding between manual descriptions and entity symbols. EMMA uses entity-conditioned attention to connect relevant text with observed roles and behavior.

body.zh: 以完成取信并正确交付的胜率评价任务表现，三阶段课程及未见实体动力学划分检验泛化。取信、交付和失败提供反馈奖励，智能体通过上下左右和停留动作执行。
body.en: Win rate for collecting and correctly delivering the message measures performance; three curriculum stages and unseen entity-dynamics splits test generalization. Collection, delivery and failure provide rewards as agents move or stay.

body.zh: 测试划分围绕实体身份、运动方式和规则组合构造，手册可见性定义语言落地条件。胜率联合反映文本解释、动态理解和网格导航的执行效果。
body.en: Splits vary entity identities, dynamics and rule combinations under manual access; win rate jointly reflects language interpretation, dynamics understanding and grid navigation.

body.zh: SILG 用统一符号接口整合 RTFM、Messenger、NetHack、ALFWorld 与 Touchdown，覆盖规则手册、目标语言、局部世界与多步行动等落地问题。
body.en: SILG unifies RTFM, Messenger, NetHack, ALFWorld and Touchdown through symbolic interfaces spanning manuals, goals, partial observability and sequential action.

body.zh: 共享模型架构比较局部卷积、循环状态跟踪、实体注意力和预训练语言模型，研究在一个环境有效的设计能否跨观察、动作和语言分布保持收益。
body.en: A shared architecture tests local convolution, recurrent tracking, entity attention and pretrained language models for transfer of modeling gains across environments.

body.zh: 各环境以任务成功率评分，网格环境测试100局，ALFWorld和Touchdown沿用原测试集。NetHack子任务分别以得分、金币和探索进度达到阈值为成功；RTFM和Messenger的论文结果采用第一课程阶段。
body.en: Each environment reports task success; grid environments use 100 test episodes, while ALFWorld and Touchdown retain their test sets. NetHack subtasks succeed at thresholds for score, gold or exploration. Reported RTFM and Messenger results use curriculum stage one.

body.zh: 五个环境共享符号接口并保留各自目标和成功标准。ALFWorld 与 Touchdown 使用视觉世界的符号对应，NetHack 以阈值子任务表达局部探索与得分目标。
body.en: Five domains share symbolic interfaces while retaining their own success criteria. ALFWorld and Touchdown use symbolic counterparts, and NetHack uses threshold-based exploration and scoring tasks.

body.zh: AutoWorldModel-Bench 把编码代理作为自主研究者，要求其在固定计算预算内修改基础世界模型，而不是直接控制玩家角色；套件包含八个自定义游戏环境。
body.en: AutoWorldModel-Bench evaluates coding agents autonomously improving a base world model under fixed compute across eight custom game environments.

body.zh: 环境以提取出的真实实体状态组成共享张量，隔离视觉感知与动态建模；代理运行实验、读取反馈并改变模型或训练方案，形成闭环研究过程。
body.en: Shared tensors of ground-truth entity state isolate dynamics from perception; agents iterate through experiments, feedback and changes to modeling or training.

body.zh: 每个预测时距以0.9×(1−归一化位置L1误差)+0.1×实体存活F1评价动态预测，1、10、20步按0.1、0.2、0.7加权。验证集选择会话最佳模型，随后在保留测试集评分，完整场景轨迹另测长期规则一致性。
body.en: Each horizon scores dynamics as 0.9×(1−normalized position L1 error)+0.1×entity-alive F1; 1-, 10- and 20-step predictions receive weights 0.1, 0.2 and 0.7. Validation selects the session-best model for held-out testing; full scenarios additionally test long-horizon rule consistency.

body.zh: 八款自定义游戏采用统一实体状态张量，形成游戏与基础模型架构的研究任务组合。固定计算预算约束代理修改和训练过程，测试与场景评分衡量生成研究产物的动态预测能力。
body.en: Eight custom games share entity-state tensors and combine with base-model architectures to define research tasks. Fixed compute bounds code modification and training; test and scenario scores measure the resulting artifacts’ dynamics predictions.

body.zh: GBQA 构建三十款游戏和一百二十四个人工核验缺陷，覆盖三档难度，要求语言模型作为质量保证工程师主动发现运行中的错误。
body.en: GBQA contains thirty games and 124 human-verified bugs across three difficulty levels, evaluating LLM agents as autonomous QA engineers.

body.zh: 多智能体生成与缺陷注入过程结合专家检查建立题目，基线使用多轮 ReAct 和记忆机制探索游戏，通过动作与反馈逐步形成缺陷判断。
body.en: Multi-agent game construction and bug injection are checked by experts; a memory-equipped ReAct baseline explores games across turns to identify defects.

body.zh: 以30款游戏中124个人工核验缺陷为参照，统计代理通过交互探索发现的缺陷比例，并比较不同模型的检测表现。CASTLE提供八房间文字冒险实例，运行反馈和探索记录作为缺陷判断的依据。
body.en: Against 124 human-validated bugs across 30 games, evaluation measures the proportion discovered through interactive exploration and compares models’ detection performance. CASTLE supplies an eight-room text-adventure example, with runtime feedback and exploration traces supporting bug judgments.

body.zh: 三十款游戏和人工核验缺陷集合定义质量保证范围，CASTLE 提供八房间文字冒险案例。代理记忆与探索策略用于取得错误证据，最终按缺陷发现结果评价。
body.en: Thirty games and verified defects define QA scope; CASTLE is an eight-room example. Memory and exploration gather evidence, while detected bugs determine performance.

body.zh: SPADE 是自博弈强化学习框架，同一个语言模型同时担任环境设计者和推理行动者；设计者编写带 reset/step 接口的完整可执行多轮环境。
body.en: SPADE is a self-play RL framework where one LLM acts as environment designer and reasoning agent, generating executable multi-turn reset/step environments.

body.zh: 环境包含状态转移、奖励与验证代码，以有无特权提示时的奖励差估计遗憾，推动设计者生成可行且位于当前学习能力边缘的任务。
body.en: State transitions, rewards and verification code define tasks; reward gaps with privileged hints estimate regret to target feasible challenges near the learner’s capability frontier.

body.zh: 训练效果在留出的数学、科学、代码和程序化推理任务上评价，分别采用答案准确率、代码pass@1与困难推理任务成功率等原始指标，再汇总八项成绩。工具使用轨道另用多轮工具任务评价指令完成情况。
body.en: Training is evaluated on held-out math, science, code and procedural-reasoning tasks through their original answer-accuracy, code pass@1 and hard-task success metrics, aggregated over eight benchmarks. A separate tool-use track measures completion in multi-turn tool tasks.

body.zh: 资源包括可执行游戏环境合成和工具环境合成两种训练设置。生成器的提示后悔值驱动课程设计，最终成绩来自训练外任务，区分环境生成机制与迁移评价。
body.en: The resource includes executable-game and tool-environment synthesis settings. Hint-based regret drives curriculum generation, while final scores come from held-out tasks, separating environment design from transfer evaluation.

paragraphs.zh: SPADE 是自博弈强化学习框架，同一个语言模型同时担任环境设计者和推理行动者；设计者编写带 reset/step 接口的完整可执行多轮环境。
paragraphs.en: SPADE is a self-play RL framework where one LLM acts as environment designer and reasoning agent, generating executable multi-turn reset/step environments.

paragraphs.zh: 环境包含状态转移、奖励与验证代码，以有无特权提示时的奖励差估计遗憾，推动设计者生成可行且位于当前学习能力边缘的任务。
paragraphs.en: State transitions, rewards and verification code define tasks; reward gaps with privileged hints estimate regret to target feasible challenges near the learner’s capability frontier.

paragraphs.zh: 训练效果在留出的数学、科学、代码和程序化推理任务上评价，分别采用答案准确率、代码pass@1与困难推理任务成功率等原始指标，再汇总八项成绩。工具使用轨道另用多轮工具任务评价指令完成情况。
paragraphs.en: Training is evaluated on held-out math, science, code and procedural-reasoning tasks through their original answer-accuracy, code pass@1 and hard-task success metrics, aggregated over eight benchmarks. A separate tool-use track measures completion in multi-turn tool tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 资源包括可执行游戏环境合成和工具环境合成两种训练设置。生成器的提示后悔值驱动课程设计，最终成绩来自训练外任务，区分环境生成机制与迁移评价。
paragraphs.en: The resource includes executable-game and tool-environment synthesis settings. Hint-based regret drives curriculum generation, while final scores come from held-out tasks, separating environment design from transfer evaluation.

body.zh: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 以一百份长篇游戏设计文档测试端到端游戏开发，编码代理需要把游戏逻辑、画面和玩家交互中的相互依赖要求实现为可运行作品。
body.en: A2Z GameSpec-Bench evaluates game development from one hundred long-form design documents with interdependent logic, rendering and interaction requirements.

body.zh: 每份文档转成包含规则、约束和前置关系的依赖合同；同一合同在不同代理与修改轮次中固定，使遗漏需求与破坏依赖可以对应到具体证据。
body.en: Dependency-aware contracts encode rules, constraints and prerequisites, remaining fixed across agents and revisions so failures can be linked to specific requirements.

body.zh: GDD Fidelity按固定需求依赖契约衡量实现对设计文档的保真度，并比较评测反馈驱动修改与自行修改。源代码检查、测试策略、场景重放和自适应游玩测试共同提供需求实现证据。
body.en: GDD Fidelity measures implementation adherence to the design specification through a fixed dependency-aware contract, comparing evaluator-feedback revision with self-revision. Code inspection, test policies, replay and adaptive play tests jointly supply implementation evidence.

body.zh: 评价对象是从长篇设计到可运行游戏的开发忠实度。游玩测试提供运行证据，源代码检查提供实现证据，依赖合同把两者对应到同一组固定需求。
body.en: The target is development fidelity from long designs to runnable games; playtesting and source inspection provide complementary evidence linked to fixed requirements by dependency contracts.

body.zh: CraftBench-UE 提供七十项 Unreal Engine 开发任务，覆盖 C++、Blueprint 资产和编辑器脚本，代理在隔离工程中实现指定玩法功能。
body.en: CraftBench-UE provides seventy Unreal Engine development tasks across C++, Blueprint assets and editor scripting in isolated projects.

body.zh: 评测器在新工程中重建已保存提交，依次检查构建是否成功、资产是否满足结构要求，以及游戏运行是否通过行为断言。该分层检查用于定位从代码和资产到实际玩法的实现差异。
body.en: The evaluator rebuilds saved submissions in fresh projects, checking successful builds, asset requirements and runtime behavior assertions. These stages locate implementation differences from code and assets through actual gameplay behavior.

body.zh: 任务完成率统计提交通过规定裁决的比例，构建、资产和运行检查分别提供错误定位。论文比较七种模型与两类编辑器工具配置，并用玩法目标及运行测试相同的C++/Blueprint任务比较交付形式。
body.en: Task completion rate measures the proportion of submissions passing the required adjudication; build, asset and runtime checks locate failures. Experiments compare seven models and two editor-tool configurations, with C++/Blueprint task pairs sharing gameplay goals and runtime tests.

body.zh: 任务按引擎功能、资产形式与工具配置组织，保存的提交在新工程中接受统一裁决。构建、资产和运行检查分别反映交付链条中的不同完成层次。
body.en: Tasks vary engine features, asset forms and tools; saved submissions receive uniform fresh-project evaluation, with build, asset and runtime checks representing distinct completion stages.

body.zh: GameASG-Bench 包含四十七项浏览器原生游戏生成任务，覆盖十二类主要类型与二维、三维互动，编码代理依据需求生成可运行且可测试的应用。
body.en: GameASG-Bench comprises forty-seven browser-native game-generation tasks across twelve primary genres and both 2D and 3D interaction.

body.zh: 生成前公开评测接口规范，固定合法起始场景、玩家级动作、稳定快照、拒绝行为及不变量，同时允许代理自由选择内部实现。
body.en: An evaluation interface fixes legal starting scenarios, player actions, snapshots, rejection behavior and invariants before generation while leaving implementation choices open.

body.zh: 严格任务成功要求全部适用的前置与核心检查通过，平均检查通过率保留部分实现进度。第一层（L1）检查源代码合规，第二层（L2）通过真实浏览器输入和语义观察验证运行行为。
body.en: Strict success requires all applicable prerequisite and core checks; mean check pass rate preserves partial implementation progress. Layer 1 (L1) checks source compliance, while Layer 2 (L2) verifies runtime behavior through real browser input and semantic observations.

body.zh: 四十七项任务各有参考实现和可执行检查，严格成功与平均检查通过率分别报告。类型覆盖描述开发需求分布，统一接口则保障不同实现的行为可比性。
body.en: Each of forty-seven tasks has a reference and executable checks; strict success and mean check pass rate are reported separately, with common interfaces enabling behavioral comparison.

body.zh: GameLogicBench 提供七十二项 Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，从孤立机制、系统交互延伸到仓库级功能，代理修改工程以满足指定行为。
body.en: GameLogicBench provides seventy-two Godot logic implementation and repair tasks spanning isolated mechanics, interacting systems and repository-scale features.

body.zh: 用于研究编码代理能否实现持续成立的游戏规则，以及复杂系统交互和仓库级修改如何影响正确性。逐帧状态断言捕捉运行中的暂时违规，补充只看终局的检查。
body.en: It studies whether coding agents implement game rules that remain valid throughout execution, and how system interactions or repository-scale edits affect correctness. Tick-level assertions detect transient violations beyond terminal-state checks.

body.zh: 72项任务以通过确定性测试的任务解决率比较模型与支架；400余个人工场景经种子扩展形成1400余项测试。移除必要功能的变异程序用于检查裁决器是否能拒绝错误实现，不同正确实现则接受同一行为规则检验。
body.en: Models and scaffolds are compared by the proportion of 72 tasks solved under deterministic tests. Over 400 authored scenarios expand to 1,400-plus seeded tests; feature-removal mutants test rejection of incorrect implementations, while alternative correct solutions face the same behavioral rules.

body.zh: 评价对象是 Godot 工程的游戏逻辑，角色动作由提交程序执行。任务规模、逐帧断言、变异验证与外部代码访问条件共同组成模型和支架比较的背景。
body.en: The target is Godot gameplay logic executed by submitted programs; task scale, tick assertions, mutant validation and external-code access define model-scaffold comparisons.

body.zh: GameXpert-Bench 将游戏开发生命周期拆成 GameGen、GameFix 和 GameOpt 三条轨道，分别测试从零生成、缺陷诊断修复和多轮累积优化。
body.en: GameXpert-Bench separates game development into GameGen creation, GameFix diagnosis and repair, and GameOpt cumulative multiround optimization.

body.zh: 生成轨道从空工作区接收完整需求，修复轨道区分已报告和待发现问题，优化轨道由真实人机开发轨迹形成请求链，强调修改后的功能保持。
body.en: Creation starts from an empty workspace, repair distinguishes reported from undiscovered defects, and optimization uses trajectory-derived request chains with functionality preservation.

body.zh: 97个GameGen任务评价新游戏的生成质量，100个GameFix任务评价缺陷修复，17条六轮GameOpt链评价持续修改中的优化与功能保持。实时游玩、确定性行为测试、产品指标和回归检查分别提供运行、质量和跨轮保持证据。
body.en: The 97 GameGen tasks assess creation quality, 100 GameFix tasks assess bug repair and 17 six-round GameOpt chains assess iterative improvement and feature preservation. Live play, deterministic behavior tests, product metrics and regression checks provide runtime, quality and preservation evidence.

body.zh: 三条轨道分别报告生成、修复和迭代优化，产品质量与回归保持提供互补证据。公开仓库提供支架，论文描述完整任务集合，两者分别对应资源发布范围与实验规模。
body.en: Creation, repair and optimization are reported separately, combining product quality and regression preservation. The public repository provides scaffolding, while the paper describes the complete task collection, distinguishing released resources from experimental scale.

body.zh: PlayTrain 将语言模型生成的 JavaScript 游戏接入高效强化学习流水线，同一文件既可供人类浏览器游玩，也可用于像素策略训练和规则修改实验。
body.en: PlayTrain connects LLM-generated JavaScript games to efficient RL, allowing the same file to support human browser play, pixel-policy training and rule modifications.

body.zh: 框架以单文件游戏减少环境开发成本，并展示 Atari、Procgen 风格副本与新动力学变体；IMPALA-CNN 等视觉编码支持端到端学习。
body.en: Single-file games reduce environment-development cost, with Atari- and Procgen-style clones and altered dynamics supporting end-to-end visual-policy learning.

body.zh: 八款游戏分别报告平均单局分数，以及策略达到人类平均成绩所需的训练步数。训练逐回合采样种子，最终检查点在八个保留种子上测试；吞吐率单独评价训练系统效率。
body.en: For each of eight games, evaluation reports mean episode score and training steps needed to reach mean human performance. Training samples seeds per episode; final checkpoints use eight held-out seeds. Throughput separately measures training-system efficiency.

body.zh: 游戏副本和规则变体采用项目生成的 JavaScript 实现。保留种子、训练重复与人类参与者分别对应测试分布、算法方差和人类参照，按不同统计层级报告。
body.en: Clones and variants use generated JavaScript implementations; held-out seeds, training repetitions and human participants represent test distributions, algorithm variance and human references respectively.

body.zh: PROWBench 评估视频模型是否把程序指定的世界事件正确渲染，包含一百七十段可重放程序场景与六百段代理视频，记录实体状态及带时间戳事件。
body.en: PROWBench tests whether video models render program-specified events using 170 replayable episodes and 600 proxy videos with entity states and timestamped events.

body.zh: 用于隔离视频渲染误差与程序状态演化误差，并比较代理表示、摄像机视角和视频长度对实体持续性及交互呈现的影响。同一程序记录可生成同步条件输入，支持受控比较。
body.en: It isolates visual-rendering errors from executable-state evolution, supporting controlled comparisons of proxy representations, viewpoints and video lengths for entity persistence and interaction realization.

body.zh: 以程序记录为参照，Logic-Render Alignment衡量生成画面对规定事件时间线的遵循程度，Interaction Success Rate统计指定时刻的交互是否在画面中实现；另评估实体控制与离开视野后再出现的状态保持。

body.zh: GVGAI-LLM 把街机式游戏以紧凑 ASCII 地图、规则、目标和动作映射呈现给语言模型，智能体逐步选择引擎允许的离散动作完成各游戏任务。
body.en: GVGAI-LLM presents arcade games as ASCII maps with rules, goals and action mappings; LLM agents select legal engine actions step by step.

body.zh: 用于研究模型能否依据新规则建立空间表示、选择有效动作并规划连续操作。推箱子中的不可逆死锁可用于分析局部有效动作与可完成整局的计划之间的差别。
body.en: It studies whether models can build spatial representations from new rules, choose effective actions and plan action sequences. Irreversible Sokoban deadlocks help distinguish locally valid actions from plans that preserve eventual solvability.

body.zh: 胜率记录任务完成情况，归一化奖励描述游戏进展，有意义步比例和步效率刻画动作利用情况，并据协议计算综合分。118款初步遍历与六款跨模型子集分别汇总。
body.en: Win rate measures completion, normalized reward tracks game progress, and meaningful-step ratio and step efficiency characterize action use; the protocol also defines a composite score. The 118-game exploratory run and six-game cross-model subset are aggregated separately.

body.zh: 默认输入包含ASCII状态、规则和动作映射。六款跨模型子集用于系统比较，118款初步遍历用于观察更广游戏分布；两种推箱实现是其中的空间规划案例。
body.en: Default inputs contain ASCII state, rules and action mappings. The six-game subset supports systematic model comparison, while the exploratory 118-game run probes broader game coverage; two Sokoban implementations provide spatial-planning cases.

body.zh: RPGBench 让语言模型担任文字角色扮演游戏引擎，包含世界创建与游戏模拟两项任务：生成可玩世界，并在多轮互动中按规则更新事件和状态。
body.en: RPGBench evaluates LLMs as text-RPG engines through world creation and multiround simulation with rule-consistent event and state updates.

body.zh: 用于研究语言模型能否同时维持叙事连贯性和可执行的游戏机制，包括状态变量更新、前置条件满足、事件触发与终止条件。世界创建和持续模拟可分别分析设计质量与多轮执行一致性。
body.en: It studies whether language models can maintain narrative coherence alongside executable mechanics: variable updates, prerequisites, event triggers and termination conditions. World creation and ongoing simulation separate design quality from consistency during multiround execution.

body.zh: 客观指标自动检查事件机制和变量更新，主观内容趣味、动作质量及角色扮演由语言模型评判；两类证据共同描述创意与规则可靠性。
body.en: Automatic checks evaluate event mechanics and state updates, while an LLM judge assesses interestingness, action quality and role-playing.

body.zh: 模型承担世界作者和游戏引擎两类角色，产物为世界定义及玩家输入后的叙事和状态更新。自动机制检查与主观内容评分分别反映规则执行和内容质量。
body.en: Models act as world authors and game engines, producing world definitions and narrative/state updates after player inputs. Automatic mechanism checks and subjective content scores respectively assess rule execution and content quality.

body.zh: VideoGameQA-Bench 面向视觉语言模型的游戏质量保证，提供游戏图像与视频中的视觉单元测试、回归测试、异常检索、故障识别及缺陷报告生成。
body.en: VideoGameQA-Bench evaluates VLMs on game-image and video QA, including visual unit and regression tests, anomaly search, glitch detection and bug reports.

body.zh: 它将传统依赖人工审阅的视觉检查转为标准化模型任务，关注细小异常、跨画面差异和长视频中的关键证据，覆盖不同质量保证活动。
body.en: It standardizes visual checks traditionally requiring manual review, probing subtle anomalies, frame differences and critical evidence in longer videos.

body.zh: 视觉问答、回归测试和异常识别按参考标签统计准确率，并对异常检测分析精确率、召回率等错误分布。视频异常定位检查首个异常时刻的预测误差；缺陷报告由语言模型评委比较生成描述与参考描述的一致性。
body.en: Visual questions, regression tests and glitch detection use reference-label accuracy, with precision and recall analyses for detection. Video localization measures error in the predicted first-glitch time; an LLM judge compares generated bug descriptions with reference reports.

body.zh: 评测以游戏截图和录像为离线输入，覆盖视觉单元测试、UI检查、回归测试、异常检测、时刻定位与报告生成九类任务。异常识别、定位和报告分别计分，视频帧采样设置随模型接口记录。
body.en: Offline screenshots and footage support nine tasks spanning visual unit tests, UI checks, regression, glitch detection, temporal localization and report generation. Detection, localization and reporting are scored separately, with model-specific video frame sampling recorded.

body.zh: Gymnasium 为强化学习环境提供标准 API、环境集合及自定义工具，用统一的重置、行动、奖励与结束反馈接口连接算法和不同模拟任务。
body.en: Gymnasium provides a standard RL API, environment collection and customization tools linking algorithms to reset, action, reward and termination interfaces.

body.zh: 资源重点是环境与学习算法的互操作性、可复用性和可重复实验，区分自然终止与时间截断等接口语义，使训练过程能正确处理回合边界。
body.en: It emphasizes interoperability and reproducibility, including interface semantics that distinguish termination from truncation for correct episode-boundary handling.

body.zh: 具体示例 CartPole-v1 使用车体位置速度、杆角度角速度四维观察，输出左右推力，按保持平衡的累计步奖励评价，同时受越界与杆倾角终止限制。
body.en: The CartPole-v1 example uses four state variables and left/right force actions, measuring accumulated balancing reward subject to cart-position and pole-angle termination.

body.zh: CartPole-v1 是当前官方任务定义中的具体控制例，平台另提供多类环境与封装工具。版本、算法预算、随机种子和封装选项共同确定实验设置。
body.en: CartPole-v1 is one current official control task within a broader environment and wrapper library; versions, algorithm budgets, seeds and wrappers determine each experiment.

body.zh: BenchMARL 以 TorchRL 为后端，把多智能体算法、模型和环境配置组织成统一训练与报告框架，使不同实验组合可以在明确设置下系统比较。
body.en: BenchMARL uses TorchRL to standardize configurations, training and reporting across multi-agent algorithms, models and environments.

body.zh: 研究动机是多智能体强化学习的复现与公平比较，配置化接口减少实现差异，平台同时支持高效维护的算法组件及跨场景汇总分析。
body.en: It addresses MARL reproducibility and fair comparison by reducing implementation differences through configurable, maintained algorithm components and systematic reporting.

body.zh: 以VMAS Navigation为例，智能体根据自身位置速度、相对目标与激光距离控制平面运动；回报综合接近目标、完成导航和碰撞事件。框架按环境记录测试回报与训练曲线，再汇总多次运行结果。
body.en: In VMAS Navigation, agents control planar motion from position, velocity, relative targets and lidar distances. Rewards combine target approach, completion and collisions; the framework records environment-specific test returns and learning curves and aggregates repeated runs.

body.zh: BenchMARL提供算法、模型和环境的配置化组合，VMAS Navigation是局部展开的导航示例。其动作形式与奖励共享方式由配置确定，论文实验与后续库版本分别记录。
body.en: BenchMARL provides configurable algorithm–model–environment combinations; VMAS Navigation is the detailed navigation example. Action format and reward sharing follow the selected configuration, and paper experiments are distinguished from later library versions.

body.zh: JaxMARL 提供在 JAX 中实现的多智能体环境和基线算法，把环境模拟与训练放到加速器上并行执行，覆盖多种合作、竞争和部分可观测任务。
body.en: JaxMARL implements multi-agent environments and baselines in JAX, enabling accelerator-parallel simulation and training across cooperative and competitive tasks.

body.zh: 用于在相同加速器执行条件下比较多智能体学习算法，分析训练效率、协同决策与自博弈。SMAX以独立实现的简化单位战斗支持大规模微操实验，减少原版游戏引擎的运行开销。
body.en: It supports comparisons of multiagent algorithms under a shared accelerator execution stack, studying training efficiency, coordination and self-play. SMAX provides independently implemented simplified unit combat for large-scale micromanagement experiments.

body.zh: SMAX 以视野内生命、位置、冷却及类型等观察驱动移动、停止和目标攻击，报告胜率及伤害与获胜组成的回报；吞吐和训练速度另作系统指标。
body.en: SMAX agents move, stop or attack from local health, position and cooldown observations; win rate and combat return are separate from system-throughput metrics.

body.zh: SMAX 使用独立向量化战斗模拟和自己的奖励尺度，集中于单位微操。其他 JaxMARL 环境保留各自规则，加速比和环境验证作为系统层面结果报告。
body.en: SMAX uses independent vectorized combat simulation and its own rewards for micromanagement; other domains retain their rules, and speedups and environment validation are system-level results.

body.zh: 该资源为离线多智能体强化学习提出标准基线与评价协议，智能体利用固定数据学习协作策略，再在对应模拟环境中检验，而非训练时持续采集新轨迹。
body.en: This resource standardizes offline MARL baselines and evaluation: policies learn from fixed datasets and are subsequently tested in corresponding simulators.

body.zh: 研究通过重审既有工作揭示基线实现、检查点选择与统计报告的不一致，并展示简单可靠的实现也能匹配复杂方法，重点是可比较的实证进展。
body.en: It identifies inconsistencies in implementations, checkpoint selection and reporting, showing that reliable simple baselines can match sophisticated methods.

body.zh: 固定轨迹训练后，在对应环境执行策略：MPE和MAMuJoCo按任务回报评价，SMACv1按团队战斗胜率并区分数据质量。原协议采用十个种子、每次32回合测试，三个环境系列使用各自更新预算。
body.en: After training on fixed trajectories, policies are executed in the corresponding environments: task return measures MPE/MAMuJoCo performance, while team combat win rate measures SMACv1 performance across dataset qualities. The protocol uses ten seeds and 32 test episodes per evaluation with environment-specific update budgets.

body.zh: 数据质量、固定更新预算和检查点选择交互共同定义离线协议。SMAC 单元对应固定轨迹学习后的单位战斗，跨场景与跨种子统计用于比较策略稳定性。
body.en: Dataset quality, fixed update budgets and checkpoint-selection interaction define the offline protocol; SMAC evaluates learned micromanagement with scenario and seed statistics.

body.zh: TextWorldExpress 以高性能模拟器重实现 CookingWorld、TextWorld Commonsense 和 Coin Collector 三类文字游戏，用文字房间、物品和动作反馈支持交互。
body.en: TextWorldExpress efficiently reimplements CookingWorld, TextWorld Commonsense and Coin Collector using textual rooms, objects and action feedback.

body.zh: 核心贡献是降低旧工具链的模拟成本，使大规模语言代理训练可行；做饭要求按食谱处理原料，整理要求归置物品，找币则强调房间探索。
body.en: Its core contribution reduces simulation cost for large-scale language-agent training; cooking, household tidying and coin retrieval retain distinct task structures.

body.zh: 代理提交文字命令，接口可返回有效动作列表；任务表现按归一化分数和完成情况评价，模拟每秒步数与代理策略得分分开报告。
body.en: Agents issue text commands with optional valid-action lists; normalized score and completion measure task performance, separately from simulator steps per second.

body.zh: 论文版本包含三类重实现游戏，后续库新增内容按版本区分。各生成器保留自己的地图与任务分布，模拟吞吐、任务分数和策略完成情况分别报告。
body.en: The paper version contains three reimplemented families, distinguished from later additions; generator distributions, simulation throughput, scores and completion are reported separately.

body.zh: U3 以 Unity 实现可配置的三维强化学习环境工具包，包含 OpenXLand 对 XLand 2.0 风格地形、物体和任务规则的实现，可程序化生成多样世界。
body.en: U3 is a configurable Unity toolkit with OpenXLand implementations of XLand-2.0-style terrains, objects and rules for diverse procedural 3D worlds.

body.zh: 用户可以修改地形与生产规则，智能体从第一人称图像和互动中发现物体转化及目标条件；资源同时提供精选规则地形与强化学习基线。
body.en: Configurable terrains and production rules let agents discover object transformations and goals from first-person interaction, supported by curated configurations and RL baselines.

body.zh: 具体互动通过移动和物体操作触发规则，以任务或任务集合的回合回报评价；满足目标的每步获得奖励，试验时长和行动预算由配置指定。
body.en: Movement and object interactions trigger rules; episode returns evaluate tasks or task collections, with per-step goal rewards and configured trial lengths.

body.zh: OpenXLand 的任务规则、地形和试验预算由配置明确给定，基础回报联合反映探索和执行。生成数据规模、任务集合表现与单任务回报分别描述资源的不同层次。
body.en: Configured rules, terrains and budgets define OpenXLand tasks; return reflects exploration and execution, while data scale, collection performance and individual returns describe distinct resource levels.

body.zh: MARLlib 通过标准多智能体环境封装、智能体级算法实现和灵活策略映射，把多样任务与训练方案解耦，提供可扩展的强化学习开发库。
body.en: MARLlib combines standardized environment wrappers, agent-level algorithms and flexible policy mapping to decouple multi-agent tasks from training strategies.

body.zh: 框架依据任务属性组织训练配置，减少算法与环境组合的兼容成本，使研究者能比较不同参数共享、价值学习和策略组织方式。
body.en: Task-aware configuration reduces compatibility cost and supports comparisons across parameter sharing, value learning and policy organization.

body.zh: Simple Spread 示例让三名智能体覆盖三个地标并避免碰撞，观察自身状态和相对位置，以四向移动或不动行动；回报含地标距离与碰撞罚分。
body.en: The Simple Spread example uses three agents covering three landmarks while avoiding collisions, with relative-state observations, movement actions and distance/collision penalties.

body.zh: Simple Spread 提供明确的地标覆盖示例，平台还支持多种环境与策略映射。离散或连续动作、新版参数和历史实现分别标识，以对应各自的奖励与训练条件。
body.en: Simple Spread supplies a landmark-coverage example within a broader library; action variants, newer parameters and historical implementations are distinguished by reward and training conditions.

body.zh: CORA 将基准、基线和指标整合为持续强化学习平台，包含 Atari、Procgen、NetHack 系列及家居模拟 CHORES，使智能体顺序学习变化中的任务。
body.en: CORA integrates benchmarks, baselines and metrics for continual RL across Atari, Procgen, NetHack and home-simulation CHORES task sequences.

body.zh: 研究重点是在学习新任务的同时保持旧技能，区分灾难性遗忘、可塑性、泛化和样本效率；训练序列及任务切换决定迁移问题的结构。
body.en: It studies retention alongside new learning, separating forgetting, plasticity, generalization and sample efficiency under explicit task sequences and switches.

body.zh: 训练过程中持续测量各任务回报，Continual Evaluation描述整体学习轨迹，Isolated Forgetting衡量学习后续任务带来的旧任务表现变化，Zero-Shot Forward Transfer考察任务专门训练之前的表现。Procgen与MiniHack采用各自观察和动作接口。
body.en: Task returns are measured throughout sequential training. Continual Evaluation describes overall learning, Isolated Forgetting tracks old-task performance changes after learning later tasks, and Zero-Shot Forward Transfer evaluates tasks before task-specific training. Procgen and MiniHack retain their own observation/action interfaces.

body.zh: 平台包含Atari、Procgen、NetHack系列和CHORES等持续学习任务序列。当前展开的Procgen序列含六款游戏，MiniHack使用其指定序列；任务顺序、训练预算与测试实例划分定义对应比较。
body.en: The platform includes continual-learning sequences based on Atari, Procgen, NetHack and CHORES. The detailed Procgen sequence contains six games, while MiniHack uses its specified sequence; task order, training budget and test-instance split define each comparison.

body.zh: EnvPool 是高并行强化学习环境执行引擎，以高效调度减少模拟成为训练瓶颈的开销，并与多种强化学习库连接，支持从笔记本到大型机器的执行。
body.en: EnvPool is a highly parallel RL environment engine that reduces simulation bottlenecks and integrates with training libraries across laptops and larger systems.

body.zh: 资源同时研究系统吞吐与实际策略学习耗时；Atari 和物理控制环境的并行模拟展示运行效率，学习示例检验速度能否转化为更快获得有效策略。
body.en: It studies simulation throughput and policy-learning time, distinguishing fast environment execution from faster acquisition of effective behavior.

body.zh: Pong 学习案例用 PPO 控制右侧球拍，观察默认四帧八十四乘八十四灰度图并选择最小离散动作，以回报随墙钟时间变化评价学习，FPS 单列。
body.en: The PPO Pong example uses stacked grayscale frames and minimal discrete actions to control the paddle, reporting return over wall-clock time separately from FPS.

body.zh: Pong 是论文中的策略学习案例，环境并行数与调参构成比较条件。历史实验与当前文档默认配置分别标识，回报、墙钟训练时间和模拟吞吐分别表达能力与效率。
body.en: Pong is a policy-learning case with parallelism and tuning as comparison conditions; historical and current settings are distinguished, and return, wall-clock time and throughput serve separate roles.

body.zh: 该资源审查2016—2022年75篇合作式多智能体强化学习论文的实验实践，并提供标准化评价协议及分析工具。输入为既有实验的训练曲线、重复运行得分和设置记录。
body.en: This resource audits evaluation practice in 75 cooperative MARL papers from 2016–2022 and provides a standardized protocol and analysis tools. Inputs are existing learning curves, repeated-run scores and experiment settings.

body.zh: 用于分析算法比较对实验预算、随机种子、评价时点及结果汇总方式的敏感性，并组织可复查的多智能体实验报告。元分析数据支持研究评价实践本身如何影响进展判断。
body.en: It supports analysis of how budgets, seeds, evaluation checkpoints and aggregation affect algorithm comparisons, and helps organize reproducible MARL reports. Its meta-analysis data enable research on how evaluation practice shapes conclusions about progress.

body.zh: 协议结合多次训练和多回合测试，对任务表现进行统计汇总并报告不确定性；元分析则审查论文是否充分交代训练、评价和结果报告设置。两者分别以策略得分和评价实践为分析对象。
body.en: The protocol combines repeated training and multi-episode testing to aggregate performance with uncertainty estimates. The meta-analysis examines how papers document training, evaluation and reporting; these analyses respectively concern policy scores and evaluation practice.

body.zh: 资源包含合作MARL评价方法、公开元分析数据和分析实现。具体游戏与回报由被分析实验提供，协议的核心产物是跨任务与跨运行的统计报告。
body.en: The resource comprises cooperative-MARL evaluation methodology, public meta-analysis data and analysis implementations. Games and rewards come from the experiments being analyzed; the protocol produces statistical reports across tasks and runs.

body.zh: EPyMARL扩展PyMARL的合作式算法和环境接口。等级觅食要求智能体同时靠近并装载食物，参与者等级之和满足食物要求；仓库任务要求机器人将指定货架送至工作站后归还。
body.en: EPyMARL extends PyMARL’s cooperative algorithms and environment interfaces. Level-based foraging requires agents to jointly load food whose level exceeds individual capacity; warehouse robots deliver requested shelves to workstations and return them.

body.zh: 用于比较独立学习、集中式多智能体策略梯度和值分解方法在稀疏奖励与协同约束下的学习效果，并分析参数共享等实现选择。
body.en: It compares independent learning, centralized multiagent policy gradients and value decomposition under sparse rewards and coordination constraints, including implementation choices such as parameter sharing.

body.zh: 等级觅食以收集食物所得回报评价协作，仓库以货架配送回报评价吞吐；两者报告平均回合回报与学习曲线。论文对各任务配置设置41个评价点，每点评价100局，并区分在策略与离策略训练预算。
body.en: Food-collection returns measure foraging cooperation, while shelf-delivery returns measure warehouse performance. Mean episode return and learning curves are reported at 41 evaluation points of 100 episodes each, under separate on- and off-policy training budgets.

body.zh: 原论文比较多类合作任务；此处细化七项等级觅食配置和三项仓库配置。两类任务保留各自局部观测、动作和奖励定义，训练预算随任务和算法类别指定。
body.en: The paper compares several cooperative task families; the detailed protocols here cover seven foraging and three warehouse configurations. Each family retains its local observations, actions and rewards, with budgets specified by task and algorithm class.
