body.zh: PettingZoo为多智能体环境提供轮流推进的Agent Environment Cycle接口和同步行动的并行接口，统一返回各智能体的观测、奖励与回合结束信息。环境集合覆盖棋类、街机和合作控制等任务。
body.en: PettingZoo provides turn-cycling Agent Environment Cycle and simultaneous-action parallel APIs, exposing per-agent observations, rewards and episode endings. Its collection spans board games, arcade-style tasks and cooperative control.

body.zh: 用于多智能体强化学习的环境复用、算法开发及顺序行动与并行行动建模。统一接口便于在不同游戏中组织交互实验。
body.en: It supports reusable MARL environments, algorithm development and modeling of sequential and parallel interaction.

body.zh: 各环境使用自己的胜负或任务回报。以Pistonball-v6为例，20个活塞依据局部RGB图像控制升降，把球送到左侧边界；共享奖励按向左进展占初始距离的比例计算，并加入逐步时间惩罚。
body.en: Each environment uses its own outcomes or returns. In Pistonball-v6, twenty pistons use local RGB views to control vertical motion and move a ball to the left boundary; shared reward measures progress relative to the initial distance with a per-step time penalty.

body.zh: PettingZoo提供环境接口与多种任务，实验按所选游戏和版本组织。Pistonball-v6的连续或离散动作、周期上限及初始随机性定义该示例的具体控制条件。
body.en: PettingZoo supplies APIs and multiple task families, with experiments organized by game and version. Pistonball-v6’s continuous/discrete actions, cycle limit and initial randomness define the concrete conditions of this example.

body.zh: rliable 提供强化学习实验的统计分析方法与实现，从既有得分中估计聚合表现和置信区间。
body.en: rliable provides statistical methods and software for aggregate performance and confidence intervals from existing RL scores.

body.zh: 用于研究少量随机种子条件下的强化学习算法比较，描述跨任务表现与统计不确定性。
body.en: It supports RL comparisons with limited random seeds, characterizing cross-task performance and statistical uncertainty.

body.zh: 四分位均值（IQM）汇总中间50%的任务得分，性能分布显示达到不同得分阈值的任务比例，提升概率描述一种算法超过另一种的机会；分层bootstrap为跨任务与跨运行的估计给出置信区间。
body.en: The interquartile mean (IQM) aggregates the middle 50% of scores, performance profiles show the fraction above score thresholds, and probability of improvement quantifies how often one method outperforms another. Stratified bootstrap provides uncertainty intervals across tasks and runs.

body.zh: 论文以Atari 100k等少量运行实验为案例，并分析ALE、Procgen及DeepMind Control结果。实验得分的归一化方式和任务集合决定统计比较的范围。
body.en: The paper studies few-run experiments such as Atari 100k and analyzes ALE, Procgen and DeepMind Control results. Score normalization and the chosen task set define the scope of statistical comparisons.

body.zh: URLB先让智能体在无外部任务奖励的环境中交互预训练，再针对指定奖励微调控制策略。智能体从状态向量或图像出发，输出连续关节控制，完成站立、行走、翻转或机械臂到达等目标。
body.en: URLB pretrains agents through interaction without external task rewards, then finetunes policies for specified reward functions. Agents use state vectors or images to produce continuous joint controls for goals such as standing, locomotion, flipping and reaching.

body.zh: 用于比较无监督预训练形成的表示、探索行为及其下游适应效率，研究不同内在目标对后续控制的作用。
body.en: It compares representations and exploration from unsupervised pretraining and their downstream adaptation efficiency.

body.zh: 按下游任务的回合回报评价目标完成质量，并以微调步数对应的回报曲线衡量适应样本效率。比较固定预训练检查点、后续交互预算及状态或像素观测模式。
body.en: Downstream episode return measures task performance, while return versus finetuning steps measures adaptation sample efficiency. Comparisons specify the pretraining checkpoint, adaptation budget and state- or pixel-observation mode.

body.zh: 包含Walker、Quadruped和Jaco三个控制域，各有四个下游任务。研究对象是从无奖励经验向不同奖励目标的迁移，预训练与微调阶段分别记录。
body.en: The benchmark contains Walker, Quadruped and Jaco, each with four downstream tasks. It evaluates transfer from reward-free experience to distinct rewarded goals, with pretraining and adaptation recorded separately.

body.zh: BuildArena在《围攻》中让语言模型根据自然语言目标构造运输、承重和升空机械。模型调用构造工具生成BSG机器文件，再由游戏物理仿真检验机械的实际行为。
body.en: BuildArena asks language models to construct transport, support and lift machines in Besiege from natural-language specifications. Models use construction tools to produce BSG machine files, whose behavior is tested in the game’s physics simulation.

body.zh: 用于研究工程构造、三维空间组合与物理推理，并分析结构设计能否满足功能约束。单轮生成与仿真反馈修正分别用于比较初始设计质量和迭代改进效果。
body.en: It supports research on engineering construction, 3D spatial composition and physical reasoning under functional constraints. One-shot generation and simulation-feedback refinement provide separate settings for initial design quality and iterative improvement.

body.zh: 按运输、承重和升空任务的轨迹判定成功率，并记录承重或高度等任务量、部件数、非法动作率与模型调用量。官方基线按任务类别和难度汇总，每个任务—模型组合采样64次。
body.en: Simulation trajectories determine task success; evaluation also records task-specific load or height, part count, invalid-action rate and model calls. Official baselines aggregate results by task category and difficulty, with 64 samples per task–model pair.

body.zh: 资源覆盖三类机械任务及三档难度，构造文件和仿真轨迹为主要研究产物。原始BuildArena的单轮与反馈实验分别记录；后续BuildArena 2.0属于独立扩展版本。
body.en: The resource covers three machine-task categories at three difficulty levels, with construction files and simulation trajectories as the main research artifacts. One-shot and feedback experiments are recorded separately; BuildArena 2.0 is a subsequent extension.

body.zh: CWMB提供18个强化学习环境的规则描述与离线轨迹，要求模型生成可执行的状态转移、奖励和终止函数。GIF-MCTS利用搜索与执行反馈修正代码，随后将生成模型用于行动规划。
body.en: CWMB supplies descriptions and offline trajectories from eighteen RL environments, asking models to generate executable transition, reward and termination functions. GIF-MCTS refines this code through search and execution feedback, then uses the resulting model for planning.

body.zh: 用于研究 LLM 生成可执行动力学模型，以及模型准确性对搜索规划回报的影响。GIF-MCTS 以搜索和执行反馈改进生成代码。
body.en: It studies executable dynamics generation and its effects on planning, with GIF-MCTS refining code through search and feedback.

body.zh: 分别测量状态转移、奖励和终止预测的准确率，以及使用代码模型规划后在真实环境中获得的归一化回报，并记录代码合成预算。RTFM案例在固定手册、静止怪物的设置下比较十回合规划表现。
body.en: Evaluation separates transition/reward/termination prediction accuracy from normalized returns obtained by planning with the generated model and executing in the real environment; synthesis budget is recorded. The RTFM case compares ten-episode planning returns under a fixed manual and stationary monsters.

body.zh: CWMB用于离线代码模型构建和检验；Blackjack-v1等环境提供后续规划任务。RTFM为另行规定的简化实验，模型预测指标与环境执行回报分别解释。
body.en: CWMB supports offline model construction and verification, with environments such as Blackjack-v1 supplying downstream planning tasks. RTFM is a separately specified simplified experiment; prediction metrics and execution returns describe different stages.

body.zh: GameGen-X利用OGameData游戏录像学习生成连续游戏画面，并根据文字指令控制角色动作或环境变化。《赛博朋克2077》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》是论文明确展示的数据来源示例。
body.en: GameGen-X learns from OGameData footage to generate continuous game video and follow text controls for character actions or environment changes. Cyberpunk 2077 and Red Dead Redemption 2 are explicitly illustrated data sources.

body.zh: 用于研究开放场景视频生成、动作可控性与指令驱动的连续画面变化。游戏录像为生成模型提供训练数据。
body.en: It studies open-domain video generation, action controllability and instruction-driven visual dynamics using gameplay footage.

body.zh: FID和FVD比较生成图像或视频的分布质量，文字对齐和偏好评价描述内容匹配及视觉效果，控制响应率记录角色或环境是否按指令发生变化。
body.en: FID/FVD assess generated image/video distribution quality; text alignment and preference evaluation describe semantic matching and visual quality. Control-response rates record whether character or environment changes follow the supplied instructions.

body.zh: 录像用于生成模型训练，评测产物为合成视频。数据覆盖、文字控制类别和视频生成设置定义实验范围，原作名称表示训练画面的来源。
body.en: Footage supplies generative-model training, and synthetic videos are the evaluated outputs. Data coverage, text-control categories and generation settings define the experiments; original-game names identify footage sources.

paragraphs.zh: 录像用于生成模型训练，评测产物为合成视频。数据覆盖、文字控制类别和视频生成设置定义实验范围，原作名称表示训练画面的来源。
paragraphs.en: Footage supplies generative-model training, and synthetic videos are the evaluated outputs. Data coverage, text-control categories and generation settings define the experiments; original-game names identify footage sources.

body.zh: GameFactory以带键鼠动作标注的GF-Minecraft录像学习交互视频生成：输入画面和操作条件，预测后续画面，并把学到的控制关系迁移到其他视觉场景。
body.en: GameFactory uses keyboard/mouse-labeled GF-Minecraft footage for interactive video generation: given visual context and controls, it predicts subsequent frames and transfers the learned control relationships to other visual scenes.

body.zh: 用于研究动作条件视频生成与场景泛化，分析游戏风格学习和键鼠控制之间的关系。
body.en: It studies action-conditioned video generation and scene generalization, separating style learning from keyboard/mouse control.

body.zh: 摄像机运动误差和光流误差衡量动作条件与画面运动的对应程度；CLIP指标描述语义匹配，FID/FVD描述图像与视频的分布质量。GF-Minecraft保留5%数据用于测试。
body.en: Camera-motion and optical-flow errors measure correspondence between controls and generated motion. CLIP measures semantic alignment, while FID/FVD assess image/video distribution quality; five percent of GF-Minecraft is held out for testing.

body.zh: 量化评价围绕GF-Minecraft的动作条件预测与生成质量，其他开放场景展示控制关系的迁移。训练、测试场景及定性扩展示例分别组织。
body.en: Quantitative evaluation concerns action-conditioned prediction and generation quality on GF-Minecraft; other open scenes demonstrate transferred control. Training data, held-out tests and qualitative extensions are distinguished.

body.zh: Hunyuan-GameCraft-2根据视觉条件和交互指令生成连续游戏视频，训练录像来自150余款AAA游戏。配套InterBench以六类控制维度检验生成画面对用户操作的响应。
body.en: Hunyuan-GameCraft-2 generates continuous game video from visual conditions and interactive instructions, using footage from over 150 AAA games. Its InterBench protocol tests video responses along six control dimensions.

body.zh: 用于研究交互视频世界模型的指令遵循、时序一致性与实时生成。InterBench 按多种控制维度评价响应。
body.en: It studies instruction following, temporal consistency and real-time generation in interactive video world models through InterBench control dimensions.

body.zh: FVD及视觉、时序质量指标描述生成视频质量，相对位姿误差测量运动控制误差，FPS衡量生成速度。InterBench使用视觉语言模型评判生成结果是否实现对应指令。
body.en: FVD and visual/temporal quality measures assess generated video, relative-pose error measures motion-control error, and FPS measures generation speed. InterBench uses a VLM to judge whether generated outcomes realize the specified instructions.

body.zh: 评价对象是交互视频世界模型，控制遵循、视觉质量和运行速度分别报告。录像中的商业游戏提供训练情境，InterBench中的VLM承担生成结果评委角色。
body.en: The evaluated system is an interactive video world model, with control following, visual quality and runtime speed reported separately. Commercial-game footage supplies training contexts, and InterBench’s VLM serves as the output judge.

body.zh: 模型根据自然语言博弈规则生成Python游戏代码，实现合法动作、状态转移、奖励和玩家观测。数据包含30种完全或不完全信息游戏，以23种训练、7种留出测试，比较监督微调和可验证奖励训练。
body.en: Models translate natural-language game rules into Python implementations of legal actions, transitions, rewards and player observations. Thirty perfect/imperfect-information games are split into 23 training and seven held-out games to compare supervised and verifiable-reward training.

body.zh: 用于研究轻量模型的规则到代码生成，通过监督微调与可验证奖励训练学习可执行游戏模型。
body.en: It studies lightweight rule-to-code generation using supervised fine-tuning and verifiable-reward training.

body.zh: 四级验证分别检查静态结构、随机动作序列下的动力学、规则场景语义，以及不完全信息游戏中重采样历史的观测一致性。每个留出游戏生成25份代码，报告各级测试通过比例和跨游戏平均分。
body.en: Four verification tiers check static structure, dynamics under random-action fuzzing, scenario-level rule semantics and observation consistency after history resampling in imperfect-information games. Twenty-five programs per held-out game yield per-tier pass fractions and cross-game means.

body.zh: 评价单位是生成的游戏程序，留出游戏衡量规则到代码的迁移；信息一致性测试针对重采样历史后的玩家观测。模型训练使用的强化学习奖励来自程序验证结果。
body.en: The evaluation unit is a generated game program; held-out games test rule-to-code transfer. Information tests concern player observations after history resampling, and reinforcement-learning rewards come from program-verification results.

body.zh: PlayAdequacy把生成的代码世界模型用于搜索决策，再由真实游戏规则裁判执行行动和判定结果。实验覆盖完全信息棋类、扑克，以及专门构造的稀有规则和信念反例。
body.en: PlayAdequacy uses generated code world models for search decisions, then executes actions and judges outcomes under the true game rules. Experiments cover perfect-information board games, poker, and constructed rare-rule/belief counterexamples.

body.zh: 用于研究代码世界模型的预测正确性与实际决策效用之间的关系，分析稀有规则或信念误差如何影响搜索对局。
body.en: It studies prediction correctness versus decision utility in code world models, including rare-rule and belief errors in search.

body.zh: 模型验证通过率与预测或分布差距描述模型拟合，真实裁判下的胜率和play-cost描述其决策代价，并给出不确定性区间。规则反例实验固定搜索预算、20个种子及每组2400局，比较知晓和忽略关键规则的玩家。
body.en: Verification pass rates and prediction/distribution gaps assess model fit; truth-refereed win rates and play-cost assess downstream decision consequences with uncertainty intervals. A rule counterexample fixes search budget, twenty seeds and 2,400 games per arm to compare rule-aware and rule-blind players.

body.zh: 手工因果反例与语言模型代码合成实验分别检验模型误差如何影响游玩。对局由真实规则推进，生成模型负责搜索中的假想状态演化。
body.en: Constructed causal counterexamples and LLM code-synthesis experiments separately examine how model errors affect play. True rules advance actual matches, while generated models simulate hypothetical states inside search.

body.zh: ProgrammableWorldModel将显式世界状态作为视频渲染条件，模型依据结构化实体状态和事件生成画面。CombatStateBench提供50段战斗视频场景，检查对象数量与死亡事件是否被正确呈现。
body.en: ProgrammableWorldModel conditions video rendering on explicit world states, using structured entities and events to generate observations. CombatStateBench supplies fifty combat clips that test whether entity counts and death events are rendered correctly.

body.zh: 用于研究显式状态控制的生成世界、对象持续性与视频状态一致性。结构化状态为生成过程提供可编程约束。
body.en: It studies explicit-state control, object persistence and video-state consistency through programmable world-state constraints.

body.zh: 以指定状态为参照，统计画面中可见存活对象数量的准确率，以及死亡事件前后对象状态的准确率；另用四项VBench指标衡量视觉质量。状态遵循与画面质量分别计分。
body.en: Against specified states, evaluation measures accuracy of visible surviving-entity counts and entity states around death events. Four VBench measures separately assess visual quality, distinguishing state adherence from appearance quality.

body.zh: CombatStateBench聚焦显式状态约束下的生成视频诊断；状态和动作条件由实验预先提供，视觉语言模型负责读取并判定生成画面。
body.en: CombatStateBench diagnoses generated video under explicit state constraints. Experiments supply the state/action conditions, and a VLM reads and judges the generated observations.

body.zh: GameDevBench提供333个由网页和视频教程构造的Godot工程修改任务。开发智能体读取需求和已有工程，修改代码、场景及素材，使图形、动画、界面或玩法呈现指定行为。
body.en: GameDevBench contains 333 Godot project-editing tasks derived from web/video tutorials. Coding agents inspect requirements and an existing project, then edit code, scenes and assets to realize specified graphics, animation, UI or gameplay behavior.

body.zh: 用于研究代码推理与多模态场景理解如何共同影响项目修改，并比较图像或视频反馈能否帮助智能体发现视觉和运行行为错误。
body.en: It studies how code reasoning and multimodal scene understanding jointly affect project editing, and whether image/video feedback helps agents identify visual and runtime-behavior errors.

body.zh: 对修改后的工程运行任务对应的验证流程，按解决任务的比例报告成功率，并按开发类别比较表现。图像和视频反馈实验保持任务测试目标一致，比较反馈对最终成功率的影响。
body.en: Task-specific validators evaluate the edited project. Success is reported as the fraction of solved tasks, with category-level breakdowns; image/video feedback experiments compare final success under the same task objectives.

body.zh: 本条目对应333项论文任务，官方验证依赖Godot 4.4.1。论文结果与后续公开榜单按版本区分，评价单位为工程修改产物。
body.en: This entry covers the paper’s 333 tasks; official validation uses Godot 4.4.1. Paper results and subsequent leaderboard versions are distinguished, with edited projects as the evaluation units.

body.zh: BesiegeField 在《围攻》中把组件、连接和驱动写成机器程序；比较单次生成与仿真反馈驱动的迭代/分层改造，覆盖七类机械任务。
body.en: BesiegeField turns parts, connections and actuation into machine programs in Besiege, comparing one-shot generation with simulation-feedback iterative/hierarchical refinement across seven mechanical task families.

body.zh: 用于研究组件级组合设计、物理因果推理和反馈驱动的程序修改，比较单次构造、盲改造与仿真反馈对最终机器功能的影响。
body.en: It studies component-level composition, physical causal reasoning and feedback-driven program revision, comparing initial construction, blind refinement and simulator-informed refinement.

body.zh: 先报告程序解析、空间约束和机器有效率，再统计有效机器的任务物理分数均值及候选中的最高分。实验按初始构造、盲改造和环境反馈阶段各生成最多八个候选，分开比较功能与有效性。
body.en: Evaluation first reports parsing, spatial and machine-validity rates, then physical-score means over valid machines and best-candidate scores. Initial construction, blind refinement and feedback refinement generate up to eight candidates per stage, separating functionality from validity.

body.zh: 评测包括多类《围攻》机械构造任务；单次生成、迭代改造和分层改造采用各自实验流程。
body.en: Evaluation covers Besiege construction tasks under one-shot, iterative and hierarchical refinement procedures.

paragraphs.zh: 先报告程序解析、空间约束和机器有效率，再统计有效机器的任务物理分数均值及候选中的最高分。实验按初始构造、盲改造和环境反馈阶段各生成最多八个候选，分开比较功能与有效性。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation first reports parsing, spatial and machine-validity rates, then physical-score means over valid machines and best-candidate scores. Initial construction, blind refinement and feedback refinement generate up to eight candidates per stage, separating functionality from validity.

paragraphs.zh: 评测包括多类《围攻》机械构造任务；单次生成、迭代改造和分层改造采用各自实验流程。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation covers Besiege construction tasks under one-shot, iterative and hierarchical refinement procedures.

body.zh: GameCraft-Bench要求开发智能体把自然语言游戏规格实现为完整Godot 4工程，并提交可重放操作轨迹。140个任务分布于15个游戏家族，覆盖脚本、场景、素材和运行配置的整合。
body.en: GameCraft-Bench asks coding agents to turn natural-language game specifications into complete Godot 4 projects and submit replayable interaction traces. Its 140 tasks span fifteen game families and require scripts, scenes, assets and runtime configuration to work together.

body.zh: 用于研究真实游戏引擎中的端到端开发，评价需求理解、机制实现与可运行产物的整合。
body.en: It studies end-to-end development in a real engine, combining requirement understanding, mechanics and executable artifacts.

body.zh: 验证器启动工程并重放操作，记录实际游玩证据；通过启动检查后，由隐藏评分规则和多模态评委评价核心机制、内容深度、功能视觉及艺术呈现，并分别汇总。
body.en: The verifier launches the project, replays submitted inputs and records gameplay evidence. After a launch gate, hidden rubrics and a multimodal judge score core mechanics, content depth, functional visuals and art/presentation, reporting these categories separately.

body.zh: 评价对象为完整游戏工程及其可重放演示，而非孤立脚本或静态截图。任务规格、引擎版本、重放轨迹与隐藏评分规则共同定义端到端验收条件。
body.en: Evaluation concerns complete game projects and replayable demonstrations rather than isolated scripts or static images. Specifications, engine version, traces and hidden rubrics jointly define end-to-end acceptance.

body.zh: GameEngineBench在九个既有Unreal Engine 5工程中提供110项C++行为实现任务。智能体根据需求修改工程，使联机复制、动画、界面、持久化或渲染插件在运行时表现正确。
body.en: GameEngineBench provides 110 C++ implementation tasks in nine existing Unreal Engine 5 projects. Agents edit code to realize requested runtime behavior in networking, animation, UI, persistence and rendering plugins.

body.zh: 用于研究开发代理处理真实 Unreal Engine C++ 工程的能力，包括运行时行为、引擎接口和跨模块修改。
body.en: It studies coding agents in real Unreal Engine C++ projects, including runtime behavior, engine interfaces and cross-module edits.

body.zh: 以单次提交同时通过编译和指定运行行为测试的任务比例报告pass@1。编译成功是可执行性条件，行为测试判定产物是否满足任务需求。
body.en: Pass@1 is the fraction of single submissions that both compile and satisfy specified runtime-behavior tests. Compilation establishes executability; behavior tests determine whether the requested functionality is implemented.

body.zh: 评测聚焦真实UE5工程内的代码变更及运行验证，包含跨模块和引擎接口相关修改；任务所在工程与测试环境确定对应依赖和验收条件。
body.en: Evaluation focuses on code changes and runtime validation inside real UE5 projects, including cross-module and engine-API changes. Each host project and test environment determines dependencies and acceptance conditions.

body.zh: JAMER从Game Jam项目构建8,133个有效Godot工程组成JamSet，并从中选取300个工程形成JamBench生成与代码补全任务。模型输出工程代码，测试其结构及运行行为。
body.en: JAMER constructs JamSet from 8,133 valid Game Jam Godot projects and selects 300 projects for JamBench generation and code-completion tasks. Models produce project code whose structure and runtime behavior are tested.

body.zh: 用于研究专业游戏引擎工程的代码生成、框架补全及行为实现，连接项目级数据与可执行测试。
body.en: It supports project-level generation, framework completion and behavior implementation in professional game engines.

body.zh: 编译通过率测量生成工程的可执行性，结构完整性分数（SCS）检查工程结构，行为对齐分数（BAS）评价指定行为的实现程度；三类指标分别反映产物的不同层次。
body.en: Compilation rate measures executability, Structural Completeness Score (SCS) assesses project structure, and Behavioral Alignment Score (BAS) assesses realization of target behavior. The three measures describe distinct levels of artifact quality.

body.zh: JamSet提供训练和分析用项目数据，JamBench提供选定的生成与补全测试。数据集规模、测试工程数和具体任务设置分别记录。
body.en: JamSet supplies project data for training and analysis; JamBench supplies selected generation/completion tests. Dataset size, test-project count and individual task settings are recorded separately.

body.zh: WebGameBench提供111项冻结的结构化浏览器游戏需求，要求编码智能体生成可部署应用。验收时启动产物并在真实浏览器中执行交互，观察游戏是否按需求工作。
body.en: WebGameBench supplies 111 frozen structured specifications for browser games, asking coding agents to produce deployable applications. Evaluation launches each artifact and interacts through a real browser to inspect its behavior.

body.zh: 用于研究编码代理从结构化需求到可交互网页应用的实现质量，使用游戏需求约束功能与交互。
body.en: It studies coding agents implementing interactive web applications from structured gameplay requirements.

body.zh: 按Excellent、Usable和Unusable三类对产物分级，分别汇总可用率与优秀率，区分基本可交互的应用和达到更高验收标准的应用。判定以浏览器运行及需求检查为依据。
body.en: Artifacts are classified as Excellent, Usable or Unusable. Usable and excellent rates distinguish basic interactive operation from higher acceptance standards, using browser execution and requirement checks as evidence.

body.zh: 评测对象为依据固定规格生成的浏览器游戏，部署、交互和需求验收属于同一评测流程；可用性分级与完整需求实现程度按协议分别解释。
body.en: The evaluated objects are browser games generated from fixed specifications, with deployment, interaction and requirement inspection in one workflow. Usability categories and completeness of requirement implementation are interpreted according to the protocol.

body.zh: GAMEGO构造游戏开发轨迹与测试任务：GameGoData包含55,060条开发轨迹，GameGoBench包含124项留出需求。编码模型根据需求和素材生成可运行的React浏览器游戏。
body.en: GAMEGO constructs development trajectories and test tasks: GameGoData contains 55,060 trajectories, while GameGoBench contains 124 held-out specifications. Coding models use requirements and assets to build runnable React browser games.

body.zh: 用于研究基于真实资产的游戏开发轨迹合成与开发代理训练，分析执行能力和需求满足程度。
body.en: It studies asset-grounded development-trajectory synthesis and agent training, analyzing execution and requirement satisfaction.

body.zh: Execution Rate统计产物能否在浏览器中执行，Requirements评价需求满足程度，Quality评价视觉与交互质量。分步浏览器试玩提供证据，独立评委对产物计分；外部ArtifactsBench-G与Cookie-Bench-G结果另列。
body.en: Execution Rate measures browser executability, Requirements measures specification satisfaction, and Quality measures visual/interaction quality. Step-driven browser play supplies evidence for independent judging; external ArtifactsBench-G and Cookie-Bench-G results are reported separately.

body.zh: GameGoData用于开发代理训练，GameGoBench按维度和难度组织留出测试，训练与测试种子在任务构造前分离。GameGoCoder为利用这些数据训练的开发模型。
body.en: GameGoData trains development agents; GameGoBench organizes held-out tests by dimensionality and difficulty, separating training/test seeds before task construction. GameGoCoder is the coding model trained using these data.

body.zh: PlaytestArena提供八类、200项游戏生成任务。Play2Code交替执行编码、GUI试玩和问题报告，将跨轮经验存入共享记忆，再据试玩反馈修改游戏工程。
body.en: PlaytestArena supplies 200 generation tasks across eight game categories. Play2Code alternates coding, GUI playtesting and issue reporting, stores experience in shared memory, and revises game projects using playtest feedback.

body.zh: 用于研究实际交互证据能否提高生成游戏的功能质量，以及开发经验如何跨轮积累。编码代理、试玩代理和记忆机制可分别用于分析错误发现与修复。
body.en: It studies whether evidence from actual interaction improves generated-game functionality and how development experience accumulates across rounds. Coding, playtesting and memory components support analysis of error discovery and repair.

body.zh: 最终产物由独立的GPT-5.5 GUI评委按照任务预设的游玩评分规则评价，报告规则通过率及随迭代轮次的变化。提供修复反馈的试玩器与最终评委分别承担开发反馈和结果评价。
body.en: An independent GPT-5.5 GUI judge scores final artifacts against task-specific in-play rubrics, reporting rubric pass rates and changes across iterations. The repair-feedback playtester and final judge have separate development and assessment roles.

body.zh: 任务以生成游戏的可观察行为为验收对象，试玩器在开发时不读取最终隐藏评分规则。任务集、开发迭代和最终独立验收分别记录。
body.en: Acceptance concerns observable behavior of generated games; the development playtester does not read the final hidden rubrics. The task suite, development iterations and independent final assessment are recorded separately.

body.zh: SciCrafter让智能体在Minecraft创造模式中通过试验理解红石元件，再摆放方块、连线和触发按钮，构造满足灯光时序目标的电路。五个家族覆盖同步、路由、序列、等延迟和脉冲整形，各含五档难度。
body.en: SciCrafter asks agents to investigate redstone components in Minecraft creative mode, then place blocks, connect circuits and trigger buttons to meet light-timing specifications. Five families cover synchronization, routing, sequencing, equal delay and pulse shaping, each at five difficulty levels.

body.zh: 用于研究发现规律、知识巩固与工程应用之间的衔接，比较探索提示和知识结构对构造成功的影响。
body.en: It studies discovery, knowledge consolidation and application, comparing hints and knowledge structures in successful construction.

body.zh: 自动时序检查器按目标事件序列判定电路成功；每项任务包含50次验证试验预算，按八次运行汇总。探索提示、科学家模块和知识结构消融分别比较成功率，课程学习与独立任务设置分开报告。
body.en: An automated temporal checker determines circuit success against target event sequences. Each task has a fifty-verification-trial budget, with eight runs aggregated; prompt, scientist-module and knowledge-structure ablations compare success rates, separately for curriculum and independent-task settings.

body.zh: 智能体读取方块状态、事件流与附近元件信息，通过结构化操作进行实验和构造；评价端的成功信号保持在检查器内。比较对象包括实验探索、知识巩固及后续工程应用。
body.en: Agents inspect block state, event streams and nearby components and use structured operations for experiments and construction; evaluator success signals remain inside the checker. Comparisons cover exploratory experimentation, knowledge consolidation and engineering application.

paragraphs.zh: 智能体读取方块状态、事件流与附近元件信息，通过结构化操作进行实验和构造；评价端的成功信号保持在检查器内。比较对象包括实验探索、知识巩固及后续工程应用。
paragraphs.en: Agents inspect block state, event streams and nearby components and use structured operations for experiments and construction; evaluator success signals remain inside the checker. Comparisons cover exploratory experimentation, knowledge consolidation and engineering application.

body.zh: 从Counter-Strike 2人类比赛demo提取瞄准、移动和经济行为特征，构建玩家行为指纹。模型读取两次观测的特征，判断它们是否来自同一玩家。
body.en: Aiming, movement and economy features are extracted from human Counter-Strike 2 demos to form behavioral fingerprints. A model compares two observations and predicts whether they belong to the same player.

body.zh: 用于研究游戏行为中的身份特征、跨观测一致性与账号验证，分析回放历史如何支持同玩家判断。
body.en: It studies behavioral identity, cross-observation consistency and account verification from gameplay histories.

body.zh: ROC AUC衡量同玩家与不同玩家观测的区分能力，采用六折交叉验证，并报告跨数据集验证与聚合多段历史回放后的AUC。
body.en: ROC AUC measures discrimination between same-player and different-player observation pairs. Evaluation uses six-fold cross-validation, cross-dataset tests and AUC after aggregating multiple historical demos.

body.zh: Perfect和Professional人类回放数据提供身份验证样本，研究对象为行为一致性分类。单段观测和多历史聚合条件分别评价。
body.en: Perfect and Professional human-demo datasets provide identity-verification samples. The evaluated object is behavioral-consistency classification under single-observation and multihistory aggregation conditions.

body.zh: World2Minecraft先从实景图像预测三维占据，再将几何转为可交互Minecraft场景。MinecraftOcc支持场景重建，MinecraftVLN提供结合指令和视觉信息的下一视角或下一动作预测任务。
body.en: World2Minecraft predicts 3D occupancy from real-scene images and converts the geometry into interactive Minecraft scenes. MinecraftOcc supports reconstruction, while MinecraftVLN provides instruction/vision-conditioned next-view and next-action prediction tasks.

body.zh: 用于研究真实场景占据重建、模拟环境构建与视觉语言导航的数据生成，将场景几何转化为可交互方块世界。
body.en: It studies occupancy reconstruction, simulated scene construction and visual-language-navigation data through voxelized real scenes.

body.zh: 重建评价比较预测占据与参考几何；导航数据任务按参考视角或动作计算Next-View和Next-Action准确率，并比较无训练、监督微调和强化微调条件。实时导航应用单独以演示呈现。
body.en: Reconstruction evaluation compares predicted occupancy with reference geometry. Navigation-data tasks measure next-view/next-action accuracy against reference labels under no-training, supervised-finetuning and reinforcement-finetuning settings; real-time navigation is presented separately as a demonstration.

body.zh: MinecraftOcc包含来自156个室内场景的100,165张图像，MinecraftVLN用于离线预测评价。数据表具体划分和版本定义各项结果，重建、预测和在线演示为不同实验层次。
body.en: MinecraftOcc contains 100,165 images from 156 indoor scenes; MinecraftVLN supports offline prediction evaluation. Table-specific splits and versions define each result, separating reconstruction, prediction and online demonstrations.

body.zh: MC-EvoBench组织80个Minecraft任务、19条任务链，要求智能体从游戏观察和物品事件出发，持续采集资源、制作工具并完成阶段目标。阶段验证器记录里程碑，配对探针检验源任务经验对后续目标的影响。
body.en: MC-EvoBench organizes eighty Minecraft tasks into nineteen chains. Agents use game observations and inventory events to gather resources, craft tools and complete staged goals; verifiers record milestones and paired probes test how source-task experience affects target tasks.

body.zh: 用于研究经验驱动的改进与跨任务迁移，通过阶段验证器和配对探针分析经验产物对后续执行的作用。
body.en: It studies experience-driven improvement and transfer with stage verifiers and paired probes of experience artifacts.

body.zh: 任务成功率（TSR）衡量目标完成，加权图进展（WGP）衡量任务依赖图中的推进，验证里程碑进展（VMP）记录已达成阶段。经验迁移实验比较相关、无关及打乱经验与无经验条件，GATG作为配对描述量另列。
body.en: Task Success Rate (TSR) measures completion, Weighted Graph Progress (WGP) tracks dependency-graph advancement, and Verified Milestone Progress (VMP) tracks attained stages. Transfer probes compare related, unrelated, shuffled and no-prior experience; GATG is reported separately as a descriptive paired contrast.

body.zh: 12条主任务链与七条校准或探针链分开组织。迁移探针包含木材种类、木制工具和石制工具三类，使用五个配对种子；目标世界重置后，仅传递协议规定的经验产物。
body.en: Twelve primary chains are separated from seven calibration/probe chains. Transfer probes cover wood species, wooden tools and stone tools using five paired seeds; after resetting the target world, only declared experience artifacts are transferred.

body.zh: MultiWorldBench向视频或世界模型提供Minecraft双玩家动作脚本，要求分别生成两个受控视角，并维持共享世界状态。场景包括移动、放置或破坏方块、遮挡物移除、并发操作及离开后重访。
body.en: MultiWorldBench supplies Minecraft two-player action scripts and asks video/world models to generate independently controlled views of one shared world. Cases include navigation, block placement/destruction, occluder removal, concurrent actions and delayed revisits.

body.zh: 用于研究多视角生成世界的一致性，分析独立控制、共享对象和重访行为是否对应同一状态。
body.en: It studies consistency of multiview generated worlds under independent control, shared objects and revisits.

body.zh: 十项指标分别测控制独立性、跨视角运动、共享状态和重访一致性，结合相机轨迹、视觉判定、分割及视角估计。结果显示为0—100分，越高越好，并报告十项能力的等权平均；原引擎重放提供参考。
body.en: Ten metrics measure independent control, cross-view motion, shared state and revisit consistency using camera trajectories, visual judgments, segmentation and viewpoint estimates. Results are displayed on a higher-is-better 0–100 scale with an equal-weight ten-metric mean; engine replays provide references.

body.zh: 包含七个任务套件、495个配置，按导航、共享世界与重访三个组别报告。动作由脚本指定，研究对象为生成模型对多玩家条件和持久状态的实现。
body.en: Seven suites and 495 configurations are reported under navigation, shared world and revisit groups. Actions are scripted; the evaluated object is the generative model’s realization of multiplayer controls and persistent state.

body.zh: AiMDoom使用DOOM地图生成器构造室内三维几何。NextBestPath控制深度传感器或相机选择后续扫描路径，在PyTorch3D与Trimesh模拟中逐步观察并重建未知场景。
body.en: AiMDoom uses a DOOM map generator to construct indoor geometry. NextBestPath chooses successive depth-sensor/camera scanning paths, incrementally observing and reconstructing unknown scenes in PyTorch3D/Trimesh simulation.

body.zh: 用于研究主动三维扫描、下一最佳路径规划与未知室内几何重建，比较传感器路径的覆盖效率。
body.en: It studies active 3D scanning, next-best-path planning and reconstruction of unknown interiors through sensor-trajectory coverage.

body.zh: 以已重建表面占参考场景表面的比例衡量覆盖程度，并结合扫描路径长度比较获取几何信息的效率。固定场景与扫描设置后，评价不同规划方法在覆盖—路径代价上的权衡。
body.en: Reconstructed-surface coverage measures how much reference geometry has been observed, while scan-path length measures acquisition cost. Under fixed scenes and scanning settings, methods are compared on the coverage–path-cost tradeoff.

body.zh: DOOM地图仅用于产生几何环境，控制对象为扫描传感器；训练与测试以AiMDoom网格及对应重建配置组织。
body.en: DOOM maps supply geometric environments, and the controlled object is the scanning sensor. Training/testing use AiMDoom meshes and their reconstruction configurations.

body.zh: ChessBench提供Stockfish标注的棋局位置，用于训练从棋盘状态直接预测价值或选择着法的模型。实验同时包含离线预测、战术棋题和模型实际执行合法着法的闭环对局。
body.en: ChessBench provides Stockfish-labeled positions to train models that predict position value or select moves directly from board state. Experiments cover offline prediction, tactical puzzles and closed-loop games in which model-selected legal moves are executed.

body.zh: 用于研究通过大规模监督学习摊销搜索计算，比较价值预测、着法选择与实际棋力。
body.en: It studies amortizing search through large-scale supervised learning, comparing value prediction, move selection and playing strength.

body.zh: 价值预测以误差和排序相关性评价，棋题以正确着法比例评价，闭环比赛记录胜负和棋力估计。锦标赛使用BayesElo，Lichess实验报告平台等级分；数据预测与对局结果分开汇总。
body.en: Value prediction uses error and rank correlation; puzzles use correct-move accuracy; closed-loop games record outcomes and estimated playing strength. Tournaments use BayesElo and Lichess experiments report platform ratings, separately from offline prediction results.

body.zh: 本条目结合ChessBench数据和无搜索棋类策略研究。比赛按开局、换色和对手计算预算组织；发布的示例赛程每对组合200局，离线测试保留各自数据划分。
body.en: The entry combines ChessBench data with searchless-chess policy research. Matches specify openings, color swaps and opponent compute; the released example uses 200 games per pair, while offline tests retain their own data splits.

body.zh: ArtifactArena要求模型同时提交MuJoCo机器人的MJCF形态文件和Python控制器。系统实例化这些产物，在固定规则的Last Bot Standing物理对抗中由控制器驱动机器人竞争。
body.en: ArtifactArena asks models to submit both a MuJoCo robot’s MJCF morphology and a Python controller. The system instantiates these artifacts and lets the controllers compete in fixed-rule Last Bot Standing physical matches.

body.zh: 用于研究模型联合设计物理形态与控制程序的能力，分析生成产物在物理对抗中的适应性。
body.en: It studies joint body/controller design and the adaptability of generated artifacts in physical competition.

body.zh: 先进行产物资格验证，再记录成对比赛的胜、负、平，用Bradley–Terry模型估计Elo。换边和新随机种子实验检查对抗表现对位置及初始随机性的稳定程度。
body.en: Artifacts first undergo eligibility validation; pairwise wins, losses and draws then feed a Bradley–Terry Elo estimate. Side swaps and fresh seeds test robustness to arena position and initialization randomness.

body.zh: 评价单位为“机器人形态＋控制程序”的组合产物，固定仿真规则、对手和比赛配置定义成绩。模型负责生成设计，运行中的动作由提交的控制器产生。
body.en: The evaluation unit is the morphology–controller artifact pair, with fixed simulation rules, opponents and match settings defining results. The model generates the design; its submitted controller produces runtime actions.

paragraphs.zh: 评价单位为“机器人形态＋控制程序”的组合产物，固定仿真规则、对手和比赛配置定义成绩。模型负责生成设计，运行中的动作由提交的控制器产生。
paragraphs.en: The evaluation unit is the morphology–controller artifact pair, with fixed simulation rules, opponents and match settings defining results. The model generates the design; its submitted controller produces runtime actions.

body.zh: ALE 基于 Atari 2600 模拟器提供游戏交互，智能体从像素或 RAM 等观测选择控制台动作。游戏涵盖射击、平台、迷宫等机制。
body.en: ALE exposes Atari 2600 games through pixel or RAM observations and console actions across shooting, platform and maze mechanics.

body.zh: 用于研究通用强化学习、视觉表征与跨任务性能比较，在共享动作接口下考察不同 Atari 游戏的学习过程。
body.en: It supports general RL, visual representations and cross-task comparisons across Atari games using shared action interfaces.

body.zh: 按游戏累计原生得分，在固定测试回合上取平均。原始论文每次训练后评价500个不再学习的回合，并跨30次试验汇总；后续研究的归一化和聚合规则随各自协议记录。
body.en: Native game scores are accumulated and averaged over fixed evaluation episodes. The original paper evaluates 500 non-learning episodes after each training trial and aggregates thirty trials; later normalization and aggregation rules are recorded with their own protocols.

body.zh: 原论文按5000训练回合及18000帧回合上限组织实验；ROM、模式、帧跳过和随机动作设置共同定义具体协议。原始设置与后续sticky-action等设置分别记录。
body.en: The original experiments use 5,000 training episodes and an 18,000-frame episode limit. ROM, mode, frame skip and action randomness define each protocol, with original settings distinguished from later sticky-action variants.

body.zh: ViZDoom将Doom引擎封装为可配置研究环境，智能体从第一人称画面及可选深度、标签通道出发，执行移动、转向和战斗操作。场景可规定寻找物品、到达位置、击败敌人或持续生存等目标。
body.en: ViZDoom exposes Doom as a configurable research environment. Agents use first-person images and optional depth/label channels to move, turn and fight, pursuing scenario-defined goals such as item collection, reaching locations, defeating enemies or survival.

body.zh: 用于研究第一人称视觉控制、导航、目标获取与对抗策略。场景编辑支持控制敌人、物品和奖励结构。
body.en: It supports first-person visual control, navigation, target acquisition and combat under configurable enemies, items and rewards.

body.zh: 场景脚本定义奖励事件和结束条件，测试按回合统计累计回报；以击杀、生存或到达为目标的任务还可报告对应事件数量、存活时长或完成率。动作按钮、仿真步长和回合上限随场景记录。
body.en: Scenario scripts define reward events and episode endings, with cumulative episode return as a central measure. Kill, survival and reaching tasks may additionally report their event counts, survival duration or completion rate; buttons, simulation step and episode limits are recorded per scenario.

body.zh: 任务通过场景、观测通道、动作按钮、仿真推进方式及奖励配置定义。
body.en: Scenarios, observation channels, action buttons, simulation advancement and rewards define each task.

body.zh: SC2LE / PySC2 提供《星际争霸 II》的学习接口，智能体读取屏幕、地图或结构化观察，调用动作函数控制单位与建筑。
body.en: SC2LE/PySC2 provides StarCraft II learning interfaces with screen, map or structured observations and action functions for units and buildings.

body.zh: 用于研究复杂实时战略中的决策、控制和表示学习，小游戏支持分析特定技能，完整对局连接经济、生产与战斗。
body.en: It supports RTS decision making, control and representations through skill minigames and full-game economy, production and combat.

body.zh: 小游戏使用任务专属得分，例如BuildMarines统计生产陆战队员的表现；完整比赛记录对局胜负。回放学习则以人类轨迹上的预测任务评价，三类结果分别报告。
body.en: Minigames use task-specific scores—for example, BuildMarines measures marine production—while full games report match outcomes. Replay learning uses prediction tasks on human trajectories, and these result types are reported separately.

body.zh: 平台包含小游戏、完整对局和人类回放。实验需对应具体地图、游戏版本、观测特征和动作接口，小游戏提供局部技能分析，完整对局覆盖经济、生产和战斗的联合决策。
body.en: The platform includes minigames, full matches and human replays. Experiments specify maps, game version, observation features and action interface; minigames analyze local skills while full games combine economy, production and combat decisions.

body.zh: DeepMind Lab是基于Quake III的第一人称三维研究环境。智能体通过视觉观察执行移动、转向和交互，在迷宫或任务地图中探索路径、寻找目标物品并完成脚本规定的目标。
body.en: DeepMind Lab is a Quake III-based first-person 3D research environment. Agents use visual observations to move, turn and interact, exploring mazes/task maps, finding target objects and completing scripted objectives.

body.zh: 用于研究第一人称导航、空间记忆与视觉强化学习，程序化地图和任务脚本支持受控场景变化。
body.en: It supports first-person navigation, spatial memory and visual RL through procedural maps and scripted tasks.

body.zh: 关卡脚本把目标获取或其他任务事件转为奖励，以回合累计回报比较策略；地图种子和时间上限控制测试条件。导航、解谜与其他关卡保留各自事件和奖励定义。
body.en: Level scripts convert target collection or other task events into rewards, with cumulative episode return used for policy comparisons. Map seeds and time limits define testing conditions; navigation, puzzle and other levels retain their own event/reward rules.

body.zh: 实验单位为关卡脚本与对应观测、动作、种子和时间预算，包含导航及解谜等任务。
body.en: Level scripts, observations, actions, seeds and time limits define navigation, puzzle and related experiments.

body.zh: GVGAI以通用游戏描述语言构造二维游戏，智能体读取游戏状态并选择离散动作完成胜利目标。部分赛道允许复制状态、向前模拟候选动作，其他赛道通过交互学习策略或生成关卡。
body.en: GVGAI constructs 2D games with a general game-description language. Agents inspect state and select discrete actions to achieve victory; some tracks allow state copying and forward simulation, while others learn through interaction or generate levels.

body.zh: 用于研究跨游戏决策、前向模型规划、学习与程序化内容生成，比较方法对不同游戏规则的适应。
body.en: It supports cross-game decisions, forward-model planning, learning and procedural content generation across diverse rules.

body.zh: 游玩赛道通常按胜负优先比较，再结合游戏得分和完成时间；各赛道按指定游戏及关卡汇总。内容生成赛道另用自己的内容和可玩性评价程序，成绩随赛道解释。
body.en: Playing tracks typically prioritize wins, then use game score and completion time, aggregating over specified games and levels. Content-generation tracks use their own content/playability procedures, with results interpreted within each track.

body.zh: 框架由不同赛道和游戏集合组成，前向模型访问、训练机会与关卡划分由赛道协议指定。
body.en: Tracks define game sets, forward-model access, learning opportunities and level splits.

body.zh: CoinRun是程序化生成的平台跳跃环境，智能体根据游戏画面选择移动和跳跃动作，避开障碍及敌人，到达关卡中的金币。训练可以限制为固定关卡集合，测试在新生成关卡上进行。
body.en: CoinRun is a procedurally generated platformer. From game images, agents choose movement/jump actions to avoid obstacles and enemies and reach the coin; training can use a fixed level set, with evaluation on newly generated levels.

body.zh: 用于研究强化学习泛化与训练关卡多样性，比较正则化、数据规模及策略结构对测试表现的影响。
body.en: It studies RL generalization and level diversity, comparing regularization, data scale and policy architecture.

body.zh: 回合回报或取币成功率衡量关卡完成，分别报告训练关卡与新关卡上的表现。固定训练步数后改变训练关卡数量，可分析关卡多样性与测试泛化之间的关系。
body.en: Episode return or coin-collection success measures level completion, reported separately on training and new levels. Varying the number of training levels under a fixed interaction budget tests how level diversity affects generalization.

body.zh: 本条目对应原版 CoinRun。评测定义训练关卡数量与测试采样过程，并记录难度、随机种子及交互预算。
body.en: This is original CoinRun, evaluated with specified training-level counts, test sampling, difficulty, seeds and budgets.

body.zh: Obstacle Tower让智能体在第三人称三维高塔中逐层寻找通往下一层的楼梯，途中执行移动和跳跃、寻找钥匙并解决房间障碍。楼层布局、视觉主题和谜题配置程序化生成。
body.en: Obstacle Tower asks agents to find the stairs to successive floors in a third-person 3D tower, moving/jumping, collecting keys and solving room obstacles. Layouts, visual themes and puzzle configurations are procedurally generated.

body.zh: 用于研究视觉导航、控制与程序化环境泛化，多层结构要求结合局部操作、钥匙收集与路径决策。
body.en: It studies visual navigation, control and procedural generalization through floor traversal, key collection and route decisions.

body.zh: 主要以每回合通过楼层数衡量推进程度，并统计多次运行的分布；奖励由通过楼层和辅助任务事件产生。未见种子或主题上的结果用于比较程序化场景泛化。
body.en: Floors cleared per episode measure progression, with distributions over repeated runs. Rewards arise from floor completion and auxiliary events; performance on held-out seeds/themes supports comparisons of procedural generalization.

body.zh: 论文实测原型为25层，后续环境设计和竞赛版本具有各自配置；视觉主题、种子与奖励模式定义测试条件。
body.en: The paper evaluates a 25-floor prototype; later designs and competition versions have separate configurations, themes, seeds and reward modes.

body.zh: Griddly以GDY规则描述对象、动作和交互，生成单智能体或多智能体网格游戏。智能体可读取向量、图像或状态映射并选择对象动作，完成推箱、收集或即时战略等规则定义的目标。
body.en: Griddly uses GDY descriptions of objects, actions and interactions to create single/multiagent grid games. Agents use vector, image or state-map observations and select object actions to solve rule-defined tasks such as box pushing, collection or RTS play.

body.zh: 用于控制规则、布局和观察方式，研究规划、强化学习及程序化任务生成；可复制的前向模型支持在候选动作上模拟后果。相同规则下的多种渲染也可用于分析视觉表示变化。
body.en: It supports controlled changes to rules, layouts and observers for planning, RL and procedural task generation. Copyable forward models enable simulated action evaluation, and multiple renderers under shared rules support studies of visual representation changes.

body.zh: 每个游戏的规则文件定义奖励和胜利条件，按关卡统计回合回报与成功情况。引擎吞吐属于系统效率，策略得分属于游戏表现，两者分开比较。
body.en: Each game’s rules define rewards and victory conditions, with episode returns and success measured by level. Engine throughput measures system efficiency, while policy scores measure gameplay performance; these are compared separately.

body.zh: 评测由游戏描述、关卡、观察器和动作配置确定，推箱子等任务是平台上的具体实例。
body.en: Game descriptions, levels, observers and actions define evaluations; Sokoban is one platform instance.

paragraphs.en: Griddly uses GDY descriptions of objects, actions and interactions to create single/multiagent grid games. Agents use vector, image or state-map observations and select object actions to solve rule-defined tasks such as box pushing, collection or RTS play.

body.zh: ELF提供MiniRTS、夺旗和塔防等轻量即时战略环境及并行训练接口。MiniRTS中智能体读取游戏观察，安排资源采集、单位生产与战斗，争取击败对手。
body.en: ELF provides lightweight RTS environments such as MiniRTS, capture-the-flag and tower defense, together with parallel training interfaces. In MiniRTS, agents read game observations and organize resource collection, production and combat to defeat an opponent.

body.zh: 用于研究即时战略中的强化学习、规划与样本效率，MiniRTS 将资源采集、生产和战斗整合到较轻量的环境中。
body.en: It supports RTS reinforcement learning, planning and sample efficiency through lightweight MiniRTS resource, production and combat dynamics.

body.zh: MiniRTS策略按对指定内置对手的胜率和终局回报评价，多次训练汇总用于描述学习稳定性。模拟吞吐与训练速度作为平台效率结果，和策略成绩分别报告。
body.en: MiniRTS policies are evaluated by win rates and terminal returns against specified built-in opponents, with repeated training used to describe stability. Simulation throughput and training speed are platform-efficiency results reported separately from policy performance.

body.zh: 平台包含 MiniRTS、夺旗和塔防等环境，具体实验由游戏、宏动作、信息条件和对手策略定义。
body.en: The platform includes MiniRTS, Capture the Flag and Tower Defense, with games, macro-actions, information and opponents defining experiments.

body.zh: Project Malmo在Minecraft中用mission规范配置世界、任务目标、智能体观测和奖励事件。智能体读取图像或结构化状态，通过规定的移动、交互等控制命令执行导航或其他任务。
body.en: Project Malmo configures Minecraft worlds, goals, agent observations and reward events through mission specifications. Agents read images or structured state and issue permitted movement/interaction commands to perform navigation or other tasks.

body.zh: 用于构造可控的开放世界实验，比较导航、学习和多智能体交互方法。研究者可在相同世界或任务条件下改变观测信息、控制接口和奖励机制。
body.en: It supports controlled open-world experiments for navigation, learning and multiagent interaction. Researchers can vary observation information, control interfaces and rewards under matched world/task conditions.

body.zh: mission规定哪些事件产生奖励、成功或结束信号；实验按这些事件记录累计回报与目标完成，并在固定步数或时间预算下比较策略。平台提供任务执行接口，具体计分来自mission定义。
body.en: Missions specify reward, success and termination events; experiments record cumulative return and completion under fixed step/time budgets. The platform executes tasks, while scoring is defined by each mission.

body.zh: Malmo 是任务平台，实验由 mission 描述、客户端配置、控制接口和奖励事件确定。
body.en: Malmo is a mission platform, with mission descriptions, clients, control interfaces and reward events defining experiments.

body.zh: SpireBench让模型读取《杀戮尖塔》的JSON游戏状态，通过工具选择卡牌、路线、奖励和事件选项，控制Ironclad在A20难度完成四幕并挑战Heart。
body.en: SpireBench supplies Slay the Spire state as JSON and tools for selecting cards, routes, rewards and event options. Models control the Ironclad at A20 through four acts and the Heart encounter.

body.zh: 用于研究长时程资源取舍、牌组构建与跨战斗规划。术语重命名检验模型对熟悉游戏知识的依赖，记忆模式对比分析跨局经验和上下文组织。
body.en: It studies long-horizon resource tradeoffs, deck construction and cross-combat planning. Terminology reskins probe dependence on familiar game knowledge, while memory comparisons examine cross-run experience and context organization.

body.zh: 平均完成幕数、各幕通关率和终止楼层衡量推进与成功，逐局或逐层调用成本描述决策开销。论文主表使用相同十个种子和主题重命名条件，记忆实验按种子顺序传递可写经验。
body.en: Mean acts cleared, per-act win rates and final floor measure progress/success; per-run or per-floor cost measures decision overhead. Main results use ten shared seeds and a themed reskin, with writable memory carried in seed order.

body.zh: 成绩对应指定角色、难度、模组和动作批处理设置下的完整爬塔。种子顺序、术语重命名与记忆模式定义比较条件，战斗和非战斗选择共同组成整局结果。
body.en: Results concern full runs under specified character, difficulty, mod and action-batching settings. Seed order, reskin and memory mode define comparisons, with combat and noncombat choices jointly determining outcomes.

body.zh: PokéAgent Challenge包含两个独立赛道：竞技赛道根据可见场面和历史选择招式或换人，在不完全信息宝可梦对战中竞争；速通赛道通过模拟器按键推进Pokémon Emerald，目标是击败首个道馆馆主Roxanne。
body.en: PokéAgent Challenge has two independent tracks: competitive agents use visible battle state/history to choose moves or switches, while speedrun agents send emulator button inputs in Pokémon Emerald to defeat first gym leader Roxanne.

body.zh: 用于研究不完全信息竞技决策与长上下文任务推进，两个赛道分别考察对手适应和持续目标执行。
body.en: It studies imperfect-information competition and long-context progression through separate battling and speedrunning tracks.

body.zh: 竞技赛道以完整对局历史拟合的Bradley–Terry评级（FH-BT）为主指标，配合bootstrap不确定性，并另报Glicko-1和GXE。速通先按里程碑完成百分比排序，完成者比较时间，再以动作数区分。
body.en: Competitive play primarily uses full-history Bradley–Terry (FH-BT) ratings with bootstrap uncertainty, alongside Glicko-1 and GXE. Speedrunning ranks milestone completion first, then completion time, with action count as a tie-breaker.

body.zh: 竞技赛道分别报告Gen 1 OU、Gen 9 OU规则和不同计时条件；速通采用首道馆范围及规定帧率。各harness使用的状态、工具、记忆和反馈配置随成绩列出。
body.en: Competitive results separate Gen 1 OU, Gen 9 OU and timer regimes. Speedruns use the first-gym scope and specified frame rate, with harness-specific state, tools, memory and feedback recorded alongside results.

body.zh: VGC-Bench让策略使用给定队伍参加宝可梦双打，从结构化状态和合法联合动作中选择两只出场宝可梦的行动。资源提供RL、行为克隆、LLM及启发式基线。
body.en: VGC-Bench evaluates policies using supplied teams in Pokémon doubles. From structured state and legal joint actions, a policy selects actions for its two active Pokémon; RL, behavior-cloning, LLM and heuristic baselines are provided.

body.zh: 用于研究双单位联合决策、阵容变化下的策略泛化，以及训练对手和队伍多样性对竞技表现的影响。给定阵容把对战决策与完整队伍构筑区分开。
body.en: It studies joint decisions for two active units, generalization across team compositions, and effects of opponent/team diversity. Supplied lineups separate battle decisions from full team construction.

body.zh: 交叉对战胜率衡量策略间表现，Alpha-Rank汇总策略池中的相对关系；双方未见阵容上的比赛检验队伍泛化，训练专用对手估计策略可被利用的程度。基础LLM与RL评测分别采用100局和1000局。
body.en: Cross-play win rates measure pairwise performance, and Alpha-Rank summarizes the policy pool. Matches with unseen lineups test team generalization; trained exploiters estimate vulnerability. Basic LLM and RL evaluations use 100 and 1,000 games respectively.

body.zh: 智能体使用给定队伍进行对战，训练阵容规模、留出阵容、对手池与比赛局数定义实验。
body.en: Agents pilot given teams; training diversity, held-out teams, opponent populations and match counts define experiments.

body.zh: gg-bench先自动生成并筛选双人游戏，再为每个游戏训练强化学习对手。语言模型读取规则、当前棋盘和合法动作说明，连续选招以击败对应对手，非法输出触发重新提示。
body.en: gg-bench generates and filters two-player games and trains game-specific RL opponents. Language models read the rulebook, board and legal-action descriptions, then act throughout each match; invalid outputs trigger reprompting.

body.zh: 用于研究模型对新规则的理解与策略适应，自动生成的游戏分布支持比较新任务中的竞争表现。
body.en: It studies understanding novel rules and adapting strategies through automatically generated competitive games.

body.zh: 每款游戏进行30局并统计LLM胜率，再对126款筛选后游戏的胜率取平均；同时分析非法动作和调用成本。固定的对手检查点为不同模型提供共同参照。
body.en: LLM win rates are measured over thirty matches per game and averaged across 126 filtered games, with invalid actions and inference cost analyzed separately. Fixed opponent checkpoints provide a common reference across models.

body.zh: 游戏生成器和可执行性筛选确定测试分布；对手来自同游戏的RL检查点池。成绩对应规则说明、合法动作接口及指定对手共同构成的新游戏适应任务。
body.en: The generator and executability filters define the test distribution; opponents come from each game’s RL checkpoint pool. Results concern adaptation under supplied rules, legal-action interfaces and specified opponents.

body.zh: COMRAD提供13个ViZDoom第一人称合作场景，智能体依据私有RGB视角和离散控制协同完成目标。例如Ammo Carrier中，一名智能体守卫据点，另一名从补给点运送弹药。
body.en: COMRAD provides thirteen ViZDoom first-person cooperative scenarios, using private RGB views and discrete controls. In Ammo Carrier, one agent defends a hub while another carries ammunition from depots.

body.zh: 用于研究具身多智能体强化学习中的分工、同步与空间协作，局部视觉和角色差异形成互相依赖的任务。
body.en: It studies role allocation, synchronization and spatial cooperation in embodied MARL with local vision and asymmetric roles.

body.zh: 按场景规则统计原始得分，并以归一化分数比较不同场景；训练曲线与多种子区间描述学习效果和不确定性。程序化地图留出测试用于单独分析布局泛化。
body.en: Scenario rules define raw scores, with normalized scores supporting cross-scenario comparisons. Learning curves and multiseed intervals describe learning and uncertainty, while held-out procedural maps separately assess layout generalization.

body.zh: 各场景具有自己的角色、地图和奖励目标；Ammo Carrier为其中的非对称合作案例。场景文件、动作跳帧、队友策略、训练预算与地图划分定义比较设置。
body.en: Scenarios have distinct roles, maps and reward objectives; Ammo Carrier is an asymmetric-cooperation example. Scenario files, frame skip, partner policy, training budget and map split define comparisons.

paragraphs.zh: COMRAD提供13个ViZDoom第一人称合作场景，智能体依据私有RGB视角和离散控制协同完成目标。例如Ammo Carrier中，一名智能体守卫据点，另一名从补给点运送弹药。
paragraphs.en: COMRAD provides thirteen ViZDoom first-person cooperative scenarios, using private RGB views and discrete controls. In Ammo Carrier, one agent defends a hub while another carries ammunition from depots.

body.zh: AgenticSTS向模型提供《杀戮尖塔2》的结构化文本状态、合法动作与按实验条件启用的记忆或技能。模型持续选择战斗、组牌、路线、事件和奖励，完成一次爬塔。
body.en: AgenticSTS supplies structured Slay the Spire 2 state, legal actions and condition-specific memory/skills. Models make combat, deckbuilding, route, event and reward decisions throughout a run.

body.zh: 用于研究有界记忆设计对长期决策的影响，通过记忆层和提示组件消融分析跨战斗信息组织。
body.en: It studies bounded memory in long-horizon decisions through ablations of memory layers and prompt components.

body.zh: 固定A0难度实验按完成对局统计胜率并给出Wilson 95%置信区间；进展分结合楼层和击败boss数量，另报告token与成本。自动难度阶梯实验按其难度和进展单独汇总。
body.en: Fixed-A0 experiments report win rates over completed runs with Wilson 95% confidence intervals. A progress score combines floors and bosses, alongside tokens/cost; automatic difficulty-ladder results are aggregated separately by difficulty and progress.

body.zh: 固定难度消融包含五种条件，各取按开始时间最早的十个完成对局，记忆库冻结且禁用赛后写入。298条发布轨迹、模型迁移及难度阶梯属于资源中的不同实验集合。
body.en: The fixed-difficulty ablation uses the earliest ten completed runs by start time in each of five conditions, with frozen memory stores and no postrun writes. The 298 released trajectories, model-transfer experiments and difficulty ladder are distinct resource components.

body.zh: 官方FightingLLM示例让模型读取双方生命、能量、位置、动作和弹幕等文本状态，输出格斗命令，再由CommandCenter转为按键序列，控制ZEN实时对战MctsAi23i。
body.en: The official FightingLLM example supplies text state including HP, energy, positions, actions and projectiles. Models output fighting commands, converted by CommandCenter into key sequences, to control ZEN against MctsAi23i in real time.

body.zh: 用于研究语言模型在实时格斗中的状态理解、招式选择与反馈控制，竞赛设置连接提示工程和模型策略。
body.en: It studies state understanding, move selection and feedback control in real-time fighting through prompting and model policies.

body.zh: 参考代理在回合结束记录双方剩余生命与经过帧数，代码中的即时奖励为造成伤害减自身生命损失。上述字段用于描述单回合表现，和赛事总体排名公式分别记录。
body.en: The reference agent records both fighters’ remaining HP and elapsed frames at round end; its immediate reward is damage dealt minus own HP lost. These fields describe round-level performance and are recorded separately from competition-wide ranking rules.

body.zh: 本条目的具体交互设置对应官方LLM对MCTS参考代理，固定角色和提示条件。2026赛事的正式轮数、排名汇总及最终模型限制仍属于待补规则信息。
body.en: The detailed interaction setting is the official LLM-versus-MCTS reference agent with specified characters and prompt conditions. Formal 2026 round counts, ranking aggregation and final model restrictions remain information to complete.
